Abl.AutoFilter~.builtin_alternative: svf~ — plain state-variable filter, no LFO, envelope or sidechain.
Abl.AutoFilter~.comments: Five inlets: inlet 1 is a sidechain input (MC or MSP). Audio in/out is one 2-channel MC cord; use mc.unpack~ 2 to reach plain MSP objects.
Abl.AutoFilter~.function: Filters stereo audio with Live's Auto Filter, including LFO, envelope and sidechain.

Abl.ChannelEQ~.builtin_alternative: filtergraph~ with cascade~ — graphical, any number of bands, no panel or presets.
Abl.ChannelEQ~.comments: Audio in/out is one 2-channel MC cord; use mc.unpack~ 2 to reach plain MSP objects.
Abl.ChannelEQ~.function: Equalizes a stereo signal with Live's three-band Channel EQ and highpass.

Abl.Chorus~.comments: Modulation inputs are polled every 30 ms; for audio-rate modulation use abl.dsp.chorus~ inlets directly. Audio in/out is one 2-channel MC cord; use mc.unpack~ 2 to reach plain MSP objects.
Abl.Chorus~.function: Adds stereo chorus from Live's Chorus-Ensemble device, with presets.

Abl.Compander~.builtin_alternative: omx.comp~ — full compressor with threshold and ratio.
Abl.Compander~.comments: Runs two mono abl.dsp.compander~ objects, one per side. Coloured, not transparent, dynamics.
Abl.Compander~.function: Compresses or expands a stereo signal with an A-law compander curve.

Abl.Compressor~.builtin_alternative: omx.comp~ — older OctiMax compressor with more controls and a sidechain.
Abl.Compressor~.comments: No sidechain input and the envelope outlet is hidden; use abl.device.compressor~ directly if you need them. Audio in/out is one 2-channel MC cord; use mc.unpack~ 2 to reach plain MSP objects.
Abl.Compressor~.function: Compresses a stereo signal using Live's Compressor device, with presets.

Abl.DFM~.builtin_alternative: lores~ — resonant lowpass without drive or analog modelling.
Abl.DFM~.comments: Two mono abl.dsp.dfm~ objects inside, one per side.
Abl.DFM~.function: Filters stereo audio through a driven, resonant analog-model lowpass.

Abl.DarkHall~.builtin_alternative: cverb~ — simple mono reverb, far plainer.
Abl.DarkHall~.comments: One of six reverb modules; also used raw in the repo's reverb-shootout patch. Freeze parameter holds the tail. Audio in/out is one 2-channel MC cord; use mc.unpack~ 2 to reach plain MSP objects.
Abl.DarkHall~.function: Adds a dark, long hall reverb from Live's Hybrid Reverb.

Abl.Delay~.builtin_alternative: tapin~ / tapout~ — build-your-own delay line, no filter or panel.
Abl.Delay~.comments: Times are set in ms (1–5000); no tempo-sync control on the panel. Audio in/out is one 2-channel MC cord; use mc.unpack~ 2 to reach plain MSP objects.
Abl.Delay~.function: Delays stereo audio with Live's Delay: feedback, filter, ping-pong, freeze.

Abl.Distortion~.builtin_alternative: overdrive~ — basic soft clipping, no tone controls.
Abl.Distortion~.comments: Sibling of Abl.Overdrive~ and Abl.Fuzz~ (same controls, different character). Runs one abl.dsp.distortion~ per side.
Abl.Distortion~.function: Distorts stereo audio like a tight, aggressive guitar pedal.

Abl.Doubler~.comments: Sibling of Abl.Flanger~ and Abl.Phaser~ (same Phaser-Flanger control set).
Abl.Doubler~.function: Thickens a stereo sound with a short modulated doubling delay.

Abl.DrumBuss~.comments: 19 presets taken from Live's Drum Buss. Best on drums or percussion groups. Audio in/out is one 2-channel MC cord; use mc.unpack~ 2 to reach plain MSP objects.
Abl.DrumBuss~.function: Processes a drum mix with drive, compression, transient shaping and tuned boom.

Abl.Echo~.builtin_alternative: tapin~ / tapout~ — plain delay line to build on.
Abl.Echo~.comments: Four panel pages (View); many parameters. Pick Abl.Delay~ for a cleaner, simpler delay.
Abl.Echo~.function: Echoes stereo audio with Live's Echo: dual delays, noise, wobble, reverb, ducking.

Abl.Ensemble~.comments: Richer sibling of Abl.Chorus~ and Abl.Vibrato~.
Abl.Ensemble~.function: Adds a lush multi-voice stereo ensemble chorus from Live's Chorus-Ensemble.

Abl.EnvFollower~.builtin_alternative: peakamp~ — reports peak level as numbers, not a shaped signal.
Abl.EnvFollower~.comments: Outputs are control signals meant for other ABL modules' modulation inlets, not audio.
Abl.EnvFollower~.function: Turns a stereo input's loudness into two 0–1 control signals.

Abl.Fade~.builtin_alternative: matrix~ — general routing matrix with ramped gains.
Abl.Fade~.comments: 5 inlets and 5 outlets. Its View parameter's stored labels read Compressor/Expander, a copy-paste leftover.
Abl.Fade~.function: Crossfades two stereo inputs and pans the result between two outputs.

Abl.Filther~.comments: Two mono objects inside, one per side. Dirtier sibling of Abl.DFM~.
Abl.Filther~.function: Filters stereo audio through a resonant lowpass with two distortion stages.

Abl.Flanger~.comments: Three panel pages. Shares its control set with Abl.Phaser~ and Abl.Doubler~.
Abl.Flanger~.function: Flanges stereo audio with Live's Phaser-Flanger, two LFOs and envelope.

Abl.Fuzz~.comments: Most extreme of the three pedal modules (see Abl.Distortion~, Abl.Overdrive~).
Abl.Fuzz~.function: Distorts stereo audio like a heavy, broken fuzz pedal.

Abl.Input~.builtin_alternative: playlist~ plus ezadc~ — the same pieces without the combined panel.
Abl.Input~.category: Audio I/O: hardware inputs, outputs & audio settings
Abl.Input~.comments: Only one modulation port. Inlet 0 audio passes through only while the module is inactive. Start playback with Play 1.
Abl.Input~.function: Plays sound files or live input as the stereo source of an ABL chain.

Abl.LFO~.builtin_alternative: phasor~ / cycle~ — build an LFO and scale it yourself.
Abl.LFO~.comments: 3 inlets, 5 outlets. Output is meant for ABL modulation inlets, which sample every 30 ms.
Abl.LFO~.function: Generates a stereo low-frequency oscillator as 0–1 control signals.

Abl.Limiter~.comments: Abl.Output~ already includes an optional limiter (Limiter 1). Audio in/out is one 2-channel MC cord; use mc.unpack~ 2 to reach plain MSP objects.
Abl.Limiter~.function: Limits a stereo signal's peaks with Live's mastering Limiter.

Abl.Matrix~.builtin_alternative: matrix~ — the same routing, set by messages instead of a grid.
Abl.Matrix~.comments: 5 inlets, 5 outlets. Dial mode lets you drag cells to set per-connection gain.
Abl.Matrix~.function: Routes and mixes four stereo inputs to four stereo outputs.

Abl.MeldFilter~.comments: Two mono objects inside. Macro1/Macro2 change meaning with the chosen filter type.
Abl.MeldFilter~.function: Filters stereo audio with any of the 14 filters from Live's Meld synth.

Abl.Mix~.builtin_alternative: mc.live.gain~ — multichannel level slider with meter, no pan.
Abl.Mix~.category: Audio I/O: gain, mixers & channel strips
Abl.Mix~.comments: Narrow panel (109 px). For width, mono or phase use Abl.Utility~.
Abl.Mix~.function: Sets gain, pan and mute for a stereo signal in an ABL rack.

Abl.ModScaler~.builtin_alternative: scale~ with rampsmooth~ — range and smoothing without the curve.
Abl.ModScaler~.comments: Only useful between ABL modulators and ABL modulation inlets.
Abl.ModScaler~.function: Rescales and smooths a 0–1 modulation signal before it drives a parameter.

Abl.ModalReson~.comments: Two mono objects inside, one per side. Separate left/right frequencies with Link.
Abl.ModalReson~.function: Makes stereo audio ring through a tuned plate or membrane resonator.

Abl.Output~.builtin_alternative: mc.dac~ with mc.live.gain~ — output and level without the panel.
Abl.Output~.category: Audio I/O: hardware inputs, outputs & audio settings
Abl.Output~.comments: Outlet 0 passes the input through before gain, for chaining. Includes a DSP on/off button (ezdac~).
Abl.Output~.function: Sends an ABL chain to chosen audio outputs with gain and optional limiter.

Abl.Overdrive~.builtin_alternative: overdrive~ — basic soft clipping, no tone controls.
Abl.Overdrive~.comments: Gentlest of the three pedal modules; a good first distortion to try.
Abl.Overdrive~.function: Distorts stereo audio like a warm, smooth overdrive pedal.

Abl.Phaser~.comments: Three panel pages. Shares its control set with Abl.Flanger~ and Abl.Doubler~.
Abl.Phaser~.function: Phases stereo audio with Live's Phaser-Flanger, up to 42 notches.

Abl.PitchShifter~.category: Audio effects: pitch shift & time stretch
Abl.PitchShifter~.comments: Longer Win (window) values suit low-pitched material.
Abl.PitchShifter~.function: Shifts the pitch of stereo audio up or down by up to two octaves.

Abl.Pitch~.builtin_alternative: fzero~ — fundamental frequency and pitch estimator.
Abl.Pitch~.comments: Monophonic input only. Outputs a float note only when confidence is high and the pitch changes.
Abl.Pitch~.function: Tracks a monophonic input's pitch and outputs it as a MIDI note number.

Abl.PlateReverb~.comments: Input is summed to mono, then spread to pseudo-stereo, so the stereo image is lost.
Abl.PlateReverb~.function: Adds a plate reverb using Live's Reverb device.

Abl.PrismReverb~.comments: One of six reverb modules; compare them in examples/Abl.Reverbs.maxpat.
Abl.PrismReverb~.function: Adds Hybrid Reverb's bright 'Prism' reverb with split low/high decay.

Abl.QuartzReverb~.comments: One of six reverb modules; compare them in examples/Abl.Reverbs.maxpat.
Abl.QuartzReverb~.function: Adds Hybrid Reverb's clear, dense 'Quartz' reverb.

Abl.Redux~.builtin_alternative: degrade~ — basic sample-rate and bit reducer.
Abl.Redux~.function: Crushes bits and reduces sample rate for lo-fi, aliased sound.

Abl.Remote~.builtin_alternative: send~ / receive~ — cordless signal routing without gain or pan.
Abl.Remote~.comments: Target names are global: every Remote~ with the same Target shares the bus. The Target field is a textedit.
Abl.Remote~.function: Sends or receives a stereo signal by name, without patch cords.

Abl.RingMod~.builtin_alternative: *~ with cycle~ — the basic ring-modulation patch.
Abl.RingMod~.function: Ring-modulates stereo audio, from tremolo to metallic tones.

Abl.Saturator~.comments: Oversampling and DC block on by default. Safer everyday colour than the pedal modules.
Abl.Saturator~.function: Warms or clips stereo audio with Live's waveshaping Saturator.

Abl.ShimmerReverb~.function: Adds Hybrid Reverb's pitch-shifted 'Shimmer' reverb for ambient tails.

Abl.SpectralReson~.comments: Many parameters over two pages; 23 presets.
Abl.SpectralReson~.function: Adds pitched spectral resonance so any sound rings at a chosen note.

Abl.SpectralTime~.comments: Three pages; Freeze and delay can run in either order (Order).
Abl.SpectralTime~.function: Freezes and delays stereo audio in the spectral domain.

Abl.Switch~.builtin_alternative: selector~ / gate~ — pick one input or output by number.
Abl.Switch~.comments: Routing is set on the panel; only View and Active are named parameters. View's stored labels read Compressor/Expander, a leftover.
Abl.Switch~.function: Switches two stereo inputs between two stereo outputs with short ramps.

Abl.TidesReverb~.comments: One of six reverb modules; compare them in examples/Abl.Reverbs.maxpat.
Abl.TidesReverb~.function: Adds Hybrid Reverb's 'Tides' reverb with a modulated, moving tail.

Abl.Transient~.comments: Two objects inside. One Shape control sets attack and sustain together.
Abl.Transient~.function: Makes drum hits snappier or softer with a one-knob transient designer.

Abl.Utility~.category: Audio I/O: gain, mixers & channel strips
Abl.Utility~.comments: Audio in/out is one 2-channel MC cord; use mc.unpack~ 2 to reach plain MSP objects.
Abl.Utility~.function: Adjusts gain, balance, width, mono, phase and bass-mono of stereo audio.

Abl.Vibrato~.function: Adds stereo pitch vibrato from Live's Chorus-Ensemble.

Abl.Vowel~.builtin_alternative: fffb~ — fixed bank of bandpass filters to tune by hand.
Abl.Vowel~.comments: Two mono objects inside. Sweep Morph for talking effects.
Abl.Vowel~.function: Filters stereo audio into vowel sounds A–E–I–O–U.

Abl.Waveshaper~.builtin_alternative: lookup~ — waveshaping through a buffer~ table you fill yourself.
Abl.Waveshaper~.comments: Many curve parameters; start from presets. Abl.Saturator~ is simpler.
Abl.Waveshaper~.function: Distorts stereo audio with a shapeable waveshaping curve.

flipflop~.comments: Period-by-period synthesis; frequencies come from signals or internal random numbers.
flipflop~.function: Makes sine waves one period at a time, alternating two parameter sets.

jeyhisto.comments: Pair with jeyrand to check a distribution.
jeyhisto.function: Builds a histogram of incoming numbers between 0 and 1.

jeyhistosliders.function: Shows jeyhisto's histogram in a resizable bpatcher with controls.

jeyhistosliders~.function: Shows jeyhisto~'s signal histogram in a resizable bpatcher with controls.

jeyhisto~.function: Builds a histogram of incoming signal samples between 0 and 1.

jeynoisesliders~.function: Draws frequency distributions for jeynoise~ in a resizable bpatcher.

jeynoise~.comments: Period-by-period synthesis. Values live in the 0 to 1 range. The sliders abstractions give a drawing interface for the PDF.
jeynoise~.function: Makes noise-like sine textures whose frequencies follow a drawn probability curve.

jeyrand.builtin_alternative: table (bang for a weighted random index)
jeyrand.comments: PDF given as a list; can interpolate between list points. Values live in the 0 to 1 range. The sliders abstractions give a drawing interface for the PDF.
jeyrand.function: Turns random numbers into ones that follow a probability curve you define.

jeyrandsliders.comments: The easiest way to use jeyrand.
jeyrandsliders.function: Draws the probability curve for jeyrand in a resizable bpatcher.

jeyrandsliders~.function: Draws the probability curve for jeyrand~ in a resizable bpatcher.

jeyrand~.comments: Values live in the 0 to 1 range. The sliders abstractions give a drawing interface for the PDF.
jeyrand~.function: Reshapes random signal values to follow a probability curve you define.

aoo.client.builtin_alternative: udpsend and udpreceive (messages only, no server, groups or NAT traversal)
aoo.client.comments: Does not stream audio itself. Once joined, aoo.send~ and aoo.receive~ on the same port address peers by group and user name. Help uses group_join <group> <pwd> <user> <pwd>; the refpage lists fewer arguments.
aoo.client.function: Connects to an aoo.server, joins groups, and exchanges messages with peers.

aoo.receive~.comments: Arguments: channels, port, id; one outlet per channel plus one unless @multichannel 1. latency <ms> trades delay for fewer dropouts. Works with Pd and SuperCollider AOO too.
aoo.receive~.function: Receives one or more audio streams over the network from aoo.send~.

aoo.send~.comments: Arguments: channels, port, id; one inlet per channel unless @multichannel 1. add <host> <port> <id> adds a receiver, then start. format opus compresses for slow links.
aoo.send~.function: Streams audio over the network to one or more aoo.receive~ objects.

aoo.server.comments: Only needed with aoo.client. Must be publicly reachable for internet use. relay 1 forwards data when peers cannot connect directly.
aoo.server.function: Hosts an AOO server so clients can find each other by group and name.

AudioEQ.builtin_alternative: filtergraph~ with cascade~ — graphical EQ, any band shape.
AudioEQ.comments: 2017 block for two-cord stereo; no MC. Name field is a textedit.
AudioEQ.function: Boosts or cuts low, mid and high bands of a two-cord stereo signal.

AudioInput.builtin_alternative: ezadc~ — input plus DSP button, no channel menu.
AudioInput.category: Audio I/O: hardware inputs, outputs & audio settings
AudioInput.function: Adds a chosen hardware input pair to a two-cord stereo channel strip.

AudioM4LEffect.builtin_alternative: mcs.amxd~ — hosts a device with one multichannel inlet and outlet.
AudioM4LEffect.category: Max for Live & DAW: plug-in & device hosting
AudioM4LEffect.comments: Drop a device onto it; E opens the editor, D unloads. Default device is SimpleGain from misc/.
crossref: Audio I/O: gain, mixers & channel strips
AudioM4LEffect.function: Hosts a Max for Live audio effect inside an AudioMix channel strip.

AudioMix.builtin_alternative: mc.live.gain~ — multichannel level with meter; add mc.mixdown~ for panning.
AudioMix.category: Audio I/O: gain, mixers & channel strips
AudioMix.comments: Solo groups set by @type. Remote name is <name>-mix. No MC; 2017 design.
AudioMix.function: Sets level, pan, solo and on/off for a two-cord stereo channel strip.

AudioOutput.builtin_alternative: mc.dac~ — multichannel output with a first-channel set message.
AudioOutput.category: Audio I/O: hardware inputs, outputs & audio settings
AudioOutput.comments: Passes audio on so a recorder can sit below it.
AudioOutput.function: Sends a two-cord stereo signal to a chosen hardware output pair.

AudioPlayer.builtin_alternative: playlist~ — drag-and-drop clips, more formats, multichannel.
AudioPlayer.comments: Only accepts AIFF and WAVE drops. Adds playback to audio arriving at its inlets.
AudioPlayer.function: Plays AIFF or WAVE files from a dropped file or folder in stereo.

AudioReceive.comments: Bus names AudioMix-<letter>-L~/-R~ are global across all open patches.
AudioReceive.function: Receives a lettered stereo bus and adds it to the channel strip.

AudioReceive2.comments: Variant of AudioReceive with a textedit name instead of letters.
AudioReceive2.function: Receives a stereo bus by typed name and adds it to the strip.

AudioRecord.builtin_alternative: sfrecord~ — records to disk with any sample type.
AudioRecord.comments: Choose a file first (save dialog), then record. Passes audio through.
AudioRecord.function: Records a two-cord stereo signal to a 24-bit WAVE file.

AudioSend.comments: Pairs with AudioReceive. Startup values can be box attributes: @bus 3 @gain -3.
AudioSend.function: Sends a copy of a stereo signal to a lettered bus A–Z.

AudioSend2.comments: Variant of AudioSend with a textedit name instead of letters.
AudioSend2.function: Sends a copy of a stereo signal to a bus with a typed name.

AudioVSTEffect.builtin_alternative: mcs.vst~ — hosts a plug-in with multichannel I/O.
AudioVSTEffect.category: Max for Live & DAW: plug-in & device hosting
AudioVSTEffect.comments: Stereo only (vst~ 2). Off state sends disable to the plug-in. Remote parameter messages use the plug-in's own names.
crossref: Audio I/O: gain, mixers & channel strips
AudioVSTEffect.function: Hosts a VST, VST3 or Audio Unit effect inside an AudioMix strip.

AudioXfaderIn.builtin_alternative: matrix~ — ramped gains between any inputs and outputs.
AudioXfaderIn.comments: 5 inlets (two stereo pairs plus messages), 3 outlets.
AudioXfaderIn.function: Crossfades two stereo sources into one output with constant power.

AudioXfaderOut.builtin_alternative: matrix~ — ramped gains between any inputs and outputs.
AudioXfaderOut.comments: 3 inlets, 5 outlets (two stereo pairs plus dumpout).
AudioXfaderOut.function: Crossfades one stereo source between two outputs with constant power.

az.granulate~.comments: Messages set ranges: durrange, amprange, panrange, trans, rate, winrange, trav. Send 1 to start. Argument: buffer~ name, output count.
az.granulate~.function: Granulates a sound in a buffer~ with randomized grain settings.

az.spectdelay~.comments: Lists set per-band delay (dt), feedback (fb) and EQ (eq). Mono.
az.spectdelay~.function: Delays and feeds back each frequency band by a different amount.

az.specteq~.comments: eq message takes a list of dB values; binmap groups bins. Mono.
az.specteq~.function: Sets the level of many frequency bands with one list, using an FFT.

az.strum~.comments: One inlet: a float plays a note; decay, squish and glide messages shape it. Mono, one note at a time.
az.strum~.function: Plays plucked-string notes with Karplus-Strong synthesis.

butter_keys.builtin_alternative: kslider — the plain keyboard, without sliders, tints, dots, pads or click reports.
butter_keys.comments: Max 9 only (v8ui script). @offset is the exact lowest note, unlike kslider. Colors are messages and are not saved with the patch. z_interp is stored but not used yet. Four outlets instead of two.
butter_keys.function: Shows a kslider-style keyboard that can also tint, mark, slide and report clicks.

2threshattack~.builtin_alternative: thresh~ — same two-threshold idea, outputs a gate
2threshattack~.comments: Thresholds multiply a reference level in the right inlet. Left outlet is a signal with a 1 at each attack; right outlet lists both amplitudes.
2threshattack~.function: Detects attacks with a high trigger level and a lower re-arm level.

SDIF-buffer.category: Buffers & offline: buffer data as lists & SDIF
SDIF-buffer.comments: Part of the SDIF chain (SDIF-buffer, SDIF-tuples); SDIF holds analysis data such as partials. Box text uses uppercase SDIF.
SDIF-buffer.function: Holds SDIF analysis data in memory under a name.

SDIF-fileinfo.category: Buffers & offline: buffer data as lists & SDIF
SDIF-fileinfo.comments: Part of the SDIF chain (SDIF-buffer, SDIF-tuples); SDIF holds analysis data such as partials. Box text uses uppercase SDIF.
SDIF-fileinfo.function: Reports the streams inside an SDIF file on disk.

SDIF-info.category: Buffers & offline: buffer data as lists & SDIF
SDIF-info.comments: Part of the SDIF chain (SDIF-buffer, SDIF-tuples); SDIF holds analysis data such as partials. Box text uses uppercase SDIF.

SDIF-listpoke.category: Buffers & offline: buffer data as lists & SDIF
SDIF-listpoke.comments: Part of the SDIF chain (SDIF-buffer, SDIF-tuples); SDIF holds analysis data such as partials. Box text uses uppercase SDIF.
SDIF-listpoke.function: Writes Max lists into an SDIF-buffer.

SDIF-ranges.category: Buffers & offline: buffer data as lists & SDIF
SDIF-ranges.comments: Part of the SDIF chain (SDIF-buffer, SDIF-tuples); SDIF holds analysis data such as partials. Box text uses uppercase SDIF.
SDIF-ranges.function: Reports each column's minimum and maximum in an SDIF-buffer.

SDIF-tuples.category: Buffers & offline: buffer data as lists & SDIF
SDIF-tuples.comments: Part of the SDIF chain (SDIF-buffer, SDIF-tuples); SDIF holds analysis data such as partials. Box text uses uppercase SDIF.
SDIF-tuples.function: Reads SDIF-buffer frames out as Max lists, with interpolation.

accumulate~.builtin_alternative: +=~ — reset by message instead of signal
accumulate~.comments: Has min, max, start, scale and mode attributes for bounded or wrapped totals.
accumulate~.function: Adds each input sample to a running total, reset by a signal.

bench.builtin_alternative: cpuclock — take two readings and subtract
bench.comments: Arguments must be in and out; connect the in object's right outlet to the out object's right inlet.
bench.function: Times how long a message chain takes, using a bench in / bench out pair.

bench~.comments: Arguments must be in and out; place one before and one after the chain.
bench~.function: Measures how long a signal chain takes to compute, using an in/out pair.

bpf.builtin_alternative: function — one curve per box (mc.function for several)
bpf.comments: Input an x value to get the function number and x/y pairs.
bpf.function: Breakpoint editor that holds several named curves in one box.

cambio~.builtin_alternative: change~ — outputs a signal showing direction of change
cambio~.comments: Help warns that long message chains after it can overflow the audio thread's stack.
cambio~.function: Outputs a message when a mostly steady signal changes value.

cnmatrix~.builtin_alternative: mcs.matrix~ — gains set by connect messages
cnmatrix~.comments: Rows are outputs, columns inputs. Modes: smooth (default), frame, fast.
cnmatrix~.function: Audio routing matrix whose gains come from a Jitter matrix or list.

decaying-sinusoids~.function: Bank of sine partials that decay exponentially, for bell-like tones.

deinterleave.category: Lists & data: get, insert & remove items
deinterleave.function: Splits one list into 2–4 lists by taking every Nth item.

gridpanel.function: Draws a grid of lines as a simple UI background or cell picker.

harmonics~.builtin_alternative: oscbank~ — any frequencies, set per oscillator
harmonics~.comments: Built-in triangle, sawtooth and square shapes; noisiness adds per-partial noise.
harmonics~.function: Bank of harmonic sine partials over one fundamental.

interleave.category: Lists & data: get, insert & remove items
interleave.function: Combines 2–4 lists into one by alternating their items.

lcm.comments: Handy for finding when two loops or polyrhythms line up again.
lcm.function: Finds the least common multiple of a set of integers.

list-interpolate.builtin_alternative: vexpr — write the crossfade formula yourself
list-interpolate.comments: Use zeropad 1 when lists differ in length.
list-interpolate.function: Crossfades between two lists, item by item.

migrator.comments: Outputs frequency/amplitude data for an oscillator bank such as sinusoids~.
migrator.function: Moves a set of partials step by step toward a target spectrum.

opensoundcontrol.builtin_alternative: udpreceive / udpsend — encode and decode OSC themselves
opensoundcontrol.comments: Deprecated per its refpage. Box text in the help file is OpenSoundControl.
opensoundcontrol.function: Old CNMAT converter between Max messages and OSC packets.

osc-route.comments: Deprecated per its refpage. Box text in the help file is OSC-route.
osc-route.function: Routes OSC messages by address and strips the matched part.

osc-schedule.comments: Deprecated per its refpage. Box text is OSC-schedule.
osc-schedule.function: Holds OSC bundles until the time in their timetag.

osc-timetag.comments: Deprecated per its refpage. Box text is OSC-timetag.

oscillators~.comments: Needs a buffer~ name as its first argument.
oscillators~.function: Bank of oscillators that all read one wavetable in a buffer~.

peqbank~.builtin_alternative: cascade~ with filtergraph~ — series biquads with a graphic editor
peqbank~.comments: Smoothed by default; send fast to save CPU.
peqbank~.function: Bank of parametric EQ bands and shelves, set by messages.

poly.bus~.comments: Must sit below poly.send~ in the DSP chain (help file).
poly.bus~.function: Receives audio from named poly.send~ objects, often inside poly~ voices.

poly.send~.function: Sends audio from inside a poly~ voice to a named poly.bus~.

printit.function: Prints everything about a message to the console, including types.

rbfi.comments: Help shows it recalling pattr presets by weight.
rbfi.function: 2D space where moving a cursor blends between named points.

res-transform.comments: Models are frequency, amplitude, decay triples. Right inlet queues changes; bang left to output.
res-transform.function: Shifts, scales and filters resonance models for resonators~.

resdisplay.function: Draws a resonance model as a frequency and amplitude graph.

resonators~.builtin_alternative: fffb~ — fixed bandpass bank, no decay model
resonators~.comments: Excite with audio or a float impulse; help notes inputs often need a big boost.
resonators~.function: Bank of resonant filters set by frequency, gain and decay lists.

roughness.comments: Works on partial lists or SDIF data, not on live audio.
roughness.function: Estimates the perceived roughness of a set of partials.

sinusoids~.builtin_alternative: oscbank~ — non-interpolating, set by signal inputs
sinusoids~.comments: bwe mode adds noise per partial.
sinusoids~.function: Bank of sine oscillators set by frequency and amplitude pairs.

slipOSC.comments: Sits after serial; uses FullPacket messages like the odot objects.
slipOSC.function: Encodes and decodes OSC over serial using SLIP framing.

sphY.category: Spatial audio: ambisonic encoding, decoding & binaural
sphY.comments: Math helper for ambisonics; it does not process audio.
sphY.function: Computes spherical harmonic values for a direction, up to an order.

thread.fork.comments: Help warns it will crash Max with objects that are not thread safe. Pair with thread.join.
thread.fork.function: Moves messages onto a separate thread.

thread.join.function: Moves messages back to Max's main scheduler thread.

thread.which.function: Reports which thread a message is on, then passes it on.

threefates.comments: Input is index, frequency, gain triples; output is frequency, gain pairs with a one-frame delay.
threefates.function: Handles partials starting and stopping between SDIF-tuples and sinusoids~.

trampoline.builtin_alternative: deferlow — also breaks the chain, via the low-priority queue
trampoline.function: Breaks deep message loops so they don't overflow the stack.

trend-report.comments: Outputs start value, end value, length and direction. The argument is a tolerance for small reversals.
trend-report.function: Reports each finished rising or falling run of numbers.

vsnapshot~.function: Outputs a whole signal vector as a list at a set interval.

waveguide~.comments: Define the mesh with connect and set messages; node and edge counts are fixed at creation. Send reset if it blows up.
waveguide~.function: Physical model built from a mesh of waveguide edges and nodes.

xydisplay.function: 2D path editor that outputs interpolated x/y points for a phase input.

CidLinkClient.comments: Send dicts to keep data types. Needs a CidLinkServer you host; the author's test server is for testing only.
CidLinkClient.function: Joins a CidLink server room to send and receive messages over the internet.

CidLinkServer.comments: Port set with an @ argument, e.g. CidLinkServer @7777. Internet use may need firewall or router setup.
CidLinkServer.function: Runs a room-based CidLink message server from inside Max.

CH-Chat.comments: A bpatcher module; needs CH-Client connected to the Collab-Hub internet server.
CH-Chat.function: Sends and shows chat messages to all users, one user, or a room.

CH-Client.comments: Use exactly one per patch. Built on Node for Max. Send messages like: publish all slider 5, or push all bang.
CH-Client.function: Connects Max to the Collab-Hub server to share data over the internet.

CH-Events.comments: Only needed when using publish mode. A bpatcher module; needs CH-Client connected to the Collab-Hub internet server.
CH-Events.function: Lists published events on the server and lets you observe them.

CH-Rooms.comments: A bpatcher module; needs CH-Client connected to the Collab-Hub internet server.
CH-Rooms.function: Creates, joins and leaves rooms of users on the server.

Collab-Hub Modules.comments: Opened from the Extras menu; not an object for use in patches.
Collab-Hub Modules.function: Opens a launcher patch showing all Collab-Hub modules.

ch.client-testing.comments: Developer tool. The file is ch.client-testing; no CH-ClientTesting name mapping ships.
ch.client-testing.function: Debugs the Node side of the Collab-Hub client module.

ch.controls.comments: Only for publish mode. The init mapping points CH-Controls at ch.control, but the file is ch.controls; type ch.controls if the name fails. A bpatcher module; needs CH-Client connected to the Collab-Hub internet server.
ch.controls.function: Lists published controls on the server and lets you observe them.

ch.timer.comments: Shows a web app hosted on the Collab-Hub server. No CH-Timer name mapping ships; the file is ch.timer.
ch.timer.function: Shows a shared start, stop and reset timer for all connected users.

jit.gp.emitter.comments: Needs jit.gp.world and jit.gp.render. type matrix emits from geometry (e.g. jit.gl.model matrix output); mode trigger emits on bang. The refpage's material attribute is disabled in the script.
jit.gp.emitter.function: Emits particles from a point or matrix into a jit.gp.world particle system.

jit.gp.force.comments: Part of the jit.gp.* system. type sets point_attractor, directional, drag or field. The refpage's materials attributes are disabled in the script.
jit.gp.force.function: Pushes GPU particles with an attractor, direction, drag or noise field.

jit.gp.obstacle.comments: Part of the jit.gp.* system; set shape and action.
jit.gp.obstacle.function: Adds a plane, sphere or box that particles bounce off, stick to or die on.

jit.gp.render.comments: Attributes: color, point_size. Has no help file; see jit.gp.world help.
jit.gp.render.function: Draws a jit.gp.world particle system as colored points.

jit.gp.world.builtin_alternative: jit.gen feeding jit.gl.mesh (matrix particles on the CPU; far fewer particles)
jit.gp.world.comments: Core of the jit.gp.* system; set count and drawto your jit.world. A v8 script built on jit.gpu.compute. Compute package 0.1.4 needs Max 9.1.3 or later.
jit.gp.world.function: Runs a GPU particle system with emitters, forces and obstacles.

jit.gpu.bang.comments: Use when a compute chain shares textures with a jit.world OpenGL context; drive the passes and jit.gpu.submit from it.
jit.gpu.bang.function: Bangs in step with jit.world's render loop to time GPU compute work.

jit.gpu.buffer.comments: Fill from a matrix or a dict (matched to the shader's block layout), or allocitems <count>. Connect to a jit.gpu.compute bind-point inlet.
jit.gpu.buffer.function: Holds arbitrary data in GPU memory for compute shaders.

jit.gpu.compute.builtin_alternative: jit.gl.pix or jit.gl.slab (per-pixel texture shaders, no general data buffers)
jit.gpu.compute.comments: Bang queues the pass; Queued work only runs when jit.gpu.submit is banged. Inlets appear per shader bind point. @autoworkgroups <image> sizes dispatch automatically. Uses Vulkan (MoltenVK on Mac). Early package, version 0.1.4.
jit.gpu.compute.function: Runs a GLSL compute shader on GPU images and buffers.

jit.gpu.image.builtin_alternative: jit.gl.texture (OpenGL texture, not usable by compute shaders directly)
jit.gpu.image.comments: Fill from a matrix or a jit.gl.texture, or size with dim for shader output. format is set automatically from an incoming matrix.
jit.gpu.image.function: Holds an image or texture in GPU memory for compute shaders.

jit.gpu.imageview.comments: Advanced. Its help notes jit.gpu.tomatrix can often read levels and layers directly without a view.
jit.gpu.imageview.function: Exposes chosen mip levels or array layers of a jit.gpu.image.

jit.gpu.submit.comments: Every compute patch needs one. Middle outlet bangs when the GPU finishes. Set gl_dependency 1 when results feed OpenGL objects.
jit.gpu.submit.function: Sends all queued GPU compute work to the GPU.

jit.gpu.tomatrix.builtin_alternative: jit.gl.asyncread (reads an OpenGL framebuffer to a matrix)
jit.gpu.tomatrix.comments: Bang queues the readback; the matrix comes out the middle outlet after jit.gpu.submit completes. Readback is slow; use jit.gpu.totexture for display.
jit.gpu.tomatrix.function: Reads a GPU image or buffer back into a Jitter matrix.

jit.gpu.totexture.comments: Shares GPU memory, so no slow CPU copy. Texture name leaves the middle outlet after submit; send it to jit.gl.videoplane. Flips vertically by default.
jit.gpu.totexture.function: Turns a GPU image into a jit.gl.texture for OpenGL drawing.

jit.gpu.transfers.comments: Advanced. Messages: copyimage, copybuffer, copyimagetobuffer, copybuffertoimage, blitimage, genmipmaps. Queued work only runs when jit.gpu.submit is banged.
jit.gpu.transfers.function: Queues copies between GPU images and buffers, and mipmap generation.

dk.avdog~.comments: Recreates the AVDog from the ciat-lonbarde Plumbutter. Accepts randomize, and its own dump output back in to recall a preset.
dk.avdog~.function: Makes throbbing pitched tones from a pinged, self-oscillating filter voice.

dk.boppad.category: Gesture & hardware: MIDI, grid & touch controllers
dk.boppad.comments: Only useful with a BopPad. Its XY output pairs with dk.gridmatch.
dk.boppad.function: Parses KMI BopPad input into notes, XY grid positions and pressure.

dk.buf2list.builtin_alternative: array.frombuffer (reads into an array object; then array.tolist)
dk.buf2list.category: Lists & data: bytes, encodings & buffer conversion
dk.buf2list.comments: Wraps fluid.buf2list; use that directly if you already work with FluCoMa.
crossref: Buffers & offline: buffer data as lists & SDIF
dk.buf2list.function: Copies the contents of a buffer~ into a Max list.

dk.classcontrollers~.comments: Needs a classifier trained with dk.classcreate or dk.clustercreate. Bundles dk.classmatch with onset detection and time-aligned triggers.
dk.classcontrollers~.function: Classifies each onset and outputs loudness and brightness meta-controls.

dk.classcorpusanalysis~.comments: Needs a classifier trained with dk.classcreate or dk.clustercreate. Bundles dk.classmatch with onset detection and time-aligned triggers.
dk.classcorpusanalysis~.function: Classifies each onset and outputs descriptors plus melbands for corpus matching.

dk.classcreate.comments: Wraps fluid.knnclassifier~ and fluid.mlpclassifier~ with fluid.dataset~ and fluid.labelset~. Training can be paused and resumed; write saves a file for dk.classmatch.
dk.classcreate.function: Trains a classifier from labeled examples of drum hits or other sounds.

dk.classdescriptors~.comments: Needs a classifier trained with dk.classcreate or dk.clustercreate. Bundles dk.classmatch with onset detection and time-aligned triggers.
dk.classdescriptors~.function: Classifies each onset and outputs loudness, brightness, flatness and pitch.

dk.classifierdisplay.comments: Adapts to dk.classmatch dump output, or can be preset with Sensory Percussion or custom labels.
dk.classifierdisplay.function: Shows which trained class was just matched as lit labels.

dk.classkitchensink~.comments: Needs a classifier trained with dk.classcreate or dk.clustercreate. Bundles dk.classmatch with onset detection and time-aligned triggers.
dk.classkitchensink~.function: Classifies each onset and outputs descriptors, melbands and MFCCs together.

dk.classmatch.comments: Wraps fluid.knnclassifier~ / fluid.mlpclassifier~ plus scaling. The dk.class*~ objects bundle it with onset analysis, which is usually easier.
dk.classmatch.function: Finds the nearest trained class for incoming descriptor data.

dk.classmelbands~.comments: Needs a classifier trained with dk.classcreate or dk.clustercreate. Bundles dk.classmatch with onset detection and time-aligned triggers.
dk.classmelbands~.function: Classifies each onset and outputs its 40 melbands.

dk.classmfccs~.comments: Needs a classifier trained with dk.classcreate or dk.clustercreate. Bundles dk.classmatch with onset detection and time-aligned triggers.
dk.classmfccs~.function: Classifies each onset and outputs its MFCCs.

dk.classsines~.comments: Needs a classifier trained with dk.classcreate or dk.clustercreate. Bundles dk.classmatch with onset detection and time-aligned triggers.
dk.classsines~.function: Classifies each onset and outputs its sinusoidal partials.

dk.classspectralshape~.comments: Needs a classifier trained with dk.classcreate or dk.clustercreate. Bundles dk.classmatch with onset detection and time-aligned triggers.
dk.classspectralshape~.function: Classifies each onset and outputs its spectral shape features.

dk.clustercreate.comments: Wraps fluid.kmeans~ and fluid.mlpclassifier~. The saved file loads into dk.classmatch like a trained classifier.
dk.clustercreate.function: Groups analyzed sounds into clusters, automatically or from seeded examples.

dk.concatanalysis~.comments: First stage of analysis, match, player. dk.concatsynth~ does all three in one.
dk.concatanalysis~.function: Analyzes live audio continuously with settings ready for dk.concatmatch.

dk.concatcreate.comments: Uses fluid.concataudiofiles and fluid.bufstats~. Its file is for dk.concatmatch / dk.concatsynth~, not dk.corpusmatch; loading the wrong type posts an error.
dk.concatcreate.function: Analyzes a sound file or folder into a corpus for real-time mosaicing.

dk.concatmatch.comments: Wraps fluid.kdtree~. Middle stage between dk.concatanalysis~ and dk.concatplayer~.
dk.concatmatch.function: Finds corpus grains that sound closest to incoming live descriptors.

dk.concatplayer~.comments: Playback stage of dk.concatsynth~; uses mc.voiceallocator~ and mc.play~ inside.
dk.concatplayer~.function: Plays short windowed grains from one large corpus buffer.

dk.concatsynth~.comments: Combines dk.concatanalysis~, dk.concatmatch and dk.concatplayer~. Build the corpus first with dk.concatcreate.
dk.concatsynth~.function: Mosaics live audio by replaying the closest-sounding grains from a corpus.

dk.controllermatch.comments: Loads dk.corpuscreate corpora and reduces them to one dimension with fluid.umap~ inside.
dk.controllermatch.function: Picks corpus samples from a single controller value instead of audio.

dk.controllerpitch.comments: Uses dk.quantizepitch inside. Handy for turning descriptor data into melodies.
dk.controllerpitch.function: Maps 0-1 values to pitches within a range, key and scale.

dk.controllers.comments: Takes dk.descriptors~ or dk.descriptorframe output; send calibrate to fit it to your input.
dk.controllers.function: Turns descriptor streams into smoothed loudness and brightness meta-controls.

dk.convolver~.comments: Uses the dk.multiconvolve~ external that ships with Data Knot (HISSTools-based), so no separate HISSTools install is needed.
dk.convolver~.function: Convolves audio with a loaded impulse response at zero latency.

dk.corpusanalysis~.category: Audio analysis: descriptor bundles & analysis frames
dk.corpusanalysis~.comments: Gives dk.corpusplayer~ what it needs for loudness and spectral compensation in one object.
dk.corpusanalysis~.function: Detects onsets and outputs descriptors plus melbands for corpus matching.

dk.corpusclustermatch.comments: Wraps fluid.kmeans~. Choose the cluster by index or a 0-1 float.
dk.corpusclustermatch.function: Splits a corpus into clusters and picks a random sample from one.

dk.corpusclustersampler~.function: Clusters a corpus and plays random samples from a chosen cluster.

dk.corpusconvolver~.comments: Has its own onset and descriptor analysis since v1.0; older patches that fed it dk.descriptors~ need rewiring.
dk.corpusconvolver~.function: Convolves live audio with the corpus sample that best matches each hit.

dk.corpuscreate.comments: Start of most Data Knot corpus work; the saved file loads into dk.corpusmatch, dk.corpussampler~, dk.gridmatch and friends.
dk.corpuscreate.function: Analyzes a sound file or folder into a corpus for one-shot sample matching.

dk.corpuslist.function: Displays the sample list inside a corpus.

dk.corpusmatch.comments: Wraps fluid.kdtree~ with scalers and a polybuffer~. Supports @filter queries, @matchcount chords and @roundrobin.
dk.corpusmatch.function: Finds the corpus sample that best matches each incoming analyzed hit.

dk.corpusplayer~.builtin_alternative: play~ (plain buffer playback, no compensation or voice handling)
dk.corpusplayer~.comments: Compensation needs descriptor and melband data from dk.corpusanalysis~.
dk.corpusplayer~.function: Plays matched corpus samples with optional loudness and spectral compensation.

dk.corpussampler~.comments: Combines dk.corpusanalysis~, dk.corpusmatch and dk.corpusplayer~. The quickest route to "hit a drum, hear a matching sample".
dk.corpussampler~.function: Plays the best-matching corpus sample for each live onset, all in one.

dk.crosstalk~.comments: Aimed at multi-mic drum and trigger setups.
dk.crosstalk~.function: Mutes other trigger channels briefly after one fires, reducing crosstalk.

dk.cvcontrollers~.comments: Needs a DC-coupled interface to receive CV.
dk.cvcontrollers~.function: Derives several related control signals from one control-voltage input.

dk.cvcross~.function: Splits a control voltage into slow-movement and fast-movement signals.

dk.cvgate~.function: Routes a control voltage to one of two outputs by onsets or direction.

dk.cvonset~.function: Detects onsets in a control-voltage signal and outputs triggers and gates.

dk.cvscatter~.function: Sends a control voltage to a different output channel on each onset.

dk.cvsmear~.function: Spreads a control voltage across multichannel outputs according to its value.

dk.databending.comments: Accepts and returns lists or buffers.
dk.databending.function: Glitches descriptor data with dropouts, jitter, scrambling and repeats.

dk.datadelay.comments: Accepts and returns lists or buffers.
dk.datadelay.function: Delays descriptor data like a lossy delay with feedback and rolloff.

dk.datagranular.function: Repeats and varies descriptor data like a granular synth.

dk.datalooper~.builtin_alternative: mtr (records and replays message tracks, no overdub)
dk.datalooper~.function: Records and loops descriptor data with play, overdub and speed controls.

dk.datatranspose.function: Shifts descriptor values such as pitch or loudness by set amounts.

dk.descriptorcurves.builtin_alternative: scale (one value at a time, no unit presets)
dk.descriptorcurves.function: Rescales and curves descriptor values, converting between units like dB and MIDI.

dk.descriptordisplay.function: Displays incoming descriptor data of any Data Knot type.

dk.descriptorframe.category: Audio analysis: descriptor bundles & analysis frames
dk.descriptorframe.comments: Frame version: feed it from dk.onsetframe~, dk.realtimeframe~ or dk.triggerframe~ so several analyses share one frame. Wraps fluid.buf* analysis objects.
dk.descriptorframe.function: Analyzes loudness, brightness, flatness and pitch of a supplied analysis frame.

dk.descriptorreplace.category: Lists & data: get, insert & remove items
dk.descriptorreplace.function: Replaces one of the four core descriptors inside a descriptor list.

dk.descriptorsrt~.category: Audio analysis: descriptor bundles & analysis frames
dk.descriptorsrt~.comments: Continuous version; the plain ~ version analyzes per onset instead.
dk.descriptorsrt~.function: Continuously analyzes loudness, brightness, flatness and pitch of live audio.

dk.descriptors~.category: Audio analysis: descriptor bundles & analysis frames
dk.descriptors~.comments: Uses very short windows tuned for drums. Output feeds dk.corpusmatch and dk.classmatch. The rt~ version runs continuously.
dk.descriptors~.function: Analyzes loudness, brightness, flatness and pitch of each detected onset.

dk.envelope~.builtin_alternative: abl.dsp.envfollower~ (basic follower, no gate or inverted output)
dk.envelope~.function: Follows a signal's amplitude, with gate, inverted and scaled outputs.

dk.eraetouch.category: Gesture & hardware: MIDI, grid & touch controllers
dk.eraetouch.comments: Only useful with an Erae Touch. Connects to dk.gridmatch.
dk.eraetouch.function: Connects the Erae Touch controller, handling zones, touches and LED feedback.

dk.filter.comments: Accepts filter messages like filter reset; the same syntax works in @filter on the corpus objects.
dk.filter.function: Routes descriptor messages to one of two outlets by value criteria.

dk.fourses~.comments: Accepts randomize, and its own dump output back in to recall a preset.
dk.fourses~.function: Generates chaotic, interlinked triangle waves modeled on the Fourses synth.

dk.gongue~.comments: Recreates the Gongue from the ciat-lonbarde Plumbutter. Accepts randomize, and its own dump output back in to recall a preset.
dk.gongue~.function: Makes ringing percussive tones from a pinged, self-oscillating filter.

dk.gridmatch.comments: Wraps fluid.umap~ and fluid.grid~ to lay the corpus out as a grid.
dk.gridmatch.function: Picks corpus samples from XY controller positions on a 2D map.

dk.gridscale.builtin_alternative: scale (one axis at a time, no deadzone or zoom)
dk.gridscale.comments: Designed to pair with dk.gridmatch. @xy was renamed @xyout in v1.0.
dk.gridscale.function: Scales, offsets and zooms XY controller input, with a deadzone.

dk.justfriends~.comments: Outputs a multichannel (MC) signal. Accepts randomize, and its own dump output back in to recall a preset.
dk.justfriends~.function: Generates harmonically related oscillators or LFOs modeled on Just Friends.

dk.karplus~.comments: The refpage description is copied from dk.triggercloud~ and is wrong; use the help file.
dk.karplus~.function: Plucks resonant string sounds with an extended Karplus-Strong model.

dk.kitchensinkrt~.category: Audio analysis: descriptor bundles & analysis frames
dk.kitchensinkrt~.comments: Continuous version; the plain ~ version analyzes per onset instead.
dk.kitchensinkrt~.function: Continuously outputs descriptors, melbands and MFCCs of live audio together.

dk.kitchensink~.category: Audio analysis: descriptor bundles & analysis frames
dk.kitchensink~.comments: Onset version: analyzes each detected hit. The rt~ version runs continuously; the frame version shares one analysis frame with other descriptor objects.
dk.kitchensink~.function: Outputs descriptors, melbands and MFCCs for each detected onset.

dk.list2buf.builtin_alternative: array.tobuffer (writes an array object to a buffer)
dk.list2buf.category: Lists & data: bytes, encodings & buffer conversion
crossref: Buffers & offline: buffer data as lists & SDIF
dk.list2buf.function: Copies a Max list into a buffer~.

dk.lpg~.function: Shapes audio with a vactrol-style low pass gate, fading volume and brightness together.

dk.mangrove~.comments: Accepts randomize, and its own dump output back in to recall a preset.
dk.mangrove~.function: Generates timbre-rich triangle-core tones modeled on the Mangrove oscillator.

dk.melbandfilter~.comments: Takes dk.melbands~ or dk.melbandsrt~ output as the curve.
dk.melbandfilter~.function: Filters audio with a spectral curve taken from melband analysis.

dk.melbandframe.comments: Frame version: feed it from dk.onsetframe~, dk.realtimeframe~ or dk.triggerframe~ so several analyses share one frame.
dk.melbandframe.function: Analyzes 40 melbands of a supplied analysis frame.

dk.melbandsrt~.comments: Continuous version; the plain ~ version analyzes per onset instead.
dk.melbandsrt~.function: Continuously analyzes 40 melbands of live audio.

dk.melbands~.comments: Onset version: analyzes each detected hit. The rt~ version runs continuously; the frame version shares one analysis frame with other descriptor objects.
dk.melbands~.function: Analyzes 40 melbands for each detected onset.

dk.metro~.comments: The refpage lists only @every; the abstraction also takes @glitch, @random, @weight and @active.
dk.metro~.function: Outputs clock bangs, triggers and a phasor, with glitch and random options.

dk.mfccframe.comments: Frame version: feed it from dk.onsetframe~, dk.realtimeframe~ or dk.triggerframe~ so several analyses share one frame.
dk.mfccframe.function: Analyzes 13 MFCCs of a supplied analysis frame.

dk.mfccrt~.comments: Continuous version; the plain ~ version analyzes per onset instead.
dk.mfccrt~.function: Continuously analyzes 13 MFCCs of live audio.

dk.mfcc~.comments: Onset version: analyzes each detected hit. The rt~ version runs continuously; the frame version shares one analysis frame with other descriptor objects.
dk.mfcc~.function: Analyzes 13 MFCCs for each detected onset.

dk.novelty~.comments: Wraps fluid.noveltyfeature~. Suits non-percussive material where amplitude onsets fail.
dk.novelty~.function: Detects changes in sound character and outputs bang, trigger and gate.

dk.onsetdisplay~.comments: Can stand in for dk.onset~ during setup and send its settings to other dk.onset~ objects.
dk.onsetdisplay~.function: Shows onset detection graphically while tuning its settings.

dk.onsetframe~.category: Audio analysis: descriptor bundles & analysis frames
dk.onsetframe~.comments: Feeds the dk.*frame analysis objects so their results line up exactly.
dk.onsetframe~.function: Detects onsets and records a frame that several analyses can share.

dk.onsetfreeze~.function: Freezes the sound at each onset with a zero-latency, spectral-style hold.

dk.onsettap~.function: Records individual onsets as taps and replays them in any order.

dk.onset~.comments: Wraps fluid.ampfeature~ with a gen~ detector. Sensitivity (0-100%) plus a dB floor are easy to tune. Needs FluCoMa installed.
dk.onset~.function: Detects amplitude onsets with low latency, outputting bang, trigger and gate.

dk.plotter.comments: Reduces data with fluid.umap~ or fluid.pca~ inside. Accepts an XY float pair to trigger the nearest item.
dk.plotter.function: Plots a corpus or trained classes as clickable 2D points.

dk.probability~.builtin_alternative: decide (random 0 or 1, not a pass-through filter)
dk.probability~.comments: Works on bangs, lists, buffers and trigger or gate signals; rejected events go to other outlets.
dk.probability~.function: Passes only some incoming events, by chance or by counting.

dk.quantizepitch.comments: Accepts numbers, descriptor lists or buffers.
dk.quantizepitch.function: Snaps pitch values to a chosen key and scale.

dk.quantizetime~.function: Delays events so they land on a local or global clock grid.

dk.quantussy~.comments: Accepts randomize, and its own dump output back in to recall a preset.
dk.quantussy~.function: Generates cross-modulating chaotic oscillators modeled on the Quantussy.

dk.ramp.function: Advances a ramp one step per incoming event, over a set event count.

dk.ramp~.builtin_alternative: line~ (ramps from messages, not signal triggers)
dk.ramp~.function: Starts sample-accurate ramps from incoming onsets.

dk.realtimeframe~.category: Audio analysis: descriptor bundles & analysis frames
dk.realtimeframe~.function: Records live audio and outputs a steady stream of frames to analyze.

dk.regressor.comments: Wraps fluid.mlpregressor~. Train the model with dk.regressorcreate~.
dk.regressor.function: Maps incoming data to synth parameters with a trained regression model.

dk.regressorcreate~.comments: Wraps fluid.mlpregressor~ and passes its training messages through.
dk.regressorcreate~.function: Trains a regression model linking descriptors or controls to synth parameters.

dk.resonatorscreate~.comments: Writes CNMAT-style frequency, gain and decay lists.
dk.resonatorscreate~.function: Analyzes a sound file into a resonance model for dk.resonators~.

dk.resonators~.builtin_alternative: mc.reson~ (resonant filter bank you configure by hand)
dk.resonators~.comments: Accepts randomize, and its own dump output back in to recall a preset.
dk.resonators~.function: Rings a bank of resonant filters from a loaded or preset model.

dk.rungler~.comments: Accepts randomize, and its own dump output back in to recall a preset.
dk.rungler~.function: Generates stepped chaotic waves modeled on Rob Hordijk's Rungler.

dk.sampler~.builtin_alternative: groove~ (one buffer, no voice handling or folder loading)
dk.sampler~.comments: Uses dk.corpusplayer~ and polybuffer~ inside; needs no corpus.
dk.sampler~.function: Plays samples from files or folders with voices, looping and pitch control.

dk.scatter~.comments: Outputs a multichannel (MC) signal. @ramp was renamed @ramptime in v1.0.
dk.scatter~.function: Sends audio to a different output channel on each detected onset.

dk.schmitt.comments: Like dk.filter, but with separate on and off thresholds.
dk.schmitt.function: Routes descriptor messages by thresholds with hysteresis to avoid flicker.

dk.scramble~.function: Scrambles multichannel audio across two stereo outputs on onsets.

dk.sequenceclock~.function: Plays stored rhythms with rest, skip and range masking.

dk.sequencedata~.function: Sequences notes, lists or buffers with rest, skip and range masking.

dk.setupcreate~.comments: Refpage root is mislabeled dk.clustertrain~. v1.0.1 changed its analysis, so older setups should be re-made.
dk.setupcreate~.function: Profiles your instrument's sounds so corpus matching fits them better.

dk.shaker~.comments: Accepts randomize, and its own dump output back in to recall a preset.
dk.shaker~.function: Models a maraca or shaker, also usable for hi-hat and snare sounds.

dk.shattercreate~.function: Learns spectral components of a sound for later splitting by dk.shatter~.

dk.shatter~.comments: Uses fluid.nmffilter~ with bases from dk.shattercreate~ or seeded in the object. Pair with dk.scramble~.
dk.shatter~.function: Splits live audio into learned spectral components on separate channels.

dk.sift~.function: Lets only some onsets through a noise-gate-style audio gate.

dk.sineframe.comments: Frame version: feed it from dk.onsetframe~, dk.realtimeframe~ or dk.triggerframe~ so several analyses share one frame.
dk.sineframe.function: Analyzes 32 sinusoidal partials of a supplied analysis frame.

dk.sinesrt~.comments: Continuous version; the plain ~ version analyzes per onset instead.
dk.sinesrt~.function: Continuously analyzes 32 sinusoidal partials of live audio.

dk.sines~.comments: Onset version: analyzes each detected hit. The rt~ version runs continuously; the frame version shares one analysis frame with other descriptor objects.
dk.sines~.function: Analyzes 32 sinusoidal partials for each detected onset.

dk.sinusoidplayer~.function: Resynthesizes analyzed partials with a bank of decaying sine oscillators.

dk.sinusoids~.function: Analyzes each onset into partials and resynthesizes them as sines.

dk.slicecurve.comments: Refpage description ends with garbled copied text.
dk.slicecurve.function: Converts indices or MIDI notes into even or uneven 0-1 slices.

dk.smear~.comments: Uses dk.envelope~ inside; outputs a multichannel (MC) signal.
dk.smear~.function: Spreads audio across multichannel outputs according to its loudness.

dk.snare~.comments: Accepts randomize, and its own dump output back in to recall a preset.
dk.snare~.function: Generates snare noise plus modulation outputs, modeled on Plumbutter and Dunst.

dk.spectralonset~.comments: Catches pitched or soft attacks that amplitude-based dk.onset~ can miss.
dk.spectralonset~.function: Detects onsets from spectral change, outputting bang and trigger.

dk.spectralshapefilter~.function: Filters audio with a curve derived from spectral shape analysis.

dk.spectralshapeframe.comments: Frame version: feed it from dk.onsetframe~, dk.realtimeframe~ or dk.triggerframe~ so several analyses share one frame.
dk.spectralshapeframe.function: Analyzes nine spectral shape features of a supplied analysis frame.

dk.spectralshapert~.comments: Continuous version; the plain ~ version analyzes per onset instead.
dk.spectralshapert~.function: Continuously analyzes nine spectral shape features of live audio.

dk.spectralshape~.comments: Onset version: analyzes each detected hit. The rt~ version runs continuously; the frame version shares one analysis frame with other descriptor objects.
dk.spectralshape~.function: Analyzes nine spectral shape features for each detected onset.

dk.speed.category: Rhythm & time: delays, gates & bang logic
dk.speed.function: Derives speed and timing controls from the time between onsets.

dk.transientextract~.comments: Pick the method with @extractmode (default hpss; sines added in v1.0.1).
dk.transientextract~.function: Separates transients from audio by transient, HPSS or sinusoidal methods.

dk.transientreplace~.function: Replaces drum transients with samples or other live audio.

dk.triggeralign~.function: Delays triggers so they line up with slower analysis or query results.

dk.triggerbounce~.function: Outputs bouncing-ball patterns of triggers after each input.

dk.triggercloud~.function: Outputs a random flurry of triggers after each input.

dk.triggerdelay~.category: Rhythm & time: delays, gates & bang logic
dk.triggerdelay~.comments: The refpage lists @activity and @rate by mistake; the abstraction uses @delay and @feedback.
dk.triggerdelay~.function: Repeats each trigger as delayed echoes with feedback.

dk.triggerframe~.category: Audio analysis: descriptor bundles & analysis frames
dk.triggerframe~.comments: Use when analysis should follow something other than onset detection.
dk.triggerframe~.function: Records audio frames for analysis whenever another process sends a trigger.

dk.triggerlength~.category: Rhythm & time: delays, gates & bang logic
dk.triggerlength~.function: Lengthens short trigger or gate signals.

dk.triggershape~.function: Turns triggers or gates into attack-hold-release envelopes.

dk.ultrasound~.comments: Accepts randomize, and its own dump output back in to recall a preset.
dk.ultrasound~.function: Filters audio through an aliasing switched-capacitor model from the Plumbutter.

dk.waveguidemesh~.comments: Accepts randomize, and its own dump output back in to recall a preset.
dk.waveguidemesh~.function: Models a vibrating drum membrane with a waveguide mesh.

dk.waveguidesnare~.comments: Accepts randomize, and its own dump output back in to recall a preset.
dk.waveguidesnare~.function: Models a snare drum with rattle, tuning and damping controls.

dot.aggregate.builtin_alternative: accum — also keeps a running sum, numbers only
dot.aggregate.comments: Middle inlet adds without output; right inlet sets the total.
dot.aggregate.function: Adds up a stream of numbers or lists into a running total.

dot.aggregate.leaky.comments: Leak shape is an expr formula (@expression), with @min/@max limits. Good for turning bursts of movement into a slowly fading 'energy' value.
dot.aggregate.leaky.function: Integrates incoming values while a leak pulls the total back to rest.

dot.aggregate.sliding.comments: Window size is set in samples (number of inputs), not time.
dot.aggregate.sliding.function: Sums the last N values of a stream.

dot.aggregate.timed.comments: Refpage says window is in samples; the help patch says milliseconds, which matches the name.
dot.aggregate.timed.function: Sums the values received during the last stretch of time.

dot.am.demodulate.asynchronous~.comments: For sensors that send data as amplitude-modulated tones through an audio interface. Set freq, phase and bandwidth.
dot.am.demodulate.asynchronous~.function: Recovers a slow control signal carried on an audio-rate AM carrier.

dot.autoscale.builtin_alternative: scale — fixed input range; no automatic calibration
dot.autoscale.comments: Self-calibrating sensor input: the range widens as new extremes arrive. One spike stretches the range until reset with input-low/input-high, so denoise first.
dot.autoscale.function: Rescales a stream to an output range using the minimum and maximum seen.

dot.autoscale.exponential.comments: Adapts to drift over time, unlike dot.autoscale.
dot.autoscale.exponential.function: Rescales a stream using its exponential moving mean and deviation.

dot.autoscale.sliding.comments: Refpage text is copied from the exponential version.
dot.autoscale.sliding.function: Rescales a stream using mean and deviation over the last N samples.

dot.autoscale.timed.function: Rescales a stream using mean and deviation over a time window.

dot.autoscale~.builtin_alternative: normalize~ — scales by peak amplitude only, no output range
dot.autoscale~.comments: Send reset to re-learn the input range; lock freezes it.
dot.autoscale~.function: Scales an audio-rate signal automatically into a chosen output range.

dot.biquad.comments: Set the data rate with samplerate so cutoff in Hz means something. Low-level: supply coefficients or use the lowpass/highpass versions.
dot.biquad.function: Filters a control-data stream with a two-pole, two-zero filter.

dot.biquad.highpass.comments: Set samplerate to the data rate (e.g. 100 Hz sensor), then cutoff frequency and Q.
dot.biquad.highpass.function: Removes slow drift from a control-data stream with a highpass filter.

dot.biquad.lowpass.builtin_alternative: slide — simpler one-pole smoothing, no cutoff in Hz
dot.biquad.lowpass.comments: Set samplerate to the data rate, then cutoff frequency and Q.
dot.biquad.lowpass.function: Smooths a control-data stream with a resonant lowpass filter.

dot.bitstobyte.comments: Left inlet is bit 7 (most significant) or a list of 8 bits.
crossref: Lists & data: bytes, encodings & buffer conversion
dot.bitstobyte.function: Combines eight bits into one byte value.

dot.bound.builtin_alternative: pong — clip, fold or wrap between two bounds
dot.bound.comments: Each end can use a different mode, e.g. @min none @max clamp 34.6.
dot.bound.function: Mutes, clamps, wraps or folds numbers that leave a min/max range.

dot.bytestoint.comments: Useful when parsing multi-byte sensor values from serial data.
crossref: Lists & data: bytes, encodings & buffer conversion
dot.bytestoint.function: Reads a list of bytes as one signed (two's complement) integer.

crossref: Lists & data: bytes, encodings & buffer conversion
dot.bytetobits.function: Splits a byte into eight separate bit values.

dot.change.category: Lists & data: change detection, matching & routing
dot.change.comments: Right inlet sets the comparison value without output.
dot.change.function: Filters out repeated numbers, symbols or lists.

dot.coll.comments: Link to an existing coll by name (first argument); send find <value> to get matching indexes and content.
dot.coll.function: Stores data like coll and finds records by their content.

dot.constrain.builtin_alternative: clip — same job for finite bounds
dot.constrain.comments: Its refpage digest wrongly says 'Retrieve indexes of coll data entries'. The help patch shows clamping, e.g. dot.constrain 0 inf.
dot.constrain.function: Clamps numbers to a min/max range that may be infinite.

dot.correlation.exponential.comments: Output near 1 means the streams rise and fall together. Works on control data, e.g. two sensor axes.
dot.correlation.exponential.function: Measures how closely two streams move together, weighting recent values more.

dot.correlation.sliding.comments: Window size is set in samples (number of inputs), not time.
dot.correlation.sliding.function: Measures how closely two streams move together over the last N samples.

dot.covariance.exponential.comments: Mostly a building block for dot.correlation.exponential.
dot.covariance.exponential.function: Computes the covariance of two streams using exponential moving means.

dot.covariance.sliding.comments: Mostly a building block for dot.correlation.sliding.
dot.covariance.sliding.function: Computes the covariance of two streams over the last N samples.

dot.denoise.exponential.builtin_alternative: slide — smooths but lets spikes through
dot.denoise.exponential.comments: Good first stage for glitchy sensors. Rejects values far from the running mean, measured in deviations.
dot.denoise.exponential.function: Smooths a stream while ignoring outlier spikes.

dot.denoise.sliding.comments: Window size is set in samples (number of inputs), not time.
dot.denoise.sliding.function: Averages the last N samples while ignoring outlier spikes.

dot.denoise.timed.comments: Window size is set in milliseconds.
dot.denoise.timed.function: Averages values over a time window while ignoring outlier spikes.

dot.deviation.exponential.comments: A quick measure of how much a gesture is moving.
dot.deviation.exponential.function: Tracks how much a stream varies, using an exponential moving deviation.

dot.deviation.sliding.comments: @Bessel toggles the n-1 correction. Window size is set in samples (number of inputs), not time.
dot.deviation.sliding.function: Computes the standard deviation of the last N samples.

dot.deviation.timed.comments: Window size is set in milliseconds.
dot.deviation.timed.function: Computes the standard deviation over a time window.

dot.device.wiimotionplus.comments: Only for the old Nintendo Wii MotionPlus add-on; you must get its raw bytes into Max yourself.
dot.device.wiimotionplus.function: Decodes Wii MotionPlus gyro bytes and removes gyro bias.

dot.entropy.wiener.comments: Feed it the output of dot.powerspectrum.sliding. Near 1 = noisy, near 0 = tonal.
dot.entropy.wiener.function: Computes spectral flatness (Wiener entropy) from a power spectrum list.

dot.envelope.exponential.builtin_alternative: slide — separate up and down smoothing
dot.envelope.exponential.function: Follows the envelope of a data stream with separate rise and fall speeds.

dot.expression.comments: Also has built-in scaling modes. Commas in the formula need a backslash. List items are addressed as x1, x2.
dot.expression.function: Applies a typed formula like y=x*2 to each incoming value.

dot.extrema.builtin_alternative: peak — highest so far; trough is its low twin
dot.extrema.comments: Send low/high to reset the stored extremes.
dot.extrema.function: Outputs the lowest and highest values seen so far.

dot.extrema.local.comments: Handy for finding the turning points of a swinging gesture.
dot.extrema.local.function: Reports each local peak and valley as a stream turns around.

dot.extrema.sliding.comments: Window size is set in samples (number of inputs), not time.
dot.extrema.sliding.function: Outputs min, max and their difference over the last N samples.

dot.extrema.timed.comments: Window size is set in milliseconds.
dot.extrema.timed.function: Outputs min, max and their difference over a time window.

dot.float.comments: Messages pi, -pi, tau, -tau, e, -e, inf, -inf, nan set the value.
dot.float.function: Stores a float and also accepts named constants like pi, e and inf.

dot.float.e.function: Outputs Euler's number e when banged.

dot.float.inf.comments: Mainly used inside other DOT tools as an open-ended bound.
dot.float.inf.function: Outputs positive or negative infinity when banged.

dot.float.nan.comments: For testing patches that must survive bad values.
dot.float.nan.function: Outputs a NaN (not-a-number) float when banged.

dot.float.pi.comments: Argument can set the sign or a multiplier.

dot.float.sanitize.comments: Bad values go out the right outlet. Useful after division or sensor parsing.
dot.float.sanitize.function: Filters NaN and infinite values out of a float stream.

dot.frequency.instantaneous~.comments: @unit and @average control output. Best on clean single-tone signals.
dot.frequency.instantaneous~.function: Estimates a signal's instantaneous frequency from its phase changes.

dot.fromsignal~.builtin_alternative: snapshot~ — samples at a fixed interval instead
dot.fromsignal~.function: Converts a signal to messages only when its value changes.

dot.gate.comments: Right inlet takes a 0–1 probability, optionally with a ramp time in ms.
dot.gate.function: Passes each message through with a set probability.

dot.gesture.jab.comments: Tune window size, denoise threshold and debounce decay for your sensor.
dot.gesture.jab.function: Detects quick jabbing movements in accelerometer data.

dot.integer.range.comments: Depends on whether Max runs 32- or 64-bit.
dot.integer.range.function: Reports the smallest and largest integer Max can hold.

dot.interpolate.4~.comments: Separate XY controls for magnitude and phase. Arguments set FFT size, overlap and window types.
dot.interpolate.4~.function: Morphs four audio signals by mixing their spectra from an XY position.

dot.io.filein.builtin_alternative: text — reads text files but strips quotation marks
dot.io.filein.function: Reads a text file with filein and dumps it line by line.

dot.io.serial.builtin_alternative: serial — same port access without the menu and polling helpers
dot.io.serial.comments: Handy starting point for Arduino-style sensors. Pair with dot.slip.decode when the device sends SLIP frames.
dot.io.serial.function: Wraps serial with a port menu, polling and repeated reading.

dot.line.builtin_alternative: line — one target and time per message
dot.line.function: Ramps numbers like line but accepts multi-segment lists like line~.

dot.list.matchnth.category: Lists & data: change detection, matching & routing
dot.list.matchnth.function: Routes lists by whether the item at index n matches a value.

dot.list.nth.category: Lists & data: get, insert & remove items
dot.list.nth.comments: Right outlet gives the list with those items removed.
dot.list.nth.function: Pulls several items out of a list by their indexes.

dot.list.swap.category: Lists & data: sorting, shuffling & set operations
dot.list.swap.function: Swaps the order of two inputs, including symbols and lists.

dot.log.play.builtin_alternative: mtr — records and replays messages, no file timestamps
dot.log.play.comments: Link to a recorder with refer. Left inlet takes speed and play/stop.
dot.log.play.function: Plays back data files recorded by dot.log.record with original timing.

dot.log.record.builtin_alternative: mtr — records and replays messages in time
dot.log.record.comments: Good for capturing a sensor performance to test mappings without the hardware. Prepend annotation to log notes.
dot.log.record.function: Records many data streams with timestamps for later playback.

dot.maximum.function: Outputs the larger of two numbers, allowing infinite bounds.

dot.mean.comments: Right inlet sets the value. Third outlet counts samples.
dot.mean.function: Averages all values received since the last reset.

dot.mean.exponential.comments: Set smoothing by @weight, @decay or @halflife (in samples). Core smoothing tool of the package.
dot.mean.exponential.function: Smooths a stream with an exponential moving average.

dot.mean.sliding.comments: Window size is set in samples (number of inputs), not time.
dot.mean.sliding.function: Averages the last N values of a stream (moving average).

dot.mean.timed.comments: Window size is set in milliseconds. Each sample has equal weight.
dot.mean.timed.function: Averages the values received during a time window.

dot.median.sliding.builtin_alternative: zl.median — median of a list, not a running stream
dot.median.sliding.comments: Window size is set in samples (number of inputs), not time.
dot.median.sliding.function: Outputs the median of the last N values to remove spikes.

dot.median.timed.comments: Window size is set in milliseconds.
dot.median.timed.function: Outputs the median of values received during a time window.

dot.midi.out.builtin_alternative: ctlout — sends CC without auto-scaling or a device menu
dot.midi.out.comments: Modes: control, velocity, note. Scaling learns the input range; reset recalibrates. Designed as a bpatcher with its own menus.
dot.midi.out.function: Sends a data stream as MIDI CC or notes, auto-scaled to 0–127.

dot.midi.pedal~.comments: Argument is the audio input channel; @sensitivity and @windowsize tune detection. Outputs pedal state and a toggle.
dot.midi.pedal~.function: Detects a pedal or footswitch plugged into an audio input.

dot.minimum.function: Outputs the smaller of two numbers, allowing infinite bounds.

dot.mix.4~.category: Audio I/O: gain, mixers & channel strips
dot.mix.4~.function: Mixes four audio signals from one XY position.

dot.osc.address.append.function: Appends text to the end of an OSC address.

dot.osc.address.compress.function: Removes spaces from OSC address strings.

dot.osc.address.expand.function: Splits an OSC address at slashes so route can parse it.

dot.osc.address.prepend.function: Prepends text to the start of an OSC address.

dot.osc.alias.comments: Decode on the other side with dot.osc.unalias. Sends alias keyframes periodically.
dot.osc.alias.function: Shortens long OSC addresses into numbered aliases to save bandwidth.

dot.osc.route.builtin_alternative: route — fixed address list set by arguments
dot.osc.route.function: Routes OSC messages by addresses you can add or remove at runtime.

dot.osc.unalias.function: Restores full OSC addresses from dot.osc.alias output.

dot.period~.function: Converts a frequency in Hz to period in seconds or samples.

dot.pid.comments: Arguments set P, I and D gains, e.g. dot.pid 0.1 0.1 0.1 @feedback 1. Outputs control value and error.
dot.pid.function: Runs a PID controller that steers a value toward a target.

dot.polar.shortestpath.comments: Use for rotation sensors whose angle jumps from 360 back to 0.
dot.polar.shortestpath.function: Outputs the shortest angular step from the last value, across wraparound.

dot.powerspectrum.sliding.comments: For analyzing rhythm or tremor in sensor data, not audio.
dot.powerspectrum.sliding.function: Computes the power spectrum of a control-data stream over a window.

dot.properties.category: Patching utilities: abstraction arguments & shared code
dot.properties.function: Parses @label value pairs out of a message.

dot.quaternion.builtin_alternative: jit.euler2quat — converts Euler angles to a quaternion
dot.quaternion.comments: Quaternion lists are [w x y z]. Jitter's quaternions are ordered x y z w, so reorder when mixing them.
dot.quaternion.function: Converts three rotation angles into a quaternion.

dot.quaternion.angle.function: Computes the angle between two quaternions.

dot.quaternion.axisangle.comments: Type dot.quaternion.axisangle (lowercase a), as the file and help patch name it.
dot.quaternion.axisangle.function: Converts a quaternion to axis-angle form.

dot.quaternion.conjugate.function: Computes the conjugate of a quaternion.

dot.quaternion.euler.function: Converts a quaternion to Euler angles.

dot.quaternion.inverse.function: Computes the inverse of a quaternion.

dot.quaternion.jit.comments: Matrix versions process many orientations at once.
dot.quaternion.jit.function: Converts rotation-angle matrices into quaternion matrices.

dot.quaternion.jit.angle.function: Computes angles between two matrices of quaternions.

dot.quaternion.jit.conjugate.function: Computes conjugates for a matrix of quaternions.

dot.quaternion.jit.inverse.function: Computes inverses for a matrix of quaternions.

dot.quaternion.jit.line.function: Ramps smoothly between quaternion matrices over time.

dot.quaternion.jit.rotate.comments: Refpage inlets and messages are copied from dot.am.demodulate.asynchronous~. Left inlet: geometry matrix; right: quaternion.
dot.quaternion.jit.rotate.function: Rotates a Jitter geometry matrix by quaternions.

dot.quaternion.jit.shortestpath.function: Removes needless long rotations from a stream of quaternion matrices.

dot.quaternion.jit.slerp.function: Interpolates smoothly between two quaternion matrices.

dot.quaternion.jit.vis.comments: A bpatcher display for checking orientation data.
dot.quaternion.jit.vis.function: Shows the effect of quaternion rotations on a 3D shape.

dot.quaternion.line.comments: Gives glitch-free rotation animation from orientation sensors. @shortest avoids long-way-round rotations.
dot.quaternion.line.function: Ramps smoothly from one quaternion to another over time.

dot.quaternion.multiply.builtin_alternative: jit.quat — quaternion multiplication, x y z w order
dot.quaternion.multiply.function: Multiplies two quaternions to combine rotations.

dot.quaternion.normalize.function: Normalizes a quaternion to unit length.

dot.quaternion.shortestpath.function: Flips quaternions in a stream to avoid long-way-round rotations.

dot.quaternion.slerp.comments: The standard way to blend two orientations. Ratio 0–1 in the right inlet.

dot.radians.normalize~.function: Scales a radian signal to 0–1, with optional wraparound.

dot.reg.builtin_alternative: zl.reg — stores and outputs a list
dot.reg.function: Stores a message and bangs its right outlet when empty.

dot.repeat.function: Outputs a message a set number of times.

dot.round.comments: Separate up and down hysteresis inlets. Stops a noisy sensor from jumping between two whole numbers.
dot.round.function: Rounds floats to integers with hysteresis to stop flicker.

dot.route.signal~.function: Separates signal connections from message input.

dot.route.type.builtin_alternative: typeroute~ — routes by data type, including signals
dot.route.type.comments: Outlets: signal, bang, int, float, list, symbol, vector, jitter.
dot.route.type.function: Routes input to outlets by data type.

dot.scale~.function: Maps a signal from one range to another with an exponent.

dot.schmitt.builtin_alternative: past — triggers above a threshold, rearmed by a clear message
dot.schmitt.comments: The hysteresis gap prevents repeated triggers from a noisy sensor near the threshold.
