imi.fullscreen.comments: Abstraction; arguments: x, y, width, height. Also hides the cursor and menu bar.
imi.fullscreen.function: Positions a jit.window and toggles fullscreen with Escape.

imi.looptheloop.comments: Abstraction for jit.movie. Supports normal and palindrome loops. Its help uses the old jit.qt.movie.
imi.looptheloop.function: Sets movie loop points by frame, jumping now or at loop end.

imi.matrix2cell.function: Displays a matrix's values in a jit.cellblock.

imi.matrixinfo.function: Outputs a matrix's planecount, type and dimensions from separate outlets.

imi.matrixset.comments: Abstraction; argument sets how many matrices.
imi.matrixset.function: Records and plays back a set of 1-plane matrices.

imi.mgra.comments: Abstraction; needs imi.wh_to_center from this package.
imi.mgra.function: Converts x, y, width, height into jit.mgraphics shape messages, from center or corner.

imi.minus.comments: Abstraction; a right-inlet value also outputs the result.
imi.minus.function: Subtracts, with both inlets triggering output.

imi.movieloader.comments: Abstraction; reads a coll named IMIMovies.
imi.movieloader.function: Loads a movie or sound by index from a coll file list.

imi.oneint.function: Passes one number, then blocks until reopened.

imi.past.comments: Abstraction; argument sets the threshold. A second outlet reports falling back below.
imi.past.function: Bangs once when a value rises past a threshold.

imi.plus.comments: Abstraction; a right-inlet value also outputs the result.
imi.plus.function: Adds, with both inlets triggering output.

imi.pushcount.comments: Abstraction; threshold and delay (help example 120 and 2000 ms) set from inlets.
imi.pushcount.function: Bangs after a delay once a value passes a threshold.

imi.seqbang.category: Rhythm & time: delays, gates & bang logic

imi.slide.function: Smooths changes in a matrix over time.

imi.splitscale.comments: Abstraction. Arguments: center, range, output low, output high. Part of the range is hard-coded to 450-550.
imi.splitscale.function: Maps values above and below a center point to two output ranges.

imi.through.function: Wraps a moving number around between 0 and a limit.

iterate.comments: Abstraction; rewrites its internal expr box by scripting when the method changes.
iterate.function: Repeats a typed math expression on a number a set number of times.

max_messaging.comments: A demo patch, not an object.
max_messaging.function: Shows building messages with pack, sprintf, zl, coll, text and dict.

maxuino.comments: Type the abstraction as maxuino with a serial port argument; its help file is maxuin.maxhelp. Upload StandardFirmata to the board first. Also includes a Max for Live device version.
maxuino.function: Controls an Arduino running StandardFirmata from Max (Maxuino).

messenger.comments: Abstraction; arguments: port letter, baud rate. Needs the matching Arduino sketch; the Messenger library is old.
messenger.function: Reads and writes Arduino pins over serial using the Messenger library.

mmf-fs.core.category: Gesture & hardware: MIDI, grid & touch controllers
mmf-fs.core.comments: The loadable abstraction is mmf-fs.core; keep it open or place it in a bpatcher. It talks by send and receive, not cords. Needs the Fantastick app and a local web server for images.
mmf-fs.core.function: Receives multitouch data from the Fantastick iOS app (Max Multitouch Framework).

nothing-detector.comments: Abstraction by Mattyo; argument sets the timeout in ms. Outputs 1 while values change.
nothing-detector.function: Outputs 0 when incoming values stop changing for a set time.

o.list.crossover.comments: Abstraction. @mix sets how much comes from each parent; @mutation adds random changes; @points sets crossover points. Works with numbers and symbols.
o.list.crossover.function: Breeds a new list from two parent lists, with mutation (genetic algorithm).

o.midi.prob-rhythm.comments: Abstraction. Weights come from a multislider list (0-1). Also sets overall probability, max velocity and seed. Drive it with a counter or metro.
o.midi.prob-rhythm.function: Plays rhythm steps by probability from a table of step weights.

o.num2list.comments: Abstraction; argument sets list length (default 32). Works with symbols too.
o.num2list.function: Repeats an incoming value N times as a list.

past2.comments: Abstraction; same as imi.past with float boxes.
past2.function: Bangs once when a float value rises past a threshold.

randomness.builtin_alternative: table (bang outputs a weighted random index)
randomness.comments: Abstraction by digiology. Left: bang; middle: list of values; right: list of percentages. Its help file is an index of random, Markov and flocking demos.
randomness.function: Outputs random values weighted by a list of probabilities.

shell2UTCtime.category: Patching utilities: Max app, system & date
shell2UTCtime.comments: Abstraction by Italo Lombardo. Its help gets the timestamp from the third-party shell external.
shell2UTCtime.function: Converts a Unix timestamp into a readable GMT date and time.

textcoordmagic.comments: Abstraction by Wes Smith; sends tex_plane_s and tex_plane_t to a GL object with tex_map 1. Arguments set zoom, anchor and angle.
textcoordmagic.function: Zooms, rotates and positions a texture on a 3D shape by texture coordinates.

threshold~.comments: Abstraction, a port of Pd's threshold~. Separate debounce times in ms for each direction.
threshold~.function: Bangs when a signal rises above one level and falls below another.

tweening.comments: Demo patch using js tween.js from this package.
tweening.function: Shows easing between two values with a tween script.

mira.channel.builtin_alternative: jweb (web page inside Max, not a remote browser)
mira.channel.comments: Needs the Miraweb package and a web page using the xebra.js library. Handles numbers, lists and dictionaries.
mira.channel.function: Sends and receives data between Max and a web page.

mira.status.comments: Outputs added, changed and removed messages automatically.
mira.status.function: Reports which Mira and Miraweb clients are connected.

gf.comments: The package's older gesture follower; mubu.hhmm and mubu.xmm are its newer recognition objects.
gf.function: Follows a live gesture against recorded examples, reporting which and how far.

imubu.comments: Works like mubu plus a GUI. Dozens of imubu-*.maxhelp pages cover its views.
imubu.function: Displays and edits a MuBu container's tracks, markers and descriptors graphically.

mc.mubu.concat~.function: Plays marked corpus segments from a MuBu container as multichannel voices.

mc.mubu.granular~.function: Granulates audio from a MuBu container as multichannel voices.

mimo.normalize.category: Machine learning: data sets, scaling & dimension reduction
mimo.normalize.comments: Module, not a box: train it inside mubu.model, then apply it live by name in pipo. e.g. pipo normalize @normalize.model <dict>.
mimo.normalize.function: Learns min/max or mean/std statistics of track data for normalization.

mimo.pca.category: Machine learning: data sets, scaling & dimension reduction
mimo.pca.comments: Module, not a box: train it inside mubu.model, then apply it live by name in pipo. e.g. pipo pca @pca.direction forward.
mimo.pca.function: Learns principal components of track data for dimension reduction.

mimo.stats.category: Machine learning: data sets, scaling & dimension reduction
mimo.stats.comments: Module, not a box: train it inside mubu.model, then apply it live by name in pipo. Fetch the result with getmodel.
mimo.stats.function: Computes basic statistics over all data in a MuBu track.

mubu.category: Machine learning: data sets, scaling & dimension reduction
mubu.comments: Central object of MuBu and catart-mubu; other mubu.* objects refer to it by name.
mubu.function: Holds audio, markers, descriptors and sensor data as aligned multi-track buffers.

mubu.additive~.function: Resynthesizes additive partial data stored in MuBu tracks.

mubu.concat~.comments: It plays segments you pick; choosing by sound similarity comes from mubu.knn upstream. Core engine of catart-mubu.
mubu.concat~.function: Plays whole marked segments of a MuBu audio track, chosen by index.

mubu.dtw.function: Compares or aligns data sequences with dynamic time warping.

mubu.gmm.function: Recognizes static poses or sound classes with Gaussian mixture models.

mubu.gmr.comments: Trained on paired input and output tracks recorded by demonstration.
mubu.gmr.function: Maps movement data to sound parameters with Gaussian mixture regression.

mubu.granular~.comments: Synchronous mode needs a marker track of waveform periods.
mubu.granular~.function: Plays grains from a MuBu audio track, synchronously or asynchronously.

mubu.gvf.function: Follows a live gesture while estimating its speed, scale and rotation.

mubu.hhmm.function: Recognizes and follows gestures continuously with hierarchical hidden Markov models.

mubu.knn.comments: Builds a kD-tree over the track. Typical chain: mubu.knn into mubu.concat~.
mubu.knn.function: Finds the nearest entries in a MuBu track to a target vector.

mubu.model.category: Machine learning: data sets, scaling & dimension reduction
mubu.model.comments: Host for mimo.* modules, named without the prefix (e.g. mubu.model <mubu> <track> pca).
mubu.model.function: Trains a Mimo model on all data of a MuBu track.

mubu.play.function: Plays back a MuBu track's data as messages over time.

mubu.play~.comments: @channels sets the number of signal outlets (in the help file, missing from the refpage). For track data as messages use mubu.play.
mubu.play~.function: Plays an audio track of a MuBu container, or a buffer~, as sound.

mubu.process.comments: Offline counterpart of pipo~, e.g. mubu.process <mubu> audio descr:chop @name descr. Reprocesses when the input track changes.
mubu.process.function: Runs audio or data tracks through PiPo analysis chains into new tracks.

mubu.record.function: Records incoming data lists into a MuBu track.

mubu.record~.function: Records live audio into a MuBu track.

mubu.scroll.function: Draws incoming vectors as a scrolling display.

mubu.track.function: Gives fast access to one track of a MuBu container.

mubu.xmm.function: Recognizes gestures and maps them to sound with multimodal hidden Markov models.

pipo.comments: Name modules without "pipo." and chain with colons, e.g. pipo median:scale. Attributes carry the module prefix. Set @framerate to your data rate, or 1000 Hz is assumed.
pipo.function: Runs PiPo processing chains on incoming lists, such as sensor data.

pipo.1euro.category: PiPo modules: smoothing, derivatives & motion sensors
pipo.1euro.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model. Set the host's frame rate, or 1000 Hz is assumed.
pipo.1euro.function: Smooths noisy sensor data, cutting lag automatically when it moves fast.

pipo.bands.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.bands.function: Groups spectrum bins into bands on various frequency scales.

pipo.basic.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.basic.function: Computes pitch, periodicity, loudness and spectral moments of audio.

pipo.bayesfilter.category: PiPo modules: smoothing, derivatives & motion sensors
pipo.bayesfilter.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.bayesfilter.function: Extracts smooth envelopes from EMG muscle signals by Bayesian filtering.

pipo.biquad.category: PiPo modules: smoothing, derivatives & motion sensors
pipo.biquad.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.biquad.function: Filters a data stream with a biquad filter.

pipo.chop.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model. Common in catart-mubu as descr:chop.
pipo.chop.function: Cuts a stream into fixed-size segments with per-segment statistics.

pipo.const.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.const.function: Adds a named constant-value column to a data stream.

pipo.cqt.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.cqt.function: Computes a constant-Q spectrum with musically spaced bins.

pipo.dct.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.dct.function: Computes a discrete cosine transform of each frame.

pipo.delta.category: PiPo modules: smoothing, derivatives & motion sensors
pipo.delta.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.delta.function: Estimates the rate of change of a data stream.

pipo.descr.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model. The default analysis in catart-mubu (descr:chop).
pipo.descr.function: Computes pitch, periodicity, loudness and spectral moments of audio.

pipo.fft.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model. Chained after slice, e.g. slice:fft.
pipo.fft.function: Computes a magnitude or power spectrum of each frame.

pipo.finitedif.category: PiPo modules: smoothing, derivatives & motion sensors
pipo.finitedif.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.finitedif.function: Computes derivatives of a data stream by finite differences.

pipo.gate.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.gate.function: Segments a stream where a value like loudness crosses thresholds.

pipo.index.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.index.function: Adds an incrementing counter column to a data stream.

pipo.intensity.category: PiPo modules: smoothing, derivatives & motion sensors
pipo.intensity.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.intensity.function: Measures movement intensity from RIoT accelerometer data.

pipo.ircamdescriptor.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.ircamdescriptor.function: Computes IRCAM's large set of audio descriptors.

pipo.javascript.comments: Module, not a box. In hosts it is named js, with @js.expr, e.g. pipo js @js.expr "…"; the refpage's javascript.* names are not what the help files use.
pipo.javascript.function: Transforms each data frame with a JavaScript expression.

pipo.loudness.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.loudness.function: Computes weighted loudness of each audio frame.

pipo.lpc.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.lpc.function: Computes linear prediction coefficients of audio frames.

pipo.lpcformants.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.lpcformants.function: Estimates formant frequencies and bandwidths from LPC analysis.

pipo.median.builtin_alternative: zl.median (median of one list, not running)
pipo.median.category: PiPo modules: smoothing, derivatives & motion sensors
pipo.median.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.median.function: Smooths a stream with a running median filter.

pipo.mel.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.mel.function: Computes mel-band energies of audio frames.

pipo.mfcc.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.mfcc.function: Computes MFCC timbre coefficients of audio frames.

pipo.moments.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.moments.function: Computes centroid, spread and higher moments of each vector.

pipo.mvavrg.category: PiPo modules: smoothing, derivatives & motion sensors
pipo.mvavrg.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.mvavrg.function: Smooths a stream with a moving average.

pipo.norm.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model. @norm.powexp 0.5 gives ordinary length.
pipo.norm.function: Computes the vector norm, or overall magnitude, of each frame.

pipo.onseg.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.onseg.function: Segments audio at onsets with per-segment statistics.

pipo.orientation.category: PiPo modules: smoothing, derivatives & motion sensors
pipo.orientation.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.orientation.function: Estimates orientation angles from RIoT motion sensor data.

pipo.peaks.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.peaks.function: Finds peaks, such as partials, in a spectrum or any vector.

pipo.psy.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.psy.function: Finds pitch-synchronous periods of audio for PSOLA processing.

pipo.savitzkygolay.category: PiPo modules: smoothing, derivatives & motion sensors
pipo.savitzkygolay.comments: Module, not a box: name it inside pipo or mubu.process. Can be renamed in the chain, e.g. savitzkygolay(sg) @sg.size 5.
pipo.savitzkygolay.function: Smooths a stream or takes derivatives with Savitzky-Golay filtering.

pipo.scale.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.scale.function: Rescales stream values from an input range to an output range.

pipo.select.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.select.function: Keeps only chosen columns or rows of a stream.

pipo.slice.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.slice.function: Cuts audio into windowed, overlapping frames for spectral analysis.

pipo.sum.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.sum.function: Sums the values of each frame.

pipo.sylseg.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.sylseg.function: Segments speech into phrases and syllables.

pipo.wavelet.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.wavelet.function: Computes a continuous wavelet transform with low delay per band.

pipo.yin.comments: Module, not a box: name it without "pipo." inside pipo, pipo~, mubu.process or mubu.model.
pipo.yin.function: Estimates pitch, energy and periodicity with the YIN algorithm.

pipo~.comments: Name modules without "pipo." and chain with colons, e.g. pipo~ slice:fft. Module attributes carry the prefix.
crossref: Audio analysis: descriptor bundles & analysis frames
pipo~.function: Runs PiPo analysis chains on live audio and outputs lists.

nls.ar~.function: Makes a clickless exponential attack-release envelope from an audio trigger.

nls.cross_seq2~.comments: Deterministic, not random: patterns shift as LFO rates and shapes change. A ready bpatcher is in the snippets.
nls.cross_seq2~.function: Fires triggers wherever two LFOs cross, plus their curves as control signals.

nls.cross_seq3~.comments: Four trigger outlets (1-2, 1-3, 2-3, 1-2-3). A ready bpatcher is in the snippets.
nls.cross_seq3~.function: Fires triggers where three LFOs cross, with LFO and difference signals.

nls.trigger_logic~.category: Rhythm & time: delays, gates & bang logic
nls.trigger_logic~.function: Passes triggers only when checks on two signals, like direction or sign, pass.

IOmap~.comments: Starts with no connections: send a routing list on load or use the patchbay bpatcher. Useful just before dac~ to remap speakers per venue.
IOmap~.function: Routes eight audio channels to eight outputs with smooth 100 ms fades.

IOrouter8to2dd~.comments: Needs Max 9 (uses abl.dsp.darkhall~), although the package says Max 8. Expects speaker 1 center-front, numbered clockwise.
IOrouter8to2dd~.function: Folds an eight-speaker double-diamond mix down to stereo for headphone checks.

balancestereo~.category: Audio I/O: gain, mixers & channel strips
balancestereo~.comments: Balance is float only, not signal. Fades the reduced side to silence below -60 dB with a 10 ms ramp. Optional argument sets the start (0.5).
balancestereo~.function: Turns down the left or right channel of a stereo signal.

circularLRFBpan~.comments: In the misc folder. Rate in Hz; negative reverses, 0 pauses. Needs panLRFB~ and pan~ from the package.
circularLRFBpan~.function: Spins a mono sound in a steady circle around four speakers.

circularXYslider.builtin_alternative: pictslider — a square 2D slider, not limited to a circle.
circularXYslider.comments: Use in a 256x256 bpatcher with offset -128 -128. Needs Max 9 (uses v8).
circularXYslider.function: Outputs x-y values from a 2D pad kept inside a circle.

cubepan~.comments: Outlets 1-4 lower ring, 5-8 upper ring (LF, RF, LB, RB). Needs pan~ and panLRFB~ from the package.
cubepan~.function: Pans a mono sound in 3D among eight speakers at cube corners.

distance2D.builtin_alternative: expr — one expression computes the same distance.
distance2D.comments: Only the left inlet triggers output; also takes a four-item list.
distance2D.function: Calculates the distance between two 2D points.

distance2D~.builtin_alternative: cartopol~ — gives distance from the origin after subtracting the points with -~.
distance2D~.comments: Pairs with dopplerd~ and a 1/distance gain.
distance2D~.function: Calculates the distance between two moving 2D points at signal rate.

distance3D.builtin_alternative: expr — one expression computes the same distance.
distance3D.comments: Only the left inlet triggers output; also takes a six-item list.
distance3D.function: Calculates the distance between two 3D points.

distance3D~.comments: Pairs with dopplerd~ and a 1/distance gain.
distance3D~.function: Calculates the distance between two moving 3D points at signal rate.

dopplerd~.builtin_alternative: delay~ — the same result if you convert meters to samples yourself.
dopplerd~.comments: @maxdelay is in samples (default 48000): about 343 m at 48 kHz but only 171 m at 96 kHz. Use a signal distance for smooth motion.
dopplerd~.function: Delays a sound by its travel time over a distance, giving Doppler shift.

fourchanpan~.comments: Position must be a signal (use sig~ or line~); floats are not accepted per its help file.
fourchanpan~.function: Pans a mono sound across four speakers in a line or arc.

gainsimple~.builtin_alternative: live.gain~ — same dB behaviour with a slider and meter.
gainsimple~.category: Audio I/O: gain, mixers & channel strips
gainsimple~.comments: Gain inlet takes floats only, though the refpage says signal. -70 dB or lower means silence; 10 ms smoothing.
gainsimple~.function: Sets a mono signal's level in decibels without a user interface.

hexapan~.builtin_alternative: mc.mixdown~ — circular panning of MC channels, but no spread and a different angle origin.
hexapan~.comments: Two speaker layouts (inlet 4). Spread above 0 raises overall loudness. Controls are signals.
hexapan~.function: Pans a mono sound around six speakers in a hexagon.

kinky~.comments: Demo voice for the package's polyphonic panning examples.
kinky~.function: Plays phase-distortion synth notes, built as a poly~ voice.

mc.cubepan~.comments: Abstraction, not Max's MC wrapper. Each outlet carries one channel per voice; follow with mc.mixdown~ 1.
mc.cubepan~.function: Pans many voices in 3D among eight cube-corner speakers.

mc.distance2D~.comments: Its refpage file wrongly declares the name mc.distance3D~, so tools that read refpage names mix up the two.
mc.distance2D~.function: Calculates per-voice distances between moving 2D points in MC signals.

mc.distance3D~.comments: The mc.distance2D~ refpage also claims this name; check port counts (six inlets here).
mc.distance3D~.function: Calculates per-voice distances between moving 3D points in MC signals.

mc.dopplerd~.comments: Its argument is sent to mc.delay~ as maxdelay, which mc.delay~ does not document (it uses maxsize); the buffer may stay 48000 samples. Untested in Max.
mc.dopplerd~.function: Delays each voice of an MC signal by its own travel distance.

mc.fourchanpan~.comments: Abstraction, not Max's MC wrapper. Each outlet carries one channel per voice; follow with mc.mixdown~ 1.
mc.fourchanpan~.function: Pans many voices across four speakers in a line.

mc.hexapan~.comments: Abstraction, not Max's MC wrapper. Each outlet carries one channel per voice; follow with mc.mixdown~ 1.
mc.hexapan~.function: Pans many voices around six speakers in a hexagon.

mc.mixS~.comments: A float mix value sets every channel. Not constant-power.
mc.mixS~.function: Crossfades two MC signals channel by channel with S-shaped curves.

mc.mix~.comments: A float balance sets every channel.
mc.mix~.function: Crossfades two MC signals channel by channel with a straight line.

mc.octopan~.builtin_alternative: mc.mixdown~ — pans MC channels around N outputs in a circle; no spread, different angle origin.
mc.octopan~.comments: Abstraction, not Max's MC wrapper. Each outlet carries one channel per voice; follow with mc.mixdown~ 1.
mc.octopan~.function: Pans many voices independently around eight speakers in a circle.

mc.pan2x4~.comments: Abstraction, not Max's MC wrapper. Each outlet carries one channel per voice; follow with mc.mixdown~ 1.
mc.pan2x4~.function: Pans many voices over eight speakers arranged as four stereo pairs.

mc.panLRFB~.comments: Abstraction, not Max's MC wrapper. Each outlet carries one channel per voice; follow with mc.mixdown~ 1.
mc.panLRFB~.function: Pans many voices over four speakers using x-y positions.

mc.panlinear~.comments: Mainly for comparing panning laws; centered sounds are 3 dB quieter.
mc.panlinear~.function: Pans each channel of an MC signal with a linear stereo law.

mc.panpolardd~.comments: Abstraction, not Max's MC wrapper. Each outlet carries one channel per voice; follow with mc.mixdown~ 1.
mc.panpolardd~.function: Pans many voices over eight speakers using per-voice distance and angle.

mc.panstereo~.comments: Its refpage file declares the name panstereo~, not mc.panstereo~.
mc.panstereo~.function: Shifts the width of many stereo voices at once.

mc.pan~.builtin_alternative: mc.stereo~ — pans and sums voices to one 2-channel MC cord; undocumented in Max 9.
mc.pan~.comments: Abstraction, not Max's MC wrapper. Each outlet carries one channel per voice; follow with mc.mixdown~ 1.
mc.pan~.function: Pans each voice of an MC signal between two speakers with constant intensity.

mc.perturbxyz~.function: Adds wandering random offsets to per-voice x, y, z signals.

mc.perturbxy~.function: Adds wandering random offsets to per-voice x and y signals.

mc.perturb~.function: Adds a wandering random offset to every channel of an MC signal.

mc.quadpan~.comments: Abstraction, not Max's MC wrapper. Each outlet carries one channel per voice; follow with mc.mixdown~ 1.
mc.quadpan~.function: Pans many voices around four square speakers by angle.

mc.surroundstereo~.comments: Abstraction, not Max's MC wrapper. Each outlet carries one channel per voice; follow with mc.mixdown~ 1.
mc.surroundstereo~.function: Spreads many stereo voices around eight speakers with rotation.

mixS~.comments: Gains add to 1, so unrelated sounds dip about 3 dB mid-fade; not equal-power. Smooth float changes to avoid clicks.
mixS~.function: Crossfades two signals using gentle S-shaped gain curves.

mix~.comments: Linear law. Smooth float changes to avoid clicks. Argument sets the starting balance.
mix~.function: Mixes or crossfades two signals with a single balance control.

noisebandstereo~.comments: Pan is fixed at note start inside poly~. Messages f, a, q, dur, att, rel, pan.
noisebandstereo~.function: Plays stereo-panned band-limited noise notes, built as a poly~ voice.

noiseband~.comments: Airy or pitched noise depending on Q. Messages f, a, q, dur, att, rel. Pair with an mc panner.
noiseband~.function: Plays band-limited noise notes, built as a poly~ voice.

octonode~.builtin_alternative: nodes — the built-in UI it is based on.
octonode~.comments: Use in a 256x256 bpatcher with offset -128 -128. Not constant-intensity. In the misc folder.
octonode~.function: Pans a mono sound over eight speakers by dragging a point near them.

octopan2~.comments: Same as octopan~ with 0.0625 added to the angle. In the misc folder.
octopan2~.function: Pans a mono sound around eight speakers with no center speaker.

octopan~.builtin_alternative: mc.mixdown~ — circular panning of MC channels, but no spread and a different angle origin.
octopan~.comments: Speaker 1 center-front, clockwise. Use signal controls. Spread above 0 raises loudness (about +6 dB at 1). Works as a poly~ voice too.
octopan~.function: Pans a mono sound around eight speakers in a circle.

octosampler~.comments: Takes any sfplay~ message in the left inlet. Needs octopan~ from the package.
octosampler~.function: Plays sound files panned over eight speakers, built as a poly~ voice.

pan2x4~.comments: Front-back control must be a signal. Needs pan~ and fourchanpan~ from the package.
pan2x4~.function: Pans a mono sound over eight speakers arranged as four stereo pairs.

panLRFB~.comments: Needs pan~ from the package; a same-named pan~ elsewhere on the search path would replace it.
panLRFB~.function: Pans a mono sound over four speakers using left-right and front-back values.

panlinear~.comments: Centered sounds are 3 dB quieter; mainly for comparing with pan~.
panlinear~.function: Pans a mono sound between two speakers with a linear law.

panpolardd~.comments: Can place sounds inside the circle, unlike octopan~. Use signal controls. Needs panLRFB~ and pan~.
panpolardd~.function: Pans a mono sound over eight speakers using distance and angle.

panstereo~.comments: Lowers the total by up to 3 dB as channels overlap. Range -1. to 1.
panstereo~.function: Shifts one channel of a stereo sound toward the other side.

pan~.builtin_alternative: mc.stereo~ — built-in constant-power pan to a 2-channel MC cord; undocumented in Max 9.
pan~.comments: Not a built-in object despite the plain name; other package panners load it by name. Positions outside 0-1 flip polarity. Smooth float changes to avoid clicks.
pan~.function: Pans a mono sound between two speakers with constant loudness.

patchbay.builtin_alternative: matrixctrl — patchbay is a matrixctrl with a pattr to save settings.
patchbay.comments: Use in a bpatcher and wire to IOmap~.
patchbay.function: Shows an 8x8 grid for choosing which channel goes to which speaker.

perturb.builtin_alternative: random — scale and add a random offset yourself.
perturb.function: Adds a random offset within a set range to each incoming number.

perturbxy.comments: Only the left inlet triggers output.
perturbxy.function: Adds random offsets within set ranges to an x-y pair.

perturbxyz.comments: Only the left inlet triggers output.
perturbxyz.function: Adds random offsets within set ranges to an x-y-z point.

perturbxyz~.builtin_alternative: rand~ — scale and add its output to each signal yourself.
perturbxyz~.function: Adds slowly wandering random offsets to three signals.

perturbxy~.builtin_alternative: rand~ — scale and add its output to each signal yourself.
perturbxy~.function: Adds slowly wandering random offsets to two signals.

perturb~.builtin_alternative: rand~ — scale its output with *~ and add it with +~.
perturb~.function: Adds a slowly wandering random offset to a signal.

polysimpleFM~.comments: Demo voice with no envelope. Signal inlets only.
polysimpleFM~.function: Plays a simple two-operator FM tone, built as a poly~ voice.

quadpan~.builtin_alternative: mc.mixdown~ — circular panning of MC channels, with a different angle origin.
quadpan~.comments: Uses only the two nearest speakers, so sounds cannot cross the middle of the room.
quadpan~.function: Pans a mono sound around four square speakers by angle.

surroundstereosampler~.comments: Takes any sfplay~ message in the left inlet. Needs surroundstereo~ and octopan~.
surroundstereosampler~.function: Plays stereo sound files spread over eight speakers, as a poly~ voice.

surroundstereo~.comments: Refpage says speaker 1 is 22.5 degrees left of front; the patch and help assume center-front. Needs octopan~.
surroundstereo~.function: Spreads a stereo sound around eight speakers with rotation and spread.

JC_rev~.comments: Messages: T60 <seconds> and mix <0-1>. Classic, cheap, somewhat metallic.
JC_rev~.function: Adds John Chowning's classic comb-and-allpass reverb to a signal.

N_rev~.comments: Messages: T60 <seconds> and mix <0-1>. The densest of the three PeRColate reverbs.
N_rev~.function: Adds the CCRMA NRev reverb, a denser comb-and-allpass network, to a signal.

PRC_rev~.comments: Messages: T60 <seconds> and mix <0-1>. Lightest of the three PeRColate reverbs. The external file is named prc_rev~ in lowercase.
PRC_rev~.function: Adds Perry Cook's small two-comb reverb to a signal.

absmax~.function: Outputs whichever of two signals has the larger absolute value.

absmin~.function: Outputs whichever of two signals has the smaller absolute value.

agogo~.builtin_alternative: abl.dsp.modalresonator~ (general modal resonator, needs an exciter)
agogo~.comments: Struck with noteon and noteoff, or its inlets. Frequency inlet is in Hz; convert MIDI with mtof.
agogo~.function: Synthesizes a struck agogo bell with modal synthesis.

bamboo~.comments: Shaken by raising the energy (maximum shake) inlet repeatedly. metashaker~ offers this model and six others in one object.
bamboo~.function: Synthesizes a bamboo wind chime from shaking energy.

bandedWG~.comments: Played with noteon <Hz> <amp> and noteoff; timbre set with control <number> <0-128>. Frequency is in Hz, so convert MIDI with mtof. control 16 picks the instrument type.
bandedWG~.function: Synthesizes bowed or struck bars, glass harmonica and Tibetan bowls.

blotar~.comments: Twelve inlets. mode 0 is the stabler classic algorithm. Some settings get very loud; the help files put limi~ after it.
blotar~.function: Synthesizes a hybrid of flute and electric guitar physical models.

blow_botl~.comments: Played with noteon <Hz> <amp> and noteoff; timbre set with control <number> <0-128>. Frequency is in Hz, so convert MIDI with mtof.
blow_botl~.function: Synthesizes a blown bottle with a resonator and breath noise.

blow_hole~.comments: Played with noteon <Hz> <amp> and noteoff; timbre set with control <number> <0-128>. Frequency is in Hz, so convert MIDI with mtof. Highest playable pitch is limited by the fixed bore length. Port counts unconfirmed: no saved example box.
blow_hole~.function: Synthesizes a clarinet with a register hole and one tonehole.

bowedbar~.comments: Plays continuously from its inlet values (no note messages). Frequency is in Hz, so convert MIDI with mtof. Some settings get very loud; the help files put limi~ after it.
bowedbar~.function: Synthesizes a bowed percussion bar, like a bowed vibraphone.

bowed~.comments: Plays continuously from its inlet values (no note messages). Frequency is in Hz, so convert MIDI with mtof. Some settings get very loud; the help files put limi~ after it.
bowed~.function: Synthesizes a bowed string instrument such as a violin.

brass~.comments: Plays continuously from its inlet values (no note messages). Frequency is in Hz, so convert MIDI with mtof. Some settings get very loud; the help files put limi~ after it.
brass~.function: Synthesizes a brass instrument from lip tension and air pressure.

cabasa~.comments: Shaken by raising the energy (maximum shake) inlet repeatedly. metashaker~ offers this model and six others in one object.
cabasa~.function: Synthesizes a cabasa from shaking energy.

casey~.comments: Meant for FFT frames: keeps only the strongest bins. The help file runs it between fft~/cartopol~ and poltocar~/ifft~.
casey~.function: Keeps the N largest samples in each signal vector and zeroes the rest.

chase~.comments: Rarely needed; a small gen~ patch does the same.
chase~.function: Sends the input nearer a sync signal left and the farther one right.

clar~.comments: Plays continuously from its inlet values (no note messages). Frequency is in Hz, so convert MIDI with mtof. Some settings get very loud; the help files put limi~ after it.
clar~.function: Synthesizes a clarinet from breath pressure and reed stiffness.

curvesmooth~.builtin_alternative: rampsmooth~ (linear only, times in samples); slide~ (logarithmic)
curvesmooth~.comments: Coefficient 1 is linear, above 1 exponential, below 1 logarithmic. Use mode 1 for input outside -1 to 1.
curvesmooth~.function: Smooths a control signal with separate up and down times and curve shapes.

dcblock~.builtin_alternative: biquad~ set as a high-pass filter (more setup)
dcblock~.comments: No arguments or messages. Handy after feedback, waveshaping or physical models.
dcblock~.function: Removes DC offset and very slow drift from a signal.

escal~.comments: Its own help file says round~ has more or less replaced it.
escal~.function: Rounds a signal to integers, always down, nearest, or always up.

flapper~.comments: Needs a trigger in the left inlet; the help uses the findtrigger~ helper patch. Delay line up to 5000 ms.
flapper~.function: Scrubs back and forth between a triggered point and the live input.

flip~.builtin_alternative: pong~ (fold or wrap within a range)
flip~.comments: Its own help file says pong~ has more or less replaced it.
flip~.function: Folds a signal back around a threshold when it exceeds it.

flute~.comments: Plays continuously from its inlet values (no note messages). Frequency is in Hz, so convert MIDI with mtof. Some settings get very loud; the help files put limi~ after it.
flute~.function: Synthesizes a flute from breath pressure, jet delay and noise.

gQ~.comments: Argument sets the number of bands; pick one with currentbank, then set frequency, bandwidth and boost. Its parameters do not interact. Refpage file is gQ~ but lists itself as gq~.
gQ~.function: Equalizes a stereo signal with a series of peak, notch and shelf bands.

gen10.comments: Outputs index/amplitude pairs to write into a buffer~ with peek~, then play with wave~. Ported from RTcmix.
gen10.function: Computes a wavetable from a list of harmonic amplitudes.

gen17.comments: Outputs index/amplitude pairs for peek~ into a buffer~ read by lookup~. Lets you choose which harmonics a sine gains when waveshaped.
gen17.function: Computes a Chebyshev waveshaping table from harmonic amplitudes.

gen20.comments: Distributions: even, low, high, triangle, Gaussian, Cauchy. Outputs index/amplitude pairs for peek~.
gen20.function: Fills a table with random values from one of six distributions.

gen24.comments: Outputs index/amplitude pairs for peek~ into a buffer~.
gen24.function: Computes a table from time and amplitude breakpoints with straight lines.

gen25.builtin_alternative: buffer~ (fill 1, then apply hanning or apply hamming)
gen25.comments: Outputs index/amplitude pairs for peek~. The refpage mislabels itself gen24.
gen25.function: Computes a Hanning or Hamming window table.

gen5.comments: Outputs index/amplitude pairs for peek~. The refpage warns never to use a target time of 0, because the exponential curve cannot handle it.
gen5.function: Computes a table from breakpoints joined by exponential curves.

gen7.comments: Outputs index/amplitude pairs for peek~ into a buffer~.
gen7.function: Computes a table from breakpoints joined by straight lines.

gen9.comments: Takes triplets, so partials need not be whole-number harmonics. Outputs index/amplitude pairs for peek~.
gen9.function: Computes a wavetable from partial ratios, amplitudes and phases.

guiro~.comments: Shaken by raising the energy (maximum shake) inlet repeatedly. metashaker~ offers this model and six others in one object. The init file's mc.guiro mapping is misspelled, so an MC version does not load.

jitter~.comments: Changes the offset every sample, or only on bang when the second argument is 1.
jitter~.function: Adds a random offset within a set range to a signal.

klutz~.comments: A glitch effect whose sound depends on the vector size set in Audio Status.
klutz~.function: Reverses the sample order inside each signal vector.

mandolin~.comments: Bang plucks it. Frequency inlet is in Hz; convert MIDI with mtof. mic <0-11> picks a recorded body perspective. Some settings get very loud; the help files put limi~ after it.
mandolin~.function: Synthesizes a plucked mandolin with body size and pluck position.

marimba~.builtin_alternative: abl.dsp.modalresonator~ (general modal resonator, needs an exciter)
marimba~.comments: Struck with noteon and noteoff, or its inlets. Frequency inlet is in Hz; convert MIDI with mtof.
marimba~.function: Synthesizes a struck marimba bar with modal synthesis.

mesh2d~.comments: Arguments set mesh size in samples; strike, position, setDecay, setNX, setNY control it. Large meshes cost CPU.
mesh2d~.function: Simulates a struck 2D membrane, like a drum head, as a waveguide mesh.

metashaker~.comments: Pick the model with bamboo, cabasa, guiro, maraca, sekere, sleigh or tambourine. Raise the energy inlet to shake. Replaces the single-instrument shaker objects.
metashaker~.function: Synthesizes seven shaken percussion instruments in one object.

munger~.builtin_alternative: abl.dsp.pitchshifter~ (plain pitch shift, no grain cloud)
munger~.comments: Works on live input via an internal delay; record 0 freezes it. Argument is max delay in ms. Pitch sieves (tempered) quantize grain pitch. note plays single grains.
munger~.function: Granulates live input into a cloud of pitch-shifted, panned stereo grains.

nbody~.comments: Pick an instrument (violin, hardanger, guitar1, guitar2, archtop, mandolin), then a mic perspective 1-12. Feed it a string model or noise.
nbody~.function: Filters a signal through measured body resonances of violins, guitars and mandolins.

nscradle~.comments: Start motion with put <ball> <radians>; zero stops it. One impulse outlet per neighbouring ball pair. Ball -1 sets all balls. Good for triggering other sounds.
nscradle~.function: Simulates a Newton's cradle and outputs an impulse at each collision.

pit_shift~.category: Audio effects: pitch shift & time stretch
pit_shift~.comments: One message: shift <factor>, where 1 means no change.
pit_shift~.function: Shifts pitch with a simple delay-line pitch shifter.

plucked~.comments: Only amplitude and frequency (Hz). stif_karp~ adds stiffness and pickup position.
plucked~.function: Synthesizes a plucked string with the basic Karplus-Strong algorithm.

pokef~.comments: Argument names the buffer~. A -1 index signal stops writing.
pokef~.function: Writes signal values into a buffer~ at signal-rate indexes with interpolation.

prc_chorus~.function: Adds Perry Cook's simple chorus to a signal.

prc_fm~.builtin_alternative: abl.dsp.simplefm~ or abl.dsp.harmonicfm~ (FM oscillators, no preset voices)
prc_fm~.comments: type 1-7 picks BeeThree, FMVoices, HevyMetl, PercFlut, Rhodey, TubeBell, Wurley. Played with noteon <Hz> <amp> and noteoff; timbre set with control <number> <0-128>. Frequency is in Hz, so convert MIDI with mtof.
prc_fm~.function: Plays seven classic FM instrument voices, such as Rhodes and tubular bell.

random~.comments: Argument or range message sets the upper limit.
random~.function: Generates random integers from 0 to a limit at audio rate.

recordf~.comments: Good for overdub loopers. Inlets: record on/off, feedback amount, loop start and end in ms. Send loop 1 for loop recording.
recordf~.function: Records into a buffer~ while keeping a set amount of what was there.

saxofony~.comments: Played with noteon <Hz> <amp> and noteoff; timbre set with control <number> <0-128>. Frequency is in Hz, so convert MIDI with mtof. The init file's MC mapping is misspelled saxophony~, so an MC version does not load.
saxofony~.function: Synthesizes a saxophone-like conical reed instrument.

scrubf~.comments: Max delay up to 3000 ms. sync 0 feeds back the output instead of the old input.
scrubf~.function: Scrubs through a delay line at a variable rate, with feedback.

scrub~.comments: Rate in the right inlet; 1 is normal speed. Max delay up to 3000 ms. Crossfades between three buffers to avoid clicks.
scrub~.function: Scrubs through a delay line at a variable rate for tape-like effects.

sekere~.comments: Shaken by raising the energy (maximum shake) inlet repeatedly. metashaker~ offers this model and six others in one object.
sekere~.function: Synthesizes a sekere (bead-covered gourd) from shaking energy.

shakers~.comments: play <instrument> <amp> starts a sound; energy, decay, numobjects, resfreq use a 0-128 range. The refpage does not list the instrument numbers.
shakers~.function: Plays STK shaker instruments chosen by number, controlled by messages.

shaker~.comments: Shaken by raising the energy (maximum shake) inlet repeatedly. metashaker~ offers this model and six others in one object.
shaker~.function: Synthesizes a maraca from shaking energy.

simple~.builtin_alternative: cycle~, noise~, biquad~ and adsr~ patched together
simple~.comments: Played with noteon <Hz> <amp> and noteoff; timbre set with control <number> <0-128>. Frequency is in Hz, so convert MIDI with mtof.
simple~.function: Plays a basic synth voice mixing a wavetable and noise through a filter.

sitar~.comments: Played only with noteon <Hz> <amp> and noteoff; nothing else to adjust.

sleigh~.comments: Shaken by raising the energy (maximum shake) inlet repeatedly. metashaker~ offers this model and six others in one object.
sleigh~.function: Synthesizes sleigh bells from shaking energy.

stif_karp~.comments: Played with noteon <Hz> <amp> and noteoff; timbre set with control <number> <0-128>. Frequency is in Hz, so convert MIDI with mtof. Richer successor to plucked~.
stif_karp~.function: Synthesizes a plucked string with stiffness and pickup position controls.

tamb~.comments: Shaken by raising the energy (maximum shake) inlet repeatedly. metashaker~ offers this model and six others in one object.
tamb~.function: Synthesizes a tambourine from shaking energy.

terrain~.comments: Arguments: buffer name, frame size, number of frames. Left inlet scans within a frame (e.g. phasor~), right inlet moves between frames.
terrain~.function: Scans a buffer~ as a 2D grid of wavetables and interpolates between frames.

ublotar~.comments: Newer blotar~. Six inlets set string frequencies; pluck <string 0-5> <amp> plucks. Some settings get very loud; the help files put limi~ after it.
ublotar~.function: Synthesizes a six-string flute-guitar hybrid with distortion stages.

vcomb~.comments: Use inside pfft~; the help loads vcomb-pfft~ and reads per-bin values from two buffer~ objects. Feedback can blow up, so the help adds limi~.
vcomb~.function: Applies a comb filter to each FFT bin, with per-bin delay and feedback.

vcompand2~.comments: Use inside pfft~ (help uses vcompand2-pfft~). Good for spectral noise reduction or bringing noise forward.
vcompand2~.function: Compresses or expands each FFT bin with per-bin thresholds.

vcompand~.comments: Use inside pfft~. Messages: compthresh, compratio, expthresh, expratio. Simple spectral noise gate.
vcompand~.function: Compresses or expands FFT bins above or below one threshold.

vibraphone~.builtin_alternative: abl.dsp.modalresonator~ (general modal resonator, needs an exciter)
vibraphone~.comments: Struck with noteon and noteoff, or its inlets. Frequency inlet is in Hz; convert MIDI with mtof.
vibraphone~.function: Synthesizes a struck vibraphone bar with modal synthesis.

voice_form~.builtin_alternative: abl.dsp.vowel~ (vowel filter only, needs a source)
voice_form~.comments: Played with noteon <Hz> <amp> and noteoff; timbre set with control <number> <0-128>. Frequency is in Hz, so convert MIDI with mtof. control 4 picks the vowel or phoneme.
voice_form~.function: Synthesizes a singing voice with vowel formants.

vstretch~.comments: Use inside pfft~ (help uses vstretch-pfft). stretch <factor>; linear, poly, poly2 pick interpolation.
vstretch~.function: Stretches or squeezes the spectrum by moving FFT bins up or down.

vwarp~.comments: Use inside pfft~ (help uses vwarp-pfft~ with a 2048-sample warptable buffer~). Draw the table to warp the spectrum unevenly.
vwarp~.function: Stretches FFT bins by a per-bin amount read from a buffer~.

waffle~.builtin_alternative: gate~ driven by a comparison such as <~
waffle~.function: Routes input left or right depending on whether sync is below a crossover.

weave~.comments: Arguments set how many low and high crossings to count; larger counts give lower subharmonics. An octave-divider fuzz sound.
weave~.function: Turns a signal into a square wave that flips after counted zero crossings.

whistle~.comments: Played with noteon <Hz> <amp> and noteoff; timbre set with control <number> <0-128>. Frequency is in Hz, so convert MIDI with mtof.
whistle~.function: Synthesizes a police or referee whistle.

wuter~.comments: Shaken by raising the energy (maximum shake) inlet repeatedly. metashaker~ offers this model and six others in one object.

pnp.amplitude~.builtin_alternative: peakamp~ or average~ (raw level, no smoothing curve)
pnp.amplitude~.comments: Output is a control-rate float. Optional smoothness argument.
pnp.amplitude~.function: Tracks the loudness of a signal as a 0 to 1 number.

pnp.autoamp~.comments: Handy when input level is unknown in advance.
pnp.autoamp~.function: Tracks loudness scaled against the loudest level heard so far.

pnp.autoregi~.function: Reports where the detected pitch sits between self-adjusting low and high pitches.

pnp.autoscale~.comments: Meant to steady the level before PnP descriptors.
pnp.autoscale~.function: Scales a signal's level toward a target amplitude.

pnp.bangs.builtin_alternative: uzi (no spacing) or metro with counter
pnp.bangs.category: Rhythm & time: delays, gates & bang logic
pnp.bangs.function: Outputs a set number of bangs spaced by a delay time.

pnp.beat~.comments: Outputs a bang plus a 0 to 1 velocity. Max has no dedicated built-in onset detector.
pnp.beat~.function: Detects note onsets and reports each one's strength.

pnp.binpass~.comments: Edges are rounded to whole bins.
pnp.binpass~.function: Keeps only the FFT bins between a low and high frequency.

pnp.boominess~.comments: Perceptual timbre measure. pnp.multi~ computes this with seven others on one FFT.
pnp.boominess~.function: Measures how boomy a sound is from its low-frequency content.

pnp.bpm~.function: Estimates tempo in BPM from detected onsets.

pnp.brightness~.comments: pnp.multi~ computes this with seven others on one FFT.
pnp.brightness~.function: Measures how bright a sound is from its high-frequency energy.

pnp.centroid~.function: Tracks the spectral centroid and the amplitude at that bin.

pnp.chroma~.comments: Outputs a 12-item list. Most reliable in middle and high registers.
pnp.chroma~.function: Measures how strongly each of the 12 pitch classes is present.

pnp.convolve~.comments: Needs two signal inputs; argument sets the mix.
pnp.convolve~.function: Convolves two live signals together with an FFT.

pnp.delay~.function: Delays a signal by a changeable time in milliseconds.

pnp.depth~.comments: pnp.multi~ computes this with seven others on one FFT.
pnp.depth~.function: Measures how deep a sound is from its 30 to 200 Hz content.

pnp.descriptor~.comments: Template for making your own timbre descriptor.
pnp.descriptor~.function: Measures a centroid and energy ratio within a frequency range you choose.

pnp.distort~.function: Distorts a signal with drive and amount controls.

pnp.energy~.function: Measures the total spectral energy of each FFT frame.

pnp.flange~.function: Applies a flanger with speed, width and feedback controls.

pnp.flatness~.function: Measures how noise-like or tone-like a sound is.

pnp.freeze~.comments: Uses a Jitter matrix to store the frame.
pnp.freeze~.function: Freezes the sound on a bang by looping one FFT frame.

pnp.grain~.function: Granulates live input with rate, duration and pitch controls.

pnp.hardness~.function: Measures how hard a sound's attacks are.

pnp.metallic~.function: Estimates the chance a sound came from a metal object.

pnp.multi~.comments: Boominess, brightness, depth, hardness, metallic, roughness, sharpness, warmth. Cheaper than eight separate descriptors.
crossref: Audio analysis: descriptor bundles & analysis frames
pnp.multi~.function: Measures eight timbre features at once from one FFT.

pnp.noone.comments: Right outlet bangs; right inlet sets a ramp time.
pnp.noone.function: Drops incoming 1 values and holds the last other value.

pnp.notch~.function: Removes the FFT bins between a low and high frequency.

pnp.nozero.comments: Right outlet bangs; right inlet sets a ramp time.
pnp.nozero.function: Drops incoming zeros and holds the last nonzero value.

pnp.overtone~.function: Splits a signal into its harmonics of a fundamental, one per outlet.

pnp.panner~.function: Pans a signal left and right with a fade speed.

pnp.pitchclass~.function: Splits a signal into octave bands above a fundamental, one per outlet.

pnp.pitchshift~.category: Audio effects: pitch shift & time stretch
pnp.pitchshift~.function: Shifts pitch by semitones using an FFT.

pnp.pluck~.function: Makes plucked-string sounds by exciting a Karplus-Strong loop with live input.

pnp.reduce~.function: Reduces background noise by removing quiet FFT bins.

pnp.register~.function: Reports where the detected pitch sits between a set low and high pitch.

pnp.reverb~.function: Adds stereo plate-style reverb with size, decay and mix.

pnp.roughness~.function: Measures how rough or uneven a sound's texture is.

pnp.sharpness~.function: Measures how sharp a sound is from its high-frequency share.

pnp.shuffle~.function: Randomly delays and rearranges pieces of the incoming sound.

pnp.smoother.comments: Right outlet gives the inverted value.
pnp.smoother.function: Smooths 0 to 1 control data and bends it with a curve.

pnp.split~.function: Splits a signal at one FFT bin into low and high outputs.

pnp.spread~.function: Tracks the spectral spread of a signal.

pnp.warmth~.function: Measures how warm a sound is.

pnp.wonky~.function: Delays a signal with randomly changing time and feedback.

16step-seq.builtin_alternative: live.step (graphical steps with pitch and velocity)
16step-seq.comments: Argument is the tempo in BPM. Pattern is a list of 16 on/off values. A second outlet bangs when the phrase ends.
16step-seq.function: Plays a 16-step on/off pattern that can be set, randomized or gradually changed.

@.comments: The type of the first argument (int or float) sets the output type.
@.function: Scales a 0–127 slider value into a chosen min–max range.

BPM2ms.function: Converts a tempo in beats per minute into a beat length in milliseconds.

DblBang.comments: Argument is the double-bang time window in ms (default 250). A single bang is reported only after that window, so it lags.
DblBang.function: Tells a single bang apart from a quick double bang.

ED-rhythm.comments: Argument is the selection principle: 1 alea, 2 series, 3 sequence. Send the list of entry delays (ms) to the right inlet first.
ED-rhythm.function: Plays a rhythm by picking entry delays from a list using alea, series or sequence.

ED-trans.comments: Arguments are start and end entry delay in ms. A time in ms sent to the left inlet starts it.
ED-trans.function: Makes a ritardando or accelerando between two entry delays over a set time.

ED2EP.comments: Integers only. Argument is a start offset.
ED2EP.function: Turns a stream of time gaps into running time points by adding them up.

Labs.comments: Peter Elsea Lobjects external, universal binary.
Labs.function: Replaces every number in a list with its absolute value.

Ladd.comments: Peter Elsea Lobjects external, universal binary. Used inside other RTC-lib objects.
Ladd.function: Adds a number or a second list to every element of a list.

Ldiv.comments: Zeros in the divisor are treated as 1, so it never divides by zero. Peter Elsea Lobjects external.
Ldiv.function: Divides every element of a list by a number or matching list.

Lmult.comments: Peter Elsea Lobjects external, universal binary.
Lmult.function: Multiplies every element of a list by a number or matching list.

Lpow.comments: 0^0 and negative numbers to fractional powers pass through unchanged. Peter Elsea Lobjects external.
Lpow.function: Raises every element of a list to a power.

Lrem.comments: A divisor of 0 gives 0 instead of an error. Peter Elsea Lobjects external.
Lrem.function: Takes the remainder of every list element divided by a number or list.

Lround.comments: Peter Elsea Lobjects external, universal binary.
Lround.function: Rounds every element of a list to a grid.

Lsub.comments: Peter Elsea Lobjects external, universal binary.
Lsub.function: Subtracts a number or a second list from every element of a list.

Lsum.comments: Peter Elsea Lobjects external, universal binary.
Lsum.function: Adds up all the numbers in a list.

MSP-iovs~.category: Audio I/O: hardware inputs, outputs & audio settings
MSP-iovs~.comments: Sends a message to dsp. It also sends its argument when the patch loads, which can change audio settings unexpectedly.
MSP-iovs~.function: Sets the audio I/O vector size from a patch.

MSP-sigvs~.category: Audio I/O: hardware inputs, outputs & audio settings
MSP-sigvs~.comments: Sends a message to dsp. It also sends its argument when the patch loads, which can change audio settings unexpectedly.
MSP-sigvs~.function: Sets the audio signal vector size from a patch.

MSP-sr~.category: Audio I/O: hardware inputs, outputs & audio settings
MSP-sr~.comments: Sends a message to dsp. It also sends its argument when the patch loads, which can change audio settings unexpectedly.
MSP-sr~.function: Sets the audio sample rate from a patch.

MSP-takeover~.category: Audio I/O: hardware inputs, outputs & audio settings
MSP-takeover~.comments: Sends a message to dsp. It also sends its argument when the patch loads, which can change audio settings unexpectedly.
MSP-takeover~.function: Turns Scheduler in Audio Interrupt on or off from a patch.

QT-PercPlayer.comments: Built for QuickTime's old GM synth. Needs a General MIDI synth on the MIDI output today. Mostly used by RTC-lib help files.
QT-PercPlayer.function: Plays General MIDI percussion sounds by instrument number and velocity.

QT-SndPlayer.comments: Built for QuickTime's old GM synth. Needs a General MIDI synth on the MIDI output today. Mostly used by RTC-lib help files.
QT-SndPlayer.function: Plays notes on a chosen General MIDI instrument with a set duration.

RTC-seed.comments: Works by a global send named RTC-rs, so it seeds all RTC-lib objects in every open patch at once.
RTC-seed.function: Sends one seed number to every seedable RTC-lib random object.

RandomSeeder.comments: Only outputs a number; feed it to RTC-seed to seed RTC-lib objects.
RandomSeeder.function: Outputs a seed number made from the current date and time.

VolAmb.function: Maps one controller to a loudness range between a set minimum and maximum.

add%.function: Adds a set percentage of a value to that value.

alea.comments: Koenig's ALEA selection principle. See series for no-repeat picking.
alea.function: Picks a random element from a stored list on each bang, repeats allowed.

alea-rhythm.comments: Arguments: min gap, max gap (ms), number of steps.
alea-rhythm.function: Plays bangs with random gaps chosen from a geometric scale of durations.

anti-bis.comments: Unlike change, the right outlet bangs each time a repeat is blocked.
crossref: Lists & data: change detection, matching & routing
anti-bis.function: Blocks a number that repeats the one just before it.

anti-bis&osc.comments: Right outlet bangs when something is blocked.
anti-bis&osc.function: Blocks direct repeats and back-and-forth returns (a-b-a) in a number stream.

anti-interval.comments: Argument is the forbidden interval in semitones. Right outlet bangs when a note is blocked.
anti-interval.function: Blocks a note that would form a chosen interval with the previous note.

anti-octave.comments: Right outlet bangs when a note is blocked.
anti-octave.function: Blocks a note that forms an octave with the previous note.

anti-octave&prime.comments: Right outlet bangs when a note is blocked.
anti-octave&prime.function: Blocks a note that forms an octave or a unison with the previous note.

anti-osc.comments: Does not block direct repeats; use anti-bis&osc for both.
anti-osc.function: Blocks a number equal to the one two steps back (a-b-a).

banger.builtin_alternative: select (bangs the outlet matching an int)
banger.comments: Peter Elsea external. Sequential, not a fan-out: each input bangs one outlet. Argument sets the number of outlets.
banger.function: Bangs its outlets one after another, or a chosen outlet for an int.

between.comments: The type of the arguments (int or float) sets the output type. Seedable through RTC-seed.
between.function: Outputs a random number between a minimum and a maximum, max excluded.

between-lin.comments: Arguments: min, max, number of steps.
between-lin.function: Picks a random value from N evenly spaced steps between min and max.

between-lin-urn.comments: Arguments: min, max, number of steps.
between-lin-urn.function: Picks evenly spaced random values without repeats until all steps are used.

between-log.comments: Good for frequencies and durations, where equal ratios sound even. Arguments: min, max, number of steps.
between-log.function: Picks a random value from N logarithmically spaced steps between min and max.

between-log-urn.comments: Arguments: min, max, number of steps.
between-log-urn.function: Picks log-spaced random values without repeats until all steps are used.

block-bang.category: Rhythm & time: delays, gates & bang logic
block-bang.comments: Argument is the blocking time in ms (default 2000).
block-bang.function: Ignores bangs that arrive too soon after the last accepted bang.

brown-melody.comments: Arguments: lowest note, highest note, step factor 0–1 (1 = any note, 0 = same note). Right outlet gives the chosen interval.
brown-melody.function: Makes a random-walk melody within a pitch range, avoiding octave leaps.

brown-rhythm.comments: Arguments: min gap, max gap (ms), number of steps, step factor 0–1. Factor 0 gives a steady pulse.
brown-rhythm.function: Plays a rhythm that wanders step by step through a scale of durations.

brownian.comments: Jump size is a factor 0–1 of the range instead of a fixed step. Max is excluded.
brownian.function: Outputs random numbers between min and max with a limited jump size.

butfirst.category: Lists & data: get, insert & remove items
butfirst.function: Outputs a list without its first element.

butlast.category: Lists & data: get, insert & remove items
butlast.function: Outputs a list without its last element.

check-octaves.comments: Right outlet bangs when the list contains a hidden octave.
check-octaves.function: Passes an interval list only if its intervals never add up to an octave.

check-row.comments: Right outlet bangs when the list is not a proper row.
check-row.function: Passes a list only if it is a valid twelve-tone row.

choice-rhythm.comments: Arguments: min gap, max gap, number of steps, subset size. A bang on the right inlet picks a new subset.
choice-rhythm.function: Plays a random rhythm from a random subset of a geometric duration scale.

choose.function: Outputs N distinct randomly chosen elements of a stored list.

choose-intervals.comments: Also avoids interval pairs that make octaves and diminished chords. Right outlet flashes when a sum would have been an octave.
choose-intervals.function: Chooses a small set of intervals that never add up to an octave.

collect.comments: A bang on the right inlet clears the list. Outputs the growing list on each input.
collect.function: Builds a list from numbers and symbols received one at a time.

contrario.comments: Useful for melodic inversion around a pivot note.
contrario.function: Mirrors a number around an axis value.

cos-slider.function: Reshapes a 0–127 controller along a cosine curve.

countdown.function: Counts down seconds from a given number.

cp-pan~.comments: By Chris Dobrian. Argument sets the start position.
cp-pan~.function: Pans a mono signal between two outputs with constant power.

cresc-decresc.comments: Right outlet bangs when the ramp ends. Arguments: start, end, duration in ms.
cresc-decresc.function: Ramps a MIDI velocity from a start to an end value over a duration.

crossfade~.function: Crossfades two signals with a sine curve that keeps loudness constant.

del-fb~.comments: Arguments: max delay time (ms), feedback in dB. A clear message empties the delay.
del-fb~.function: Delays a signal with adjustable feedback.

display-row.comments: Uses small note images stored in the package. Pairs with check-row and random-row.
display-row.function: Shows a twelve-tone row as notes in musical notation.

divmod.function: Divides integers and gives quotient and remainder, wrapping correctly for negatives.

dur-from-ED.comments: Factor 1 = legato, less than 1 = staccato, more than 1 = overlapping.
dur-from-ED.function: Turns time gaps into note durations with a legato factor.

first.category: Lists & data: get, insert & remove items
first.function: Outputs the first element of a list.

first-bang.comments: Right outlet passes all the other bangs.
first-bang.function: Passes only the first bang until a reset bang arrives.

first-shot.comments: By Les Stuck. Works for numbers, symbols and lists.
first-shot.function: Passes only the first message of any type until reset.

frq2note.comments: Outputs float note numbers for in-between pitches.
frq2note.function: Converts a frequency in Hz into a MIDI note number.

geom.comments: Arguments: start value and ratio q.
geom.function: Outputs the nth member of a geometric series.

grid-rhythm.comments: Arguments: grid (ms), deviation (%), selection principle 1–3. Send the list of multiples to the right inlet first.
grid-rhythm.function: Plays a rhythm from multiples of a time grid, with random timing deviation.

groove-rhythm.comments: Argument is the grid in ms. Send the list of multiples to the right inlet.
groove-rhythm.function: Plays a rhythm from multiples of a time grid picked by a selection principle.

group.function: Collects a set number of incoming numbers and outputs them as a list.

group-rhythm.comments: Based on Stockhausen's group idea. Arguments: min gap, max gap, number of steps, periodicity.
group-rhythm.function: Plays a rhythm that repeats chosen durations in groups by probability.

group-rhythm2.comments: Send the duration list to the middle inlet and group sizes to the right inlet.
group-rhythm2.function: Plays a random duration repeated a random number of times from given lists.

groups.comments: After Koenig. Supply goes to the middle inlet, group sizes to the right inlet; both are chosen with the series principle.
groups.function: Picks list elements and repeats each a randomly chosen number of times.

inc-dec.function: Steps a number up or down by bangs, without a UI.

infinity-row.comments: Every 4th, 16th, 64th member repeats the start, giving a self-similar melody.
infinity-row.function: Generates Per Nørgård's infinity series of pitches.

insert.category: Lists & data: get, insert & remove items
insert.comments: Position 0 puts it first; a position past the end appends.
insert.function: Inserts an element into a list at a given position.

integ.comments: Any input to the right inlet resets the sum.
integ.function: Adds up incoming numbers until a reset.

intv2ratio.function: Converts an interval in semitones into a frequency ratio.

inv.comments: Despite the name, it does not invert around an axis; contrario does that.
inv.function: Outputs the reciprocal (1 divided by the input).

key-bang.category: Gesture & hardware: computer keyboard, mouse & game controllers
key-bang.comments: Argument is the key's ASCII code (default 13, Return).
key-bang.function: Bangs when one chosen computer key is pressed.

last.category: Lists & data: get, insert & remove items
last.function: Outputs the last element of a list.

listlen.category: Lists & data: get, insert & remove items
listlen.function: Outputs the length of a list.

listreg.function: Stores a list and outputs it on bang.

loop-buff~.comments: Arguments: buffer name and speed. Stereo output.
loop-buff~.function: Loops a buffer~ at a set speed; negative speed plays backwards.

loop-sf~.comments: Negative speed plays backwards. Stereo output.
loop-sf~.function: Loops a mono sound file from disk at a set speed.

make-ED-scale.comments: Arguments: min gap, max gap, number of steps. Feeds many RTC-lib rhythm objects.
make-ED-scale.function: Makes a list of N durations spaced geometrically between min and max.

make-choice-list.comments: Arguments: min length, max length, min value, max value.
make-choice-list.function: Makes a random integer list with random length within set limits.

make-scale.function: Makes a list of N consecutive integers from a start value.

make-trans-scale.comments: The int sent to the left inlet picks the curve type and triggers output.
make-trans-scale.function: Makes a list of N values moving from start to end in a chosen curve.

markov.comments: Front end for prob. Send the transition table to the right inlet and the start value to the middle inlet. An outlet flashes when no transition is possible.
markov.function: Picks the next value from a first-order Markov table on each bang.

markov-harmony.comments: Weights follow prob's format. Right outlet flashes when no transition is possible.
markov-harmony.function: Generates a chain of intervals from Markov transition weights.

markov-rhythm.comments: Inlets: on/off, start index, Markov table (prob format), duration list. Argument is the start index.
markov-rhythm.function: Picks durations from a list using a Markov transition table.

matrix12.comments: C external by Charles Baker. Outputs rows, inversions or retrogrades. Index starts at 0.
matrix12.function: Builds the 12×12 row matrix of a twelve-tone row.

max-cursor.category: Patching utilities: Max app, system & date
max-cursor.comments: Also sends its argument when the patch loads.
max-cursor.function: Hides or shows the mouse cursor.

max-menubar.category: Patching utilities: Max app, system & date
max-menubar.comments: Also sends its argument when the patch loads.
max-menubar.function: Hides or shows Max's menu bar.

max-overdrive.category: Patching utilities: Max app, system & date
max-overdrive.comments: Also sends its argument when the patch loads.
max-overdrive.function: Turns Max's Overdrive mode on or off.

max-quit.category: Patching utilities: Max app, system & date
max-quit.comments: Max still asks to save unsaved patches.
max-quit.function: Quits Max when it gets any input.

member.category: Lists & data: sorting, shuffling & set operations
member.function: Reports 1 or 0 for whether a number appears in a stored list.

metro-dev%.comments: Arguments: base period (ms) and maximum deviation (%).
metro-dev%.function: Bangs at a steady rate with random timing deviation for a human feel.

ms2sec.comments: Argument is the number of decimal places.
ms2sec.function: Converts milliseconds to seconds with set decimal places.

multiple.comments: Both lists must be the same length. A count of 0 removes that element.
multiple.function: Repeats each list element as many times as a matching count list says.

neutral-harmony.category: Pitch & frequency: pitch-class sets & harmony theory
neutral-harmony.comments: Argument is the interval (default 6). Output is pitch classes 0–11.
neutral-harmony.function: Builds pitch classes by alternating an interval with its complement.

normalize-row.function: Transposes a twelve-tone row so it starts on pitch class 0.

note2cents.function: Reports how many cents a float note is from the nearest semitone.

note2frq.function: Converts a MIDI note number, including fractions, into frequency.

note2pitch.category: Pitch & frequency: note names & pitch classes
note2pitch.function: Converts a MIDI note number into a pitch class 0–11.

note2st.comments: Argument or right inlet sets the reference note (default 60).
note2st.function: Turns a stream of notes into intervals from a reference note.

nth.category: Lists & data: get, insert & remove items
nth.comments: A list of indices outputs several elements.
nth.function: Outputs list elements by index, counting from 0.

panning.comments: By Iain Mott and Karlheinz Essl, after Chowning. Outputs control values, not audio.
panning.function: Turns one 0–127 controller into left and right equal-power gains.

pass.comments: Argument is the percentage (default 50). Seedable through RTC-seed.
pass.function: Lets a set percentage of incoming messages through at random.

pass-bang.category: Rhythm & time: delays, gates & bang logic
pass-bang.function: Lets only every nth bang through.

per2pass.comments: Helper for pass and the rhythm objects.
per2pass.function: Converts a periodicity factor 0–1 into a pass percentage.

periodic.comments: Arguments: range max and periodicity 0–1. 1 repeats one value forever, 0 never repeats.
periodic.function: Outputs random numbers whose chance of repeating is set by a factor.

permutate.comments: Each bang outputs one element. Works with numbers and symbols.
permutate.function: Plays through a list in random order without immediate repeats.

permutate-row.function: Reorders a twelve-tone row using the row itself as the reordering.

pianoteq6-player.comments: Needs a licensed Pianoteq 6. The plug-in name is fixed, so newer Pianoteq versions need editing.
pianoteq6-player.function: Plays generated notes on a Pianoteq 6 plug-in with sound controls.

pianoteq7-player.comments: Needs a licensed Pianoteq 7. The plug-in name is fixed, so newer Pianoteq versions need editing.
pianoteq7-player.function: Plays generated notes on a Pianoteq 7 plug-in with sound controls.

piece.category: Lists & data: get, insert & remove items
piece.function: Outputs the part of a list between two positions.

pitch-from-intervals.comments: Argument is the selection principle 1–3. Send intervals to the right inlet; rhythm bangs to the left.
pitch-from-intervals.function: Generates pitch classes by picking intervals from a list.

pitch-from-row-mod.comments: Webern-style row modulation. Right outlet flashes at each new transposition.
pitch-from-row-mod.function: Plays pitch classes from a row, starting each transposition on the last note.

pitch2note.category: Pitch & frequency: note names & pitch classes
pitch2note.function: Combines a pitch class and an octave into a MIDI note number.

play.comments: Arguments: velocity, duration (ms), channel. Handy one-box note output.
play.function: Plays a MIDI note with set velocity, duration, channel and device.

play-samp~.comments: Input list: speed, buffer name, gain. Negative speed plays backwards. Stereo out.
play-samp~.function: Plays one sample from a named buffer~ with speed and gain.

position.category: Lists & data: sorting, shuffling & set operations
position.function: Reorders a list using a list of indices.

random-env.comments: Arguments set the ramp and wait time limits (ms).
random-env.function: Generates random envelopes after Koenig's Sonology random envelope generator.

random-norep.comments: Argument is the range max (default 3). By Michael Gold.
random-norep.function: Outputs random integers that never repeat the previous value.

random-pan~.comments: Argument is strength 0–1; 0 turns it off. Higher values cause pitch wobble.
random-pan~.function: Turns a mono signal into pseudo-stereo with slowly varying delays.

random-ramp.comments: Each rhythm bang outputs the current value. A stop message ends it. Arguments: min and max velocity, number of values, min and max ramp time, number of ramp times.
random-ramp.function: Makes random ramps between values from a scale over random durations.

random-ramp-urn.function: Makes random ramps like random-ramp, without repeating choices.

random-rampf.function: Makes random float ramps between values over random durations.

random-rampf-urn.function: Makes random float ramps without repeating choices.

ratio.comments: Right outlet flashes when the supply is used up. Numbers only.
ratio.function: Picks list elements with no repeats, each allowed a set number of times.

ratio2intv.function: Converts a frequency ratio into an interval in semitones.

reanimate.comments: Input bangs pass through. Argument is the wait time in ms.
reanimate.function: Bangs if no input has arrived for a set time.

remove.category: Lists & data: get, insert & remove items
remove.function: Removes the element at a position from a list.

remove-dc~.function: Removes DC offset from an audio signal.

repchord-rhythm.comments: Six arguments: min and max gap, steps, max chord size, and periodicity for the shortest and longest gaps. Rich control over textures.
repchord-rhythm.function: Plays chords whose size and repeat rate depend on the chosen duration.

repeat-ED.builtin_alternative: uzi (no spacing) or metro with counter
repeat-ED.comments: Int on the left sets how many; right inlet sets the gap in ms.
crossref: Rhythm & time: delays, gates & bang logic
repeat-ED.function: Sends a set number of bangs spaced by a set time.

replace.category: Lists & data: get, insert & remove items
replace.function: Replaces the element at a position in a list.

reverse.category: Lists & data: sorting, shuffling & set operations
reverse.function: Reverses the order of a list.

rit-acc.comments: Arguments: first gap (ms) and slope; below 1 speeds up, above 1 slows down.
rit-acc.function: Plays bangs that steadily slow down or speed up.

rota.function: Cycles through a list, restarting from a reset bang.

rotate.category: Lists & data: sorting, shuffling & set operations
rotate.function: Rotates a list by a set number of positions.

roundto.function: Rounds a number to the nearest multiple of a grid value.

samp10~.function: Plays up to 10 overlapping samples from buffers.

samp20~.function: Plays up to 20 overlapping samples from buffers.

scale-changer.comments: The scale is a list of twelve 0s and 1s (1 = pitch class in use).
scale-changer.function: Changes one pitch class of a 12-slot scale at random on each bang.

schweller.comments: Arguments: start/end velocity, peak velocity, duration, and the crescendo share 0–1.
schweller.function: Generates a crescendo–decrescendo velocity hairpin over a duration.

scramble.category: Lists & data: sorting, shuffling & set operations
scramble.function: Shuffles a list into random order.

sect.category: Lists & data: sorting, shuffling & set operations
sect.function: Outputs the elements two lists have in common.

sel-princ.comments: Central hub of RTC-lib's Koenig selection principles.
sel-princ.function: Picks list elements using alea, series, sequence or rota, switchable live.
