sequence.comments: Koenig's SEQUENCE principle. Right outlet bangs at the last element.
sequence.function: Steps through a list in order on each bang, looping at the end.

serial-rhythm.comments: Arguments: min gap, max gap, number of steps.
serial-rhythm.function: Plays a rhythm using every duration of a geometric scale before repeating.

series.comments: Koenig's SERIES principle. Right outlet bangs when the list is used up and refills.
series.function: Picks random list elements without repeats until all are used.

show.function: Displays a list in a message box without passing it on.

crossref: Pitch & frequency: note names & pitch classes
show-pitchclass.function: Displays the pitch class of a MIDI note number.

slice.category: Lists & data: get, insert & remove items
slice.function: Splits a list in two after a set number of elements.

smooth-line.comments: Argument is the glide time in ms (default 1000).
smooth-line.function: Glides smoothly from the last value to each new input value.

sneak.comments: Gives smooth, stepwise motion through a list. No direct repeats.
sneak.function: Picks list elements by stepping to a neighbour each time.

sneak-random.function: Outputs random integers that always move to an adjacent value.

sneak-rhythm.comments: Gives continuous rubato. Arguments: min gap, max gap, number of steps.
sneak-rhythm.function: Plays a rhythm that moves between neighbouring durations of a scale.

sort.category: Lists & data: sorting, shuffling & set operations
sort.function: Sorts a list, ascending by default.

sqrt-pan~.comments: Pan index runs 0–1. Square-root gains also keep power constant.
sqrt-pan~.function: Pans a mono signal between two outputs with a square-root law.

st2pitch.comments: Argument is the start note (default 60). Inverse of note2st.
st2pitch.function: Adds up intervals into pitch classes and MIDI notes.

sum.function: Adds up all numbers in a list.

super-rhythm.comments: RTC-lib's most complete rhythm model. Many inlets; study the help file.
super-rhythm.function: Generates rich rhythms with chords, repeats and rubato from a duration list.

trans.comments: Arguments: start, end, steps, curve type.
trans.function: Outputs the nth step of a linear, exponential or log transition.

trans-exp.function: Outputs the nth step of an exponential transition between two values.

trans-lin.function: Outputs the nth step of a linear transition between two values.

trans-log.comments: Arguments: start, end, steps. Used by most RTC-lib rhythm objects.
trans-log.function: Outputs the nth step of a logarithmic transition between two values.

transp-pitch.category: Pitch & frequency: pitch-class sets & harmony theory
transp-pitch.function: Transposes pitch classes by an interval, wrapping within 0–11.

transpose-row.function: Transposes a list of notes and outputs pitch classes 0–11.

union.category: Lists & data: sorting, shuffling & set operations

unique.category: Lists & data: sorting, shuffling & set operations
unique.function: Outputs the elements of the left list that are not in the right list.

xrandom.comments: Refills automatically after banging. Range max must be above 1.
xrandom.function: Outputs random integers without repeats, banging when all are used.

rtt.8sequence~.comments: Global and per-sequence attributes. Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.8sequence~.function: Plays eight step sequences at once from one clock.

rtt.binary~.comments: Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.binary~.function: Makes rhythm patterns from the binary digits of a number.

rtt.blocks~.comments: Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.blocks~.function: Splits a phasor clock into unequal sub-ramps from a list of lengths.

rtt.clockin~.comments: For clocks from modular synths or triggers. Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.clockin~.function: Turns an external pulse clock into a smooth phasor clock.

rtt.clock~.comments: Usual starting point for an RTT sequencer. Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.clock~.function: Generates a phasor clock set in BPM, with start and stop.

rtt.counter~.comments: Use rtt.loop~ instead when your clock is a phasor. Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.counter~.function: Counts trigger pulses or steps, with reorder and range options.

rtt.dist~.builtin_alternative: table (bang it for a weighted random index)
rtt.dist~.comments: Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.dist~.function: Picks an index at random using a list of weights.

rtt.divs~.comments: Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.divs~.function: Subdivides successive phasor cycles by a list of amounts.

rtt.emask~.comments: Adds controlled random variation. Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.emask~.function: Makes varied gate patterns by masking one Euclidean pattern with another.

rtt.euclidean~.comments: Classic Euclidean rhythms, driven by a clock signal. Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.euclidean~.function: Spreads a number of hits evenly over a number of steps.

rtt.feel~.comments: Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.feel~.function: Bends a phasor clock with a list so timing feels loose.

rtt.loop~.comments: Use rtt.counter~ for pulse clocks instead. Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.loop~.function: Turns a phasor clock into a step counter with several counting modes.

rtt.makecc~.comments: Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.makecc~.function: Samples 0 to 1 signals and outputs MIDI control change messages.

rtt.makenote~.comments: Bridges signal-rate sequencers to MIDI gear. Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.makenote~.function: Turns trigger, pitch, velocity and duration signals into MIDI notes.

rtt.notes~.comments: Pitch-focused sibling of rtt.sequence~; pair with rtt.scala~. Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.notes~.function: Stores a note sequence and plays it back from a counter or clock.

rtt.onepulse~.category: Rhythm & time: delays, gates & bang logic
rtt.onepulse~.comments: Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.onepulse~.function: Lets one trigger through only after a reset trigger arrives.

rtt.pattern~.comments: Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.pattern~.function: Plays back a gate pattern from an index or ramp signal.

rtt.pprob~.comments: Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.pprob~.function: Makes a gate pattern from a list of per-step probabilities.

rtt.resync~.comments: For playing pattern segments or custom directions. Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.resync~.function: Makes a phasor clock jump to a new position.

rtt.retrig~.comments: Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.retrig~.function: Fires a burst of repeating pulses, like drum-machine ratchets, from one trigger.

rtt.rlogic~.category: Rhythm & time: delays, gates & bang logic
rtt.rlogic~.comments: Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.rlogic~.function: Combines two rhythm signals with AND, OR and other logic.

rtt.rprob~.comments: Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.rprob~.function: Decides step by step whether events happen, from a probability list.

rtt.scala~.comments: Pair with rtt.notes~ to play melodies in any scale. Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.scala~.function: Snaps MIDI notes to a scale loaded from a Scala file.

rtt.sequence~.builtin_alternative: stash~ (stores signal values in a buffer)
rtt.sequence~.comments: Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.sequence~.function: Stores a list of values and plays them back step by step.

rtt.snap~.builtin_alternative: snapshot~ (samples on a timer or bang)
rtt.snap~.comments: Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.snap~.function: Converts a signal to a float when it changes or on a trigger.

rtt.swing~.comments: Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.swing~.function: Bends a phasor clock to add swing or shuffle.

rtt.upright~.comments: Output also works with subdiv~ and what~. Made with RNBO. A matching UI module lives in the package's patchers/modules folder.
rtt.upright~.function: Turns any signal into a phasor-style clock.

sadam.base64.category: Lists & data: bytes, encodings & buffer conversion
sadam.base64.comments: Pair with sadam.lzo to store or send binary data as text.
sadam.base64.function: Encodes or decodes a symbol as base64 text.

sadam.canvas.function: Vector drawing canvas with movable layers and a grid.

sadam.dom.comments: A Java (mxj) class, not a native external: the box text is mxj sadam.dom. Needs Java support in Max. sadam.rapidXML does the same job natively.
sadam.dom.function: Reads, edits and writes XML as a tree.

sadam.empty.function: Detects empty symbols and can output one.

sadam.envelopeGenerator.builtin_alternative: function — draw the envelope by hand
sadam.envelopeGenerator.function: Makes breakpoints for a function object from an expr-style formula.

sadam.float.builtin_alternative: float — no NaN or infinity checks
sadam.float.function: Stores a float and flags NaN or infinite values.

sadam.fromBytes.category: Lists & data: bytes, encodings & buffer conversion
sadam.fromBytes.comments: Sets endianness; pairs with the sadam network objects.
sadam.fromBytes.function: Converts a list of bytes into integers or floats.

sadam.gcd.function: Finds the greatest common divisor of two integers.

sadam.interpol.function: Interpolates or extrapolates values from a set of points, many methods.

sadam.lcm.comments: CNMAT's lcm accepts more than two integers.
sadam.lcm.function: Finds the least common multiple of two integers.

sadam.limits.function: Outputs the smallest and largest values Max numbers can hold.

sadam.lzo.category: Lists & data: bytes, encodings & buffer conversion
sadam.lzo.comments: GPL-licensed; output may hold odd characters, so encode with sadam.base64 before saving or sending.
sadam.lzo.function: Compresses or decompresses any message without loss.

sadam.mutex.comments: One instance locks, another with the releaser argument unlocks.
sadam.mutex.function: Named lock that blocks messages while a shared resource is in use.

sadam.normalize~.function: Scales a signal to match a target level or a reference signal's level.

sadam.onebang.function: Bangs once every control inlet has received something; reset on the right.

sadam.phasor~.function: phasor~ that finishes its ramp to 1 when frequency is set to 0.

sadam.prime.function: Tests whether a number is prime and finds nearby primes and factors.

sadam.rand~.function: Smooth random signal with sine-shaped steps between values.

sadam.rapidXML.function: Fast native XML reader and editor that addresses elements by index.

sadam.sax.comments: A Java (mxj) class, not a native external: the box text is mxj sadam.sax. Needs Java support in Max.
sadam.sax.function: Streams an XML file's elements out one at a time.

sadam.sgn~.function: Outputs 1 or -1 depending on the sign of a signal.

sadam.sortLists.builtin_alternative: zl.sort — sorts one list; right outlet gives the new order
sadam.sortLists.category: Lists & data: sorting, shuffling & set operations
sadam.sortLists.function: Sorts several lists together by one key list, like spreadsheet rows.

sadam.split.function: Routes numbers to outlets by a set of breakpoint ranges.

sadam.standardMap~.comments: A paper on it ships in the package's misc folder.
sadam.standardMap~.function: Chaotic oscillator based on Chirikov's Standard Map.

sadam.stat.comments: With a size argument it uses only the last N values.
sadam.stat.function: Running mean, standard deviation, minimum and maximum of numbers.

sadam.stream.comments: The sadam network objects can read and write it directly.
sadam.stream.function: Named shared byte buffer for binary device and network data.

sadam.tcpClient.builtin_alternative: node.script — write a TCP client in Node
sadam.tcpClient.comments: Bytes only (0–255); convert with sadam.toBytes and sadam.fromBytes.
sadam.tcpClient.function: TCP client that sends and receives raw bytes.

sadam.tcpReceiver.function: Listens on a TCP port and outputs received bytes.

sadam.tcpSender.function: Sends bytes over TCP, opening a new connection per message.

sadam.tcpServer.builtin_alternative: node.script — write a TCP server in Node
sadam.tcpServer.function: TCP server that sends and receives raw bytes.

sadam.toBytes.category: Lists & data: bytes, encodings & buffer conversion
sadam.toBytes.comments: Sets endianness; pairs with the sadam network objects.
sadam.toBytes.function: Converts numbers into a list of bytes.

sadam.udpClient.builtin_alternative: udpsend / udpreceive — Max messages as OSC, not raw bytes
sadam.udpClient.function: Sends and receives raw UDP bytes from a fixed local port.

sadam.udpReceiver.builtin_alternative: udpreceive — decodes OSC into Max messages
sadam.udpReceiver.comments: Useful for devices that send non-OSC binary data.
sadam.udpReceiver.function: Receives UDP packets and outputs them as bytes.

sadam.udpSender.builtin_alternative: udpsend — sends Max messages as OSC

samplor2.kg.comments: Can import MachFive presets. Mac only.
samplor2.kg.function: Maps MIDI notes and velocities to key groups for samplor3~.

samplor3~.comments: Mac only (no Windows version). Play with a list or play message; adsr sets envelopes. Argument 1 sets outputs, 2 sets voices.
samplor3~.function: Plays many samples at once with envelopes, loops and voice stealing.

sdt.bouncing~.comments: Bang to drop. Control layer only: needs sdt.inertial, sdt.impact~ and sdt.modal set up with matching names.
sdt.bouncing~.function: Generates the impact timing of a bouncing object for a solid-body model.

sdt.breaking~.comments: Bang to break. Control layer only: needs sdt.inertial, sdt.impact~ and sdt.modal set up with matching names.
sdt.breaking~.function: Generates impact and fragment events for breaking or shattering sounds.

sdt.bubble~.comments: Bang for one bubble. Works on its own; use sdt.fluidflow~ for many.
sdt.bubble~.function: Synthesizes a single bubble pop, with size and pitch rise.

sdt.crumpling~.comments: Control layer only: needs sdt.inertial, sdt.impact~ and sdt.modal set up with matching names.
sdt.crumpling~.function: Generates a random stream of small impacts for crumpling or crushing sounds.

sdt.dcmotor~.comments: Self-contained. Inputs are RPM and load signals.
sdt.dcmotor~.function: Synthesizes an electric motor sound from speed and load signals.

sdt.demix~.comments: Three outlets, so each part can be processed separately. No built-in Max object does this split.
sdt.demix~.function: Splits audio into transient, tonal and noisy parts.

sdt.envelope~.builtin_alternative: slide~ on abs~ (separate up and down times)
sdt.envelope~.function: Follows a signal's amplitude with separate attack and release times.

sdt.explosion~.comments: Bang to fire. Default delay buffers are large, about 100 seconds each.
sdt.explosion~.function: Synthesizes a supersonic blast with distance and wind controls.

sdt.fluidflow~.function: Synthesizes dripping, streaming or pouring water from many random bubbles.

sdt.friction~.comments: Arguments required: two object names and an outlet count. Needs sdt.inertial or sdt.modal objects with those names.
sdt.friction~.function: Models rubbing between two named solid objects, like a squeaky hinge.

sdt.impact~.comments: Central SDT interactor. Arguments required: two object names and an outlet count, matching sdt.inertial or sdt.modal objects.
sdt.impact~.function: Models a collision between two named solid objects.

sdt.inertial.comments: Makes no sound alone. Needs a unique name argument; use the strike message to hit.
sdt.inertial.function: Defines a simple mass that strikes or rubs a resonator.

sdt.modal.comments: Makes no sound alone: sdt.impact~ or sdt.friction~ excite it. Arguments required: name, mode count, pickup count.
sdt.modal.function: Defines a resonating object by its mode frequencies and decay times.

sdt.motor~.comments: Many engine-shape attributes: cylinders, stroke cycle, exhaust, muffler.
sdt.motor~.function: Synthesizes a combustion engine sound from RPM and throttle signals.

sdt.myo~.comments: Built for voice-driven sound design research. It is not a general voice activity detector.
sdt.myo~.function: Detects non-voiced vocal sounds such as vocal fry and lip trills.

sdt.pitchshift~.category: Audio effects: pitch shift & time stretch
sdt.pitchshift~.function: Shifts pitch with an FFT, from 0.125 to 8 times.

sdt.pitch~.function: Estimates the pitch of a signal and how clear that pitch is.

sdt.reverb~.comments: Meant to add scatter to SDT models; cheap on CPU.
sdt.reverb~.function: Adds a light, diffuse room reverb set by room size.

sdt.rolling~.comments: Control layer only: needs sdt.inertial, sdt.impact~ and sdt.modal set up with matching names.
sdt.rolling~.function: Generates a rolling object's micro-impacts from a surface signal.

sdt.scraping~.comments: Control layer for sdt.impact~ or sdt.friction~, with at least one sdt.modal.
sdt.scraping~.function: Generates the force of a probe sliding over a surface from a surface signal.

sdt.spectralfeats~.function: Measures centroid, spread, flatness, flux and other spectral features at once.

sdt.windcavity~.comments: Signal input is wind speed 0 to 1; length and diameter set the tone.
sdt.windcavity~.function: Synthesizes wind howling through a pipe or tunnel.

sdt.windflow~.function: Synthesizes plain wind noise from a wind speed signal.

sdt.windkarman~.comments: Input is wind speed 0 to 1; diameter sets the pitch.
sdt.windkarman~.function: Synthesizes whistling wind around a thin wire or branch.

sdt.zerox~.function: Measures how often a signal crosses zero, as a rough noisiness value.

jit.gl.syphonclient.comments: Mac only; on Windows use the Spout package. Pick a source with the servername or appname message; getavailableservers lists them. Needs a GL context such as jit.world. Supports alpha.
jit.gl.syphonclient.function: Receives live video textures that another Mac app shares over Syphon.

jit.gl.syphonserver.comments: Mac only; Spout is the Windows counterpart. Set the published name with servername. Frames flow even when the window is hidden. The rate you drive it at also sets the clients' frame rate.
jit.gl.syphonserver.function: Shares a Jitter texture or matrix with other Mac apps over Syphon.

ts.4to1Switch.builtin_alternative: selector~ — picks an input by number, not by counting gates
ts.4to1Switch.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). The last inlet sets how many gates pass before it switches.
ts.4to1Switch.function: Steps through four input signals, switching after a set number of gates.

ts.CV.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Clock-driven; outputs raw and smoothed CV.
ts.CV.function: Sequences stepped control signals in several playback directions.

ts.DrumSeq.builtin_alternative: bp.Drum Sequencer — BEAP drum sequencer sending MIDI
ts.DrumSeq.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Clock input required.
ts.DrumSeq.function: Sequences six drum gate channels with a chance per step.

ts.aKastle.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Pitch inputs are 1V/oct-style signals.
ts.aKastle.function: Generates FM tones from two voices with six routing algorithms.

ts.ad.function: Generates an attack/decay envelope with adjustable curves from a gate.

ts.adsr.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Also outputs the gate.
ts.adsr.function: Generates an ADSR envelope signal from a gate.

ts.attenuverter.builtin_alternative: bp.Gain and Bias — BEAP gain and offset module
ts.attenuverter.function: Scales a signal down or flips its polarity.

ts.beatrepeat.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Syncs to Max tempo or an external clock.
ts.beatrepeat.function: Loops a slice of incoming audio in time with a clock, with pitch change.

ts.biToUni.function: Converts a -1 to 1 signal into a 0 to 1 signal.

ts.biquad.builtin_alternative: filtercoeff~ — feeds biquad~ with modulatable coefficients
ts.biquad.function: Filters a mono signal with a selectable biquad filter.

ts.clave.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Based on a Sound on Sound synthesis article. Trigger input.
ts.clave.function: Synthesizes a clave hit modeled on the Roland CR-8000.

ts.clockMini.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular > Clock). File is ts.clockMini.maxpat; the help file is ts.clock. Can follow Max's global tempo.
ts.clockMini.function: Generates clock gates with multiplication, phase, width and external sync.

ts.clockdiv.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular > Clock). File is ts.clockdiv.maxpat. Help says divide by 2, 4, 6, 8; outlets say 2, 4, 8, 16.
ts.clockdiv.function: Divides an incoming clock into slower clocks.

ts.clockmult.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular > Clock). File is ts.clockmult.maxpat. Outlets say ×2, 4, 8, 16.
ts.clockmult.function: Multiplies an incoming clock into faster clocks.

ts.complexOsc.function: Generates rich tones from two cross-modulating oscillators with wavefolding.

ts.crazyClock.function: Generates clock gates at a Hz rate with random spread.

ts.cymbal.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Based on a Sound on Sound article. Most parameters take modulation.
ts.cymbal.function: Synthesizes cymbal sounds from FM and noise.

ts.dadsr.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Delay can sync to Max's tempo.
ts.dadsr.function: Generates an ADSR envelope after a delay from the gate.

ts.delayUnit.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Separate odd and even tap outputs; can sync to a clock.
ts.delayUnit.function: Delays audio through eight taps with per-tap volume and feedback pitch shift.

ts.drumModule.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Includes filter and pitch envelopes.
ts.drumModule.function: Plays drum hits from an oscillator, noise and a loaded sample.

ts.euclideanSeq.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Clock input required; ratcheting and gate length per step.
ts.euclideanSeq.function: Sequences gates with evenly spread (Euclidean) hits and rotation.

ts.euscale.function: Builds scales by Euclidean distribution and quantizes up to four melodies to them.

ts.feedback.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Feedback delay equals the signal vector size; smaller is tighter.
ts.feedback.function: Lets you patch a module's output back into an earlier module.

ts.fmPerc.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). External modulation only updates when the module is gated.
ts.fmPerc.function: Synthesizes percussive FM sounds with two envelopes and feedback.

ts.freqShift.function: Shifts stereo audio frequencies with feedback and up/down outputs.

ts.fromBEAP.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Pair with ts.toBEAP.
ts.fromBEAP.function: Converts BEAP's -5 to 5 signal range into TS.Modular's -1 to 1.

ts.function.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Can quantize to Max's tempo.
ts.function.function: Generates rise/fall function shapes, once or cycling.

ts.gateDelay.category: Rhythm & time: delays, gates & bang logic
ts.gateDelay.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Can quantize to Max's tempo.
ts.gateDelay.function: Delays incoming gates by a set time.

ts.gateLogic.function: Combines two gate signals with AND, NAND, OR and XOR.

ts.gater.category: Audio I/O: gain, mixers & channel strips
ts.gater.function: Toggles a signal on and off with each incoming gate.

ts.granTapDelay.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Reverse mode; tempo sync.
ts.granTapDelay.function: Delays stereo audio through grain taps with panning and pitch shift.

ts.granulatorRealTime.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Outputs grain envelope and trigger too.
ts.granulatorRealTime.function: Granulates live input with randomized grain parameters.

ts.harmonicOsc.function: Generates tones by mixing eight harmonics, with odd and even outputs.

ts.hihat.function: Synthesizes metallic hi-hats in the style of the TR-808.

ts.inADC.category: Audio I/O: hardware inputs, outputs & audio settings
ts.inADC.function: Brings eight audio inputs into a TS.Modular patch.

ts.karplus.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Each pluck gets a random stereo position.
ts.karplus.function: Plucks Karplus-Strong strings as chords or random notes.

ts.kick.function: Synthesizes kick drums with pitch envelope, FM and filters.

ts.matematika.function: Sums, inverts and multiplies four signals, each attenuated.

ts.metroSeq.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Clock input required.
ts.metroSeq.function: Sequences gates and CV with chance, step hold and gate length.

ts.modMatrix.builtin_alternative: matrix~ — signal routing and mixing matrix
ts.modMatrix.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). A gate input randomizes the matrix.
ts.modMatrix.function: Routes four signals through a randomizable matrix with comparisons.

ts.morphi.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Seven wavetable banks included; you can load your own.
ts.morphi.function: Morphs through 2D wavetables with internal FM.

ts.multichannelRecorder.builtin_alternative: mc.sfrecord~ — records multichannel audio to disk
ts.multichannelRecorder.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Records what ts.outDAC modules send to recorder channels 1–8, by global send~ names, without patch cords.
ts.multichannelRecorder.function: Records multichannel WAV files from the patch.

ts.negFlooring.function: Pushes the negative half of a signal toward -1.

ts.octShift.function: Shifts a pitch signal up or down by octaves.

ts.outDAC.category: Audio I/O: hardware inputs, outputs & audio settings
ts.outDAC.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Also feeds the package's recorders.
ts.outDAC.function: Sends stereo audio to the speakers with pan, volume and recorder sends.

ts.phasor.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Named 'phasor' but it is a phaser effect, not the phasor~ ramp.
ts.phasor.function: Adds a stereo phaser effect with its own LFO.

ts.probabilityGate.category: Rhythm & time: delays, gates & bang logic
ts.probabilityGate.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular > Clock). File is ts.probabilityGate.maxpat. Has an internal clock.
ts.probabilityGate.function: Routes each clock pulse to one of two outputs by chance.

ts.randLFO.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). New values can be triggered by an external gate.
ts.randLFO.function: Generates random stepped or smoothed control signals.

ts.randSmoothLFO.function: Generates a smooth random control signal.

ts.randomMetallizer.function: Runs audio through a chain of randomly timed delays for metallic tones.

ts.ratchetSeq.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Clock input required.
ts.ratchetSeq.function: Sequences gates and CV with chance, gate length and ratcheting.

ts.rect.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Pitch input is 1V/oct-style.
ts.rect.function: Generates an antialiased pulse wave with FM and sync.

ts.rotateClock.function: Cycles through six clock multiplications as a sequence.

ts.sai.function: Generates four morphing oscillator voices combined by algorithm.

ts.sampleHold.builtin_alternative: sah~ — sample and hold a signal
ts.sampleHold.function: Samples a signal when triggered and holds the value.

ts.sampler.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Drop a folder to auto-populate; each gate can pick a new file.
ts.sampler.function: Plays samples from a folder at random, with separate left and right pitch.

ts.saturation.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Algorithms include rectification, arctan, exponential and diode.
ts.saturation.function: Saturates stereo audio with several distortion formulas.

ts.scaler.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular > Quantizers). File is ts.scaler.maxpat.
ts.scaler.function: Quantizes pitch signals or MIDI notes to a custom scale.

ts.simpleDelay.function: Delays stereo audio with separate left and right times and feedback.

ts.simpleFM.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Built on the simpleFM~ abstraction from Max's old MSP tutorials.
ts.simpleFM.function: Plays a two-operator FM voice with an AD envelope.

ts.simpleLFOs.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Sine, triangle, square, ramps and random; tempo sync option.
ts.simpleLFOs.function: Generates six synced LFO shapes at once.

ts.sine.function: Generates a sine wave with FM input.

ts.sineLFO.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Can sync to Max's tempo.
ts.sineLFO.function: Generates a slow sine control signal.

ts.snare.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Based on a Sound on Sound article. Nearly all parameters take modulation.
ts.snare.function: Synthesizes snare drums from tone and noise.

ts.spectralResonator.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Based on Mutable Instruments filter code, co-made with Volker Böhm.
ts.spectralResonator.function: Resonates audio through seven tuned filters spread from one pitch.

ts.stereoBiquad.builtin_alternative: filtercoeff~ — feeds biquad~ with modulatable coefficients
ts.stereoBiquad.function: Filters a stereo signal with a selectable biquad filter.

ts.stereoRecorder.builtin_alternative: sfrecord~ — record to audio file on disk
ts.stereoRecorder.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Records recorder channel 1 sent by ts.outDAC, by global send~ names.
ts.stereoRecorder.function: Records stereo WAV files from the patch.

ts.strangeVerb.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Changing diffusion re-randomizes all delay times.
ts.strangeVerb.function: Makes an unusual reverb from many randomly timed delays.

ts.tanhOsc.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Includes a wavefolder.
ts.tanhOsc.function: Generates tones by combining two oscillators through math functions.

ts.toBEAP.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Pair with ts.fromBEAP.
ts.toBEAP.function: Converts TS.Modular's -1 to 1 signals to BEAP's -5 to 5 range.

ts.triangle.function: Generates an antialiased triangle wave with FM and sync.

ts.uniToBi.function: Converts a 0 to 1 signal into a -1 to 1 signal.

ts.vca.category: Audio I/O: gain, mixers & channel strips
ts.vca.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Unipolar CV for envelopes, bipolar for amplitude modulation.
ts.vca.function: Controls a signal's level from a control signal.

ts.vertecho.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular > FX). File is ts.vertecho.maxpat.
ts.vertecho.function: Delays stereo audio with uneven left/right times and a feedback filter.

ts.wavefolder.function: Folds a signal back on itself for bright harmonics.

ts.waveshaper.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Based on the Max waveshaping tutorial.
ts.waveshaper.function: Reshapes audio through a hand-drawn transfer table.

ts.wavetableRandomLFO.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular). Load your own wavetable or pick a preset bank.
ts.wavetableRandomLFO.function: Generates a random control signal read from a wavetable.

ts.xyz.comments: Bpatcher module (Paste From > TS.Modular > Sequencers). File is ts.xyz.maxpat. Its help says it was inspired by MN Rene.
ts.xyz.function: Sequences notes along snake-shaped paths through a grid.

och.hset.comments: Part of Quantum-computing Aided Composition; only useful with och.microqiskit.
och.hset.function: Writes Hadamard gate instructions for a range of qubits.

och.identitymatrix.function: Generates an identity matrix as a list.

och.int2qc.comments: Part of Quantum-computing Aided Composition; only useful with och.microqiskit.
och.int2qc.function: Writes the X gates that encode a number into qubits.

och.microqiskit.comments: Create circuits with QuantumCircuit and Simulator messages. Output is measurement counts. The qubit_cap attribute limits simulation size.
och.microqiskit.function: Builds and simulates small quantum circuits for composing.

och.mset.comments: Part of Quantum-computing Aided Composition; only useful with och.microqiskit.
och.mset.function: Writes measure gate instructions for a range of qubits.

och.mtos.builtin_alternative: number (display-only note names via its format attribute)
och.mtos.category: Pitch & frequency: note names & pitch classes
och.mtos.comments: c4mode 1 names middle C as C4.
och.mtos.function: Converts MIDI note numbers to note names like C3.

och.qubits2states.function: Calculates how many states a number of qubits can represent.

och.states2qubits.function: Calculates how many qubits are needed for a number of states.

och.topcount.comments: Part of Quantum-computing Aided Composition; only useful with och.microqiskit.
och.topcount.function: Picks the most frequent result from och.microqiskit counts.

och.xset.comments: Part of Quantum-computing Aided Composition; only useful with och.microqiskit.
och.xset.function: Writes X gate instructions for a range of qubits.

upshot_16chanpanner.builtin_alternative: mc.mixdown~ — pans multichannel signals to any output count
upshot_16chanpanner.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.16chanpanner in Upshot/clippings/ROUTING. Controls take 0–127. Position is an endless rotary; uses an equal-power lookup curve.
upshot_16chanpanner.function: Pans stereo audio around 16 speakers in a circle with one control.

upshot_1bitprobability.builtin_alternative: random — combine with a comparison to get the same result
upshot_1bitprobability.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.1bitprobability in Upshot/clippings/MISC. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_1bitprobability.function: Outputs 0 or 1 on each bang, with a set chance of 1.

upshot_2chanpanner.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.2chanpanner in Upshot/clippings/ROUTING. Controls take 0–127. Reset inlet recenters.
upshot_2chanpanner.function: Pans a stereo signal left and right.

upshot_4chanpanner.builtin_alternative: mc.mixdown~ — pans multichannel signals to any output count
upshot_4chanpanner.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.4chanpanner in Upshot/clippings/ROUTING. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_4chanpanner.function: Pans stereo audio around four speakers in a circle.

upshot_7bitprobability.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.7bitprobability in Upshot/clippings/MISC. Controls take 0–127. Draw the probability for each value 0–127 in the itable.
upshot_7bitprobability.function: Outputs 0 or 1, with the chance set per input value in a drawn table.

upshot_8chanmonomixer.builtin_alternative: matrix~ — routing and mixing matrix without a front panel
upshot_8chanmonomixer.category: Audio I/O: gain, mixers & channel strips
upshot_8chanmonomixer.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.8chanmonomixer in Upshot/clippings/ROUTING. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_8chanmonomixer.function: Mixes eight mono inputs with volume and output routing per channel.

upshot_8chanpanner.builtin_alternative: mc.mixdown~ — pans multichannel signals to any output count
upshot_8chanpanner.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.8chanpanner in Upshot/clippings/ROUTING. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_8chanpanner.function: Pans stereo audio around eight speakers in a circle.

upshot_8chanstereomixer.builtin_alternative: matrix~ — routing and mixing matrix without a front panel
upshot_8chanstereomixer.category: Audio I/O: gain, mixers & channel strips
upshot_8chanstereomixer.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.8chanstereomixer in Upshot/clippings/ROUTING. Controls take 0–127. 24 inlets, 16 outlets.
upshot_8chanstereomixer.function: Mixes eight stereo inputs with volume and output routing per channel.

upshot_8x8matrix.builtin_alternative: matrix~ — same routing, set by messages
upshot_8x8matrix.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.8x8matrix in Upshot/clippings/ROUTING. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_8x8matrix.function: Routes eight audio inputs to eight outputs with menus.

upshot_alpha.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.alpha in Upshot/clippings/MISC. Controls take 0–127. Use headphones.
upshot_alpha.function: Generates binaural beats from two slightly detuned tones.

upshot_amplitudefollower.builtin_alternative: peakamp~ — reports peak amplitude, no smoothing or scaling
upshot_amplitudefollower.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.amplitudefollower in Upshot/clippings/TRACKING. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_amplitudefollower.function: Tracks the loudness of an audio signal as a 0–127 value.

upshot_artefacts.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.artefacts in Upshot/clippings/INSTRUMENTS. Controls take 0–127. Smaller I/O vector sizes allow shorter artefacts.
upshot_artefacts.function: Records audio and plays back short clicks and pops from it by MIDI note.

upshot_attackdetection.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.attackdetection in Upshot/clippings/TRACKING. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_attackdetection.function: Bangs when an audio signal's attack crosses a sensitivity threshold.

upshot_audiofileplayer.builtin_alternative: playlist~ — file player with its own interface
upshot_audiofileplayer.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.audiofileplayer in Upshot/clippings/MISC. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_audiofileplayer.function: Plays a sound file with play, pause, loop and volume controls.

upshot_audiofootswitch.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.audiofootswitch in Upshot/clippings/MISC. Controls take 0–127. Adjust sensitivity and input gain to find the sweet spot.
upshot_audiofootswitch.function: Turns a footswitch plugged into an audio input into triggers.

upshot_autocontrol.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.autocontrol in Upshot/clippings/GENERATORS. Controls take 0–127. Set interval and probability; switch between external and automatic triggering.
upshot_autocontrol.function: Outputs bangs, toggles or random values at random times.

upshot_autotune.builtin_alternative: retune~ — the same pitch correction engine
upshot_autotune.category: Audio effects: pitch shift & time stretch
upshot_autotune.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.autotune in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_autotune.function: Pitch-corrects audio toward a chosen scale.

upshot_beams.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.beams in Upshot/clippings/SEQUENCERS. Controls take 0–127. Outputs note lists and bangs; follows Max's transport.
upshot_beams.function: Generates rhythms by weighting how often each note value occurs.

upshot_bitcrusher.builtin_alternative: degrade~ — same effect; abl.device.redux~ is a fuller version
upshot_bitcrusher.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.bitcrusher in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_bitcrusher.function: Reduces sample rate for a lo-fi, crunchy sound.

upshot_blobtracking.category: Computer vision: motion, tracking & optical flow
upshot_blobtracking.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.blobtracking in Upshot/clippings/TRACKING. Controls take 0–127. Requires the cv.jit package. Outputs 0–127 per blob.
upshot_blobtracking.function: Tracks up to five moving blobs in a camera image as XY and size.

upshot_bursts.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.bursts in Upshot/clippings/GENERATORS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_bursts.function: Generates a stream of numbers that bursts upward by chance.

upshot_chordmorpher.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.chordmorpher in Upshot/clippings/INSTRUMENTS. Controls take 0–127. Takes MIDI notes; bangs when a morph completes.
upshot_chordmorpher.function: Plays chords that glide from one to the next over time.

upshot_chords.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.chords in Upshot/clippings/MIDI. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_chords.function: Turns a single MIDI note into a chosen chord.

upshot_clicker.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.clicker in Upshot/clippings/INSTRUMENTS. Controls take 0–127. 20 inlets: each sound has trigger, resonance and pan.
upshot_clicker.function: Plays kick, clicks and impulse sounds from bangs.

upshot_collatz.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.collatz in Upshot/clippings/SEQUENCERS. Controls take 0–127. Uneven, irregular rhythms; scale and root inputs.
upshot_collatz.function: Generates notes from Collatz number sequences.

upshot_collide.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.collide in Upshot/clippings/SEQUENCERS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_collide.function: Generates notes and bangs like a Newton's cradle on a grid.

upshot_colortracking.builtin_alternative: jit.findbounds — finds the bounds of a color range
upshot_colortracking.category: Computer vision: motion, tracking & optical flow
upshot_colortracking.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.colortracking in Upshot/clippings/TRACKING. Controls take 0–127. Click a color in the video window to start.
upshot_colortracking.function: Tracks a clicked color in a camera image as position and width.

upshot_compare.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.compare in Upshot/clippings/MISC. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_compare.function: Bangs when an input is less than, equal to, or greater than a value.

upshot_compressor.builtin_alternative: omx.comp~ — full compressor with more controls
upshot_compressor.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.compressor in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127. Based on Max's 'Simple Compressor' example.
upshot_compressor.function: Compresses a stereo signal with threshold and bypass.

upshot_cues.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.cues in Upshot/clippings/GENERATORS. Controls take 0–127. Split the outputs with route using the instance number.
upshot_cues.function: Fires up to 100 programmed events at set bars, beats or bang counts.

upshot_delay.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.delay in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127. Uses M4L.dl.vdelay~, which ships with Max.
upshot_delay.function: Adds a stereo multi-tap delay with feedback.

upshot_density.category: Rhythm & time: delays, gates & bang logic
upshot_density.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.density in Upshot/clippings/TRACKING. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_density.function: Measures how densely bangs are arriving and outputs 0–127.

upshot_distortion.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.distortion in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_distortion.function: Distorts stereo audio with tanh soft clipping.

upshot_divisions.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.divisions in Upshot/clippings/SEQUENCERS. Controls take 0–127. Up to 24 tuplet types over an adjustable number of beats.
upshot_divisions.function: Plays Euclidean-style tuplet rhythms locked to Max's transport.

upshot_draw.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.draw in Upshot/clippings/TRACKING. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_draw.function: Turns drawing on a canvas into sound and MIDI notes.

upshot_dynamicstutter.builtin_alternative: stutter~ — signal capture buffer for stutter playback
upshot_dynamicstutter.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.dynamicstutter in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_dynamicstutter.function: Captures audio and stutters loops of it on command.

upshot_easyarp.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.easyarp in Upshot/clippings/SEQUENCERS. Controls take 0–127. Monophonic.
upshot_easyarp.function: Arpeggiates held MIDI notes with chord, direction and octave settings.

upshot_easyverb.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.easyverb in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127. Built on a copy of the yafr2 reverb abstraction.
upshot_easyverb.function: Adds a basic stereo reverb with a single decay control.

upshot_echo.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.echo in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_echo.function: Adds a single-tap delay with tempo-synced timing.

upshot_echternach.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.echternach in Upshot/clippings/SEQUENCERS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_echternach.function: Sequences notes three steps forward, two steps back.

upshot_endlessreverb.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.endlessreverb in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127. Grab/release inlet plus fade time.
upshot_endlessreverb.function: Freezes incoming sound into an endless reverb tail.

upshot_envelope.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.envelope in Upshot/clippings/GENERATORS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_envelope.function: Draws and plays envelopes as 0–127 control values.

upshot_fauxstereo.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.fauxstereo in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_fauxstereo.function: Makes a wide stereo signal from mono by delaying one side.

upshot_filter.builtin_alternative: filtergraph~ — the same filter editor, feeding biquad~
upshot_filter.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.filter in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_filter.function: Filters stereo audio with a graphical filter type and cutoff.

upshot_freeze.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.freeze in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127. Based on Jean-François Charles's stochastic freeze.
upshot_freeze.function: Freezes the sound into a sustained spectral texture.

upshot_gameoflife.builtin_alternative: jit.conway — plays the Game of Life on a matrix
upshot_gameoflife.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.gameoflife in Upshot/clippings/GENERATORS. Controls take 0–127. Spacebar spawns or stops life.
upshot_gameoflife.function: Triggers eight event slots from Conway's Game of Life.

upshot_gate.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.gate in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_gate.function: Silences stereo audio below a threshold (noise gate).

upshot_glitch.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.glitch in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_glitch.function: Generates glitchy stereo noise by chopping and degrading recorded input.

upshot_glitchchorus.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.glitchchorus in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_glitchchorus.function: Turns a chorus into a glitch generator with extreme settings.

upshot_glitchlooper.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.glitchlooper in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_glitchlooper.function: Loops recorded audio with automatically shifting playback ranges.

upshot_granular.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.granulator in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127. File is upshot_granular.maxpat.
upshot_granular.function: Granulates incoming audio into clouds of short grains.

upshot_harmonizer.category: Audio effects: pitch shift & time stretch
upshot_harmonizer.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.harmonizer in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127. Adapted from Cycling '74's M4L Multi Harmonizer.
upshot_harmonizer.function: Adds pitch-shifted harmony voices chosen with a keyboard.

upshot_hold.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.hold in Upshot/clippings/MIDI. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_hold.function: Sends sustain pedal (CC 64) on/off messages to a MIDI device.

upshot_input.category: Audio I/O: hardware inputs, outputs & audio settings
upshot_input.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.input in Upshot/clippings/ROUTING. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_input.function: Selects an audio input channel and sets its volume.

upshot_kitt.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.kitt in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_kitt.function: Records audio and plays it back bouncing forward and backward.

upshot_limiter.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.limiter in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_limiter.function: Limits stereo peaks with input, threshold and output levels.

upshot_looper.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.looper in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127. Its digest wrongly says 'Filter audio effect'. 15 inlets.
upshot_looper.function: Records and loops audio with stretching, pitch shift and randomizing.

upshot_lpcontrol.category: Gesture & hardware: MIDI, grid & touch controllers
upshot_lpcontrol.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.launchpadcontrol in Upshot/clippings/MIDI. Controls take 0–127. Tested with Launchpad S, Mini and Mini MK3. File is upshot_lpcontrol.maxpat.
upshot_lpcontrol.function: Turns a Novation Launchpad into sliders, pads, XY pads and a keyboard.

upshot_manualarp.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.manualarp in Upshot/clippings/MIDI. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_manualarp.function: Steps through a chosen chord built on an incoming note.

upshot_many2one.category: Gesture & hardware: MIDI, grid & touch controllers
upshot_many2one.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.many2one in Upshot/clippings/MIDI. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_many2one.function: Combines five controllers into one MIDI CC output.

upshot_mapping.builtin_alternative: mappings — enable and manage Max's mapping from a patch
upshot_mapping.category: Gesture & hardware: MIDI, grid & touch controllers
upshot_mapping.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.mapping in Upshot/clippings/MIDI. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_mapping.function: Opens Max's MIDI and keyboard mapping for Upshot controls.

upshot_microlooper.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.microlooper in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_microlooper.function: Loops tiny 20–500 ms slices of audio to build textures.

upshot_midifileplayer.builtin_alternative: seq — records and plays MIDI files
upshot_midifileplayer.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.midifileplayer in Upshot/clippings/MIDI. Controls take 0–127. Send read filename.mid.
upshot_midifileplayer.function: Plays a MIDI file as note output at a set tempo.

upshot_midifootswitch.category: Gesture & hardware: MIDI, grid & touch controllers
upshot_midifootswitch.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.midifootswitch in Upshot/clippings/MIDI. Controls take 0–127. Listens to CC 64 by default.
upshot_midifootswitch.function: Turns a sustain-style MIDI footswitch into a 0–127 value.

upshot_monosynth.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.monosynth in Upshot/clippings/INSTRUMENTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_monosynth.function: Plays a simple monophonic synth with choice of waveform and portamento.

upshot_morse.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.morse in Upshot/clippings/SEQUENCERS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_morse.function: Turns typed text into Morse code rhythms, notes and tones.

upshot_musicaltyping.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.musicaltyping in Upshot/clippings/MISC. Controls take 0–127.
crossref: Gesture & hardware: computer keyboard, mouse & game controllers
upshot_musicaltyping.function: Plays synth notes from the computer keyboard, shaped by mouse position.

upshot_nodes.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.nodes in Upshot/clippings/GENERATORS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_nodes.function: Generates up to eight envelopes by moving a point through nodes.

upshot_noisegenerator.builtin_alternative: noise~ — white noise; pink~ for pink noise
upshot_noisegenerator.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.noise in Upshot/clippings/MISC. Controls take 0–127. File is upshot_noisegenerator.maxpat.
upshot_noisegenerator.function: Generates white or pink noise with a filter.

upshot_output.category: Audio I/O: hardware inputs, outputs & audio settings
upshot_output.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.output in Upshot/clippings/ROUTING. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_output.function: Sends up to 16 channels to the audio device with one volume.

upshot_patterns.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.patterns in Upshot/clippings/SEQUENCERS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_patterns.function: Sequences note patterns in a tracker-style grid.

upshot_peacefulpiano.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.peacefulpiano in Upshot/clippings/INSTRUMENTS. Controls take 0–127. A generative demo; needs a piano instrument on the MIDI output.
upshot_peacefulpiano.function: Generates gentle piano music as MIDI output.

upshot_phaselooper.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.phaselooper in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_phaselooper.function: Loops a recording with one channel drifting ahead, like Reich's tape phasing.

upshot_phaselope.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.phaselope in Upshot/clippings/GENERATORS. Controls take 0–127. Outputs 0–127 control values, not audio.
upshot_phaselope.function: Generates up to eight LFO shapes spread evenly in phase.

upshot_phaser.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.phaser in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_phaser.function: Adds a phaser effect to stereo audio.

upshot_pi.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.pi in Upshot/clippings/SEQUENCERS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_pi.function: Steps through the digits of pi to generate notes.

upshot_pingpong.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.pingpong in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127. Tempo sync option.
upshot_pingpong.function: Adds a delay that bounces between left and right.

upshot_pitchdetection.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.pitchdetection in Upshot/clippings/TRACKING. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_pitchdetection.function: Detects the pitch of incoming audio as a MIDI note.

upshot_pitchshifter.category: Audio effects: pitch shift & time stretch
upshot_pitchshifter.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.pitchshifter in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127. Uses M4L.vdelay~, which ships with Max.
upshot_pitchshifter.function: Shifts stereo audio up or down by up to 24 semitones.

upshot_playlist.builtin_alternative: playlist~ — same player, any number of clips
upshot_playlist.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.playlist in Upshot/clippings/MISC. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_playlist.function: Plays up to ten audio clips with speed control.

upshot_polysynth.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.polysynth in Upshot/clippings/INSTRUMENTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_polysynth.function: Plays a simple polyphonic FM synth with envelopes.

upshot_quantizer.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.quantizer in Upshot/clippings/MIDI. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_quantizer.function: Delays MIDI notes so they land on a chosen beat division.

upshot_rain.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.rain in Upshot/clippings/MISC. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_rain.function: Synthesizes rain and hail sounds from filtered noise.

upshot_recnplay.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.recnplay in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127. Both outlet labels say (R); left is the first.
upshot_recnplay.function: Records a short stereo buffer and plays it back.

upshot_repeat.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.repeat in Upshot/clippings/GENERATORS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_repeat.function: Records and replays control movements in eight slots.

upshot_reverb.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.reverb in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_reverb.function: Adds stereo reverb with size, decay, damping and diffusion.

upshot_reversedelay.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.reversedelay in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_reversedelay.function: Captures incoming audio and plays it reversed, with delay.

upshot_reversestretch.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.reversestretch in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127. Its digest wrongly says 'Reverse delay audio effect'.
upshot_reversestretch.function: Records audio, then plays it reversed and stretched.

upshot_ringmodulator.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.ringmodulator in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127. Despite its name it uses freqshift~, which shifts rather than ring-modulates.
upshot_ringmodulator.function: Shifts the frequencies of stereo audio (labeled ring modulator).

upshot_sampler.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.sampler in Upshot/clippings/INSTRUMENTS. Controls take 0–127. Monophonic; drag-and-drop files.
upshot_sampler.function: Records a sample and plays it by MIDI note.

upshot_samplerack.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.samplerack in Upshot/clippings/INSTRUMENTS. Controls take 0–127. Accepts .wav, .aif and .mp3.
upshot_samplerack.function: Plays dropped samples from numbered pads by MIDI note, like a drum rack.

upshot_scale.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.scale in Upshot/clippings/MISC. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_scale.function: Maps 0–127 input to another range with a curve.

upshot_scalequantizer.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.scalequantizer in Upshot/clippings/MIDI. Controls take 0–127. Its refpage text is copied from upshot_quantizer and wrongly mentions time intervals.
upshot_scalequantizer.function: Snaps incoming MIDI notes to a chosen musical scale.

upshot_shortstretch.category: Audio effects: pitch shift & time stretch
upshot_shortstretch.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.shortstretch in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_shortstretch.function: Stretches the last moment of audio in real time.

upshot_slicer.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.slicer in Upshot/clippings/INSTRUMENTS. Controls take 0–127. 16 voices.
upshot_slicer.function: Slices recorded audio into 128 pieces played by MIDI note.

upshot_smooth.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.smooth in Upshot/clippings/MISC. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_smooth.function: Smooths a 0–127 data stream by slide, median or scaling.

upshot_snake.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.snake in Upshot/clippings/GENERATORS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_snake.function: Plays a Snake game that outputs positions, score and notes.

upshot_stepsequencer.builtin_alternative: live.step — the same step sequencer UI
upshot_stepsequencer.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.stepsequencer in Upshot/clippings/SEQUENCERS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_stepsequencer.function: Sequences notes with a step grid.

upshot_stutter.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.stutter in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_stutter.function: Grabs audio and repeats it at a set speed.

upshot_texttospeech.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.texttospeech in Upshot/clippings/MISC. Controls take 0–127. macOS only; needs the third-party shell external, which Upshot does not include.
upshot_texttospeech.function: Speaks typed text aloud through the system voice.

upshot_touchoscaccelerometer.category: Gesture & hardware: MIDI, grid & touch controllers
upshot_touchoscaccelerometer.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.touchoscaccelerometer in Upshot/clippings/MISC. Controls take 0–127. Needs the TouchOSC app sending to Max's port.
upshot_touchoscaccelerometer.function: Receives phone accelerometer XYZ from TouchOSC as 0–127 values.

upshot_trackpadxy.category: Gesture & hardware: computer keyboard, mouse & game controllers
upshot_trackpadxy.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.trackpadxy in Upshot/clippings/TRACKING. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_trackpadxy.function: Uses the mouse or trackpad position as an XY controller.

upshot_transport.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.transport in Upshot/clippings/MIDI. Controls take 0–127. Its refpage has no digest.
upshot_transport.function: Controls Max's global transport with tap tempo and time signature.

upshot_truerandom.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.truerandom in Upshot/clippings/MISC. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_truerandom.function: Outputs random integers in a range without repeats.

upshot_udp.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.udp in Upshot/clippings/MISC. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_udp.function: Sends and receives messages over the network by UDP.

upshot_velocityreplacer.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.velocityreplacer in Upshot/clippings/MIDI. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_velocityreplacer.function: Replaces the velocity of one chosen MIDI note.

upshot_wavelope.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.wavelope in Upshot/clippings/GENERATORS. Controls take 0–127. Outputs 0–127 control values.
upshot_wavelope.function: Generates a repeating control envelope from a chosen wave shape.

upshot_waveshapedistortion.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.waveshapedistortion in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_waveshapedistortion.function: Distorts audio through a hand-drawn wave shape.

upshot_zag.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.zag in Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_zag.function: Imitates the stretch-and-catch-up glitch of video calls.

upshot_zerogravity.comments: Bpatcher module; clipping us.zerogravity in Upshot/clippings/SEQUENCERS. Controls take 0–127.
upshot_zerogravity.function: Generates notes from collisions of six moving balls.

vector_3ch_out.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. Only one per Max session. For driving a real oscilloscope, vector monitor or laser through an audio interface; choose output channels 1-8 per signal.
vector_3ch_out.function: Sends Vsynth vector X, Y and brightness signals to audio outputs.

vector_3d_displacement.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. The right inlet signal sets Z displacement; auto_rotation turns angle controls into speeds.
vector_3d_displacement.function: Pushes vector drawings in depth by a signal, with rotation on three axes.

vector_audio2tex.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. The bridge from the vector modules to the texture modules. The readme says it works better at 96 kHz.
vector_audio2tex.function: Draws Vsynth vector X/Y/brightness signals into a texture for video mixing.

vector_brightness_merger.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures.
vector_brightness_merger.function: Combines two vector brightness signals into one.

vector_cropper.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. Like vector_edge_fade without brightness control.
vector_cropper.function: Clips a vector drawing at its left, right, top and bottom edges.

vector_crossfader.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. Use vector_xyb_compose first to bundle X/Y and brightness into one cord.
vector_crossfader.function: Crossfades, mixes or morphs between two vector drawings.

vector_cube_generator.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. auto_rotation turns angle controls into rotation speeds.
vector_cube_generator.function: Generates a rotating 3D wireframe cube as vector signals.

vector_degrader.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures.
vector_degrader.function: Quantizes vector X/Y positions into steps, like a bit-crusher for drawings.

vector_displacement.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. Modulation inputs accept signals or textures.
vector_displacement.function: Moves, scales and rotates a vector drawing, with modulation inputs.

vector_edge_fade.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. Brightness input defaults to full when nothing is connected.
vector_edge_fade.function: Fades a vector drawing's brightness to black near its edges.

vector_fisheye.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures.
vector_fisheye.function: Applies a fisheye lens distortion to a vector drawing.

vector_flip&swap.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures.
vector_flip&swap.function: Mirrors a vector drawing horizontally or vertically, or swaps X and Y.

vector_grid_generator.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. Modulation inputs take signals or textures; with nothing connected, an internal signal modulates Y and brightness.
vector_grid_generator.function: Generates a grid by rapidly switching vertical and horizontal rasters.

vector_modules.category: Patching utilities: scripting, presets & patcher control
vector_modules.comments: A menu patch, not a processing module. Vsynth's supported way to add vector modules is Paste From > Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat.
vector_modules.function: Shows the menu of Vsynth vector modules for adding them to a patch.

vector_noise_generator.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. bang makes new points; threshold and smooth fade the connecting lines.
vector_noise_generator.function: Generates random points in 2D or 3D, joined by lines, as vector signals.

vector_outline_generator.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. Requires the cv.jit package. band and detail pick the brightness range and amount of outline.
vector_outline_generator.function: Traces outlines of a video image into vector drawing signals.

vector_poly_raster_generator.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. vertex sets polygon sides; modulation inputs take signals or textures.
vector_poly_raster_generator.function: Generates a polygon-shaped raster scan as vector signals.

vector_preview.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. Inputs pass straight through to its outputs, so it can sit anywhere in a chain.
vector_preview.function: Shows vector X/Y and brightness signals in a resizable preview window.

vector_raster_generator.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. A starting point for scan-processor style images; modulation inputs take signals or textures.
vector_raster_generator.function: Generates parallel or diagonal raster lines as vector signals.

vector_ripples.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures.
vector_ripples.function: Generates sine-based ripple patterns, from stripes to radial shapes, as vector signals.

vector_scale_bias.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. Multiplies by scale, then adds bias.
vector_scale_bias.function: Scales and offsets a single vector signal, such as brightness.

vector_sketcher.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. Stores up to 240 frames with three playback modes. Requires the cv.jit package.
vector_sketcher.function: Records mouse drawings as looping frame animations output as vector signals.

vector_sosci.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. Requires the free Sosci VST from its author, installed separately.
vector_sosci.function: Loads James Ball's Sosci oscilloscope simulator plug-in with Vsynth presets.

vector_stretcher.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. Changing X and Y together scales the drawing.
vector_stretcher.function: Stretches or compresses a vector drawing on X and Y, with modulation.

vector_tex2audio.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. Outputs a 0-1 and a -1 to 1 version; takes a SYNC input from a raster generator.
vector_tex2audio.function: Reads a texture into a mono audio signal for modulating vector drawings.

vector_text_generator.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. Up to 13 characters per line. Pair vs_title_generator with vector_outline_generator for fonts and animation.
vector_text_generator.function: Draws three short lines of text as vector signals.

vector_translation_scale.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures.
vector_translation_scale.function: Moves and scales a vector drawing.

vector_twirl.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. amt sets distortion; speed animates it.
vector_twirl.function: Twists a vector drawing around its center.

vector_wobbulator_generator.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures.
vector_wobbulator_generator.function: Generates raster lines with displacement, inspired by the Paik-Abe Wobbulator.

vector_xyb_compose.comments: Vsynth vector module (bpatcher): X/Y and brightness travel as audio signals for scope-style drawing, not textures. Needed before mixing modules such as vector_crossfader. Brightness defaults to full when unconnected.
vector_xyb_compose.function: Bundles vector X/Y and brightness signals into one multichannel cord.

vs_3bandsplit.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render.
vs_3bandsplit.function: Splits a texture into three outputs by brightness band.

vs_alpha_blend.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render.
vs_alpha_blend.function: Replaces dark and bright parts of a texture with two other textures.

vs_alpha_blend_2.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Like vs_duotoner, but with textures instead of flat colors.
vs_alpha_blend_2.function: Tints dark and light parts of an image with two other textures.

vs_audio2video.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Turns audio on automatically.
vs_audio2video.function: Turns incoming audio into a scanned video image.

vs_band_splitter.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Band position can be animated with the sync timer.
vs_band_splitter.function: Keeps only the gray shades between two brightness thresholds.

vs_blendmode_mixer.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render.
vs_blendmode_mixer.function: Mixes two textures with one of twelve blend modes.

vs_camera_fm.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Second output passes the undistorted image.
vs_camera_fm.function: Brings in webcam video warped by a displacement texture.

vs_camera_s.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Use one instance per camera.
vs_camera_s.function: Brings live webcam video into a Vsynth patch as a texture.

vs_capture.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Choose codec and frame rate in the module.
vs_capture.function: Records the video output with stereo audio to a movie file.

vs_cartopol.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Pairs with vs_poltocar.
vs_cartopol.function: Remaps a texture from Cartesian to polar coordinates.

vs_chemical_osc.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. bang reset restarts the reaction. Works alone or with a connected video source.
vs_chemical_osc.function: Generates evolving patterns from a Belousov-Zhabotinsky reaction simulation.

vs_chroma_key.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Use vs_clr_xtrct to pick the key color by clicking the image.
vs_chroma_key.function: Keys one texture over another by distance from a chosen color.

vs_clr_solid.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. color takes r g b a floats from 0 to 1.

vs_clr_xtrct.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Outputs data, not a texture; feed it to vs_chroma_key or a colorizer.
crossref: UI: buttons, pads, tabs & color pickers
vs_clr_xtrct.function: Outputs the color of the pixel you click in its preview.

vs_colorizer.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render.
vs_colorizer.function: Tints a texture with one chosen color.

vs_colorizer_2.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Modulation inputs take textures.
vs_colorizer_2.function: Adjusts hue, saturation, lightness and pedestal, with hue and saturation modulation.

vs_comparator.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. smooth softens the cut.
vs_comparator.function: Pushes pixels to full or zero brightness around a threshold.

vs_convolve.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Kernel rows can also be set by message.
vs_convolve.function: Applies a 3x3 convolution kernel, with a menu of classic kernels.

vs_cos_palettes.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Three outputs: gradient, solid color, and a gradient map of the input's brightness. A second inlet can override the gradient, for example from jit.gradient.ui.
vs_cos_palettes.function: Generates cosine color gradients and uses them to recolor an image.

vs_crssfade.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render.

vs_degrader.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Since v1.7 set by color count 0-255; older presets may load differently.
vs_degrader.function: Reduces the number of color levels (posterizes) a texture.

vs_differentiator.builtin_alternative: jit.fx.co.difference (Jitter Tools, with a delayed copy)
vs_differentiator.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Shows only what moves; still images go black.
crossref: Computer vision: motion, tracking & optical flow
vs_differentiator.function: Outputs the difference between the current and previous frame.

vs_displacement.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Separate modulation inputs for X, Y, angle and zoom; several warp modes.
vs_displacement.function: Moves, rotates and zooms a texture with texture modulation inputs.

vs_dither.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. scale sets pattern size.
vs_dither.function: Dithers an image with an 8x8 ordered Bayer pattern.

vs_duotoner.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Sharp or smooth mode.
vs_duotoner.function: Colors the dark and light parts of an image with two chosen colors.

vs_edges.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Built from vs_filter_hp4x and vs_comparator.
vs_edges.function: Detects edges using a high-pass filter and a threshold.

vs_envelope.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Trigger with bang; attack and decay times are settable.
vs_envelope.function: Generates an attack-decay brightness envelope when triggered.

vs_envelope_follower.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Useful for audio-reactive brightness.
vs_envelope_follower.function: Turns audio loudness into a texture and a number.

vs_fader.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. clip keeps values within 0-1; fader goes up to 1.5.
vs_fader.function: Changes the overall brightness of a texture.

vs_feedback.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. amt sets trail length.
vs_feedback.function: Adds a video feedback loop for trails, using a max operation.

vs_filter_hp4x.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. cutoff 0-0.25. Useful for taming noisy feedback and for edge detectors.
vs_filter_hp4x.function: Sharpens and extracts edges with a Gaussian high-pass filter.

vs_filter_lp2x.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. vs_filter_lp4x blurs more at higher cost.
vs_filter_lp2x.function: Blurs a texture with a two-pass Gaussian low-pass filter.

vs_filter_lp4x.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Smoother but heavier than vs_filter_lp2x.
vs_filter_lp4x.function: Blurs a texture with a four-pass Gaussian low-pass filter.

vs_filter_spat.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Four passes; cutoff 0-0.25.
vs_filter_spat.function: Filters a texture spatially in low-pass, high-pass or band-pass mode.

vs_filter_temp.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. Separate high-pass and low-pass outputs. Does nothing on a still image.
vs_filter_temp.function: Filters a texture over time, splitting slow and fast changes.

vs_fish_eye.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render. aperture 0-180.
vs_fish_eye.function: Applies a fisheye lens distortion to a texture.

vs_flip&swap.comments: Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu); needs one vs_render.
vs_flip&swap.function: Mirrors a texture horizontally or vertically, or swaps its axes.
