mo.notepad.function: Text box whose contents are stored in a dict.

mo.number.function: Number box for integer, float or MIDI values in a set range.

mo.numbers.function: Row of number displays that grows with the incoming list.

mo.pad.category: UI: buttons, pads, tabs & color pickers

mo.pads.category: UI: buttons, pads, tabs & color pickers
mo.pads.function: Row of pads where each pad is set to trigger or bang mode.

mo.pipe.function: Delays numbers, lists or symbols, then resets the delay to 0.

mo.playlist~.function: Plays, loops and selects sections of sound files.

mo.poll.builtin_alternative: qlim — limits rate, but only when new data arrives

mo.prepend.category: Lists & data: change detection, matching & routing
mo.prepend.function: Adds a message in front of input, for all voices or one target voice.

mo.preset.category: Patching utilities: scripting, presets & patcher control
mo.preset.comments: Works with modulo's pattr bindings, so all mo.* parameters are included.
mo.preset.function: Preset panel for storing and recalling patch states.

mo.rand.builtin_alternative: drunk — random walk with a step size
mo.rand.function: Generates 0–1 random values at a rate, with step size and probability.

mo.receive.function: Receives data by name from mo.send, without cables.

mo.receives.function: Receives from several named senders in one object.

mo.receive~.comments: Restart DSP after the channel count changes (modulo README).
mo.receive~.function: Receives multichannel audio by name, without cables.

mo.record.builtin_alternative: mtr — multitrack data recorder, no panel
mo.record.function: Records, loops and plays back control data with speed and range.

mo.record~.comments: Set the length first; shorter takes are cropped.
mo.record~.function: Records multichannel audio for a set length and saves it to a file.

mo.rms~.comments: Restart DSP after the channel count changes (modulo README).
mo.rms~.function: Outputs the average level of each audio channel as numbers.

mo.route.category: Lists & data: change detection, matching & routing
mo.route.function: Routes matching input to outlets, for all voices or one target voice.

mo.rsliders.function: Range sliders, one low/high pair per voice.

mo.scale.function: Maps list values to a new range, for all voices or each one.

mo.schmitt.builtin_alternative: thresh~ — the same two-threshold idea for signals
mo.schmitt.function: On/off trigger with separate thresholds, per voice.

mo.scope.function: Plots control data over time, unipolar or bipolar.

mo.select.category: Lists & data: change detection, matching & routing
mo.select.function: Outputs a value when input matches, with fuzzy float matching.

mo.send.function: Sends data by name to mo.receive, without cables.

mo.sends.function: Sends to several named receivers from one object.

mo.send~.comments: Restart DSP after the channel count changes (modulo README).
mo.send~.function: Sends multichannel audio by name, without cables.

mo.serial.function: Talks to Arduino, Teensy and other serial devices, picked from a menu.

mo.shake.function: Measures movement in sensor data with up and down smoothing.

mo.sig~.comments: Restart DSP after the channel count changes (modulo README).
mo.sig~.function: Turns a list of numbers into a multichannel signal.

mo.slide.function: Smooths each list value with separate up and down slide amounts.

mo.sliders.function: Row of sliders for a list of values, unipolar or bipolar.

mo.smooth.function: Smooths each list value with up and down times in ms.

mo.snapshot~.comments: Restart DSP after the channel count changes (modulo README).
mo.snapshot~.function: Samples each audio channel into a list of numbers.

mo.spectroscope~.function: Spectrum or sonogram display for audio.

mo.speedlim.function: Limits how often a list passes through.

mo.split.function: Sends numbers out separate outlets for within, below and above a range.

mo.steer.function: Turns two values into one direction value centered on 0.5.

mo.step.function: Step sequencer with pitch, velocity, duration and two extra lanes.

mo.swatch.category: UI: buttons, pads, tabs & color pickers
mo.swatch.function: Color picker controlled by hue, saturation and lightness.

mo.tabs.category: UI: buttons, pads, tabs & color pickers
mo.tabs.function: Tab bar with a set number of named tabs.

mo.theremin~.function: Theremin-style synth voice with pitch, volume, timbre and vibrato.

mo.transport.function: Shows and controls Max's global transport: tempo, bars, beats.

mo.udpreceive.function: Receives network messages on a UDP port.

mo.udpsend.function: Sends network messages to a host and port.

mo.vector.function: Sums several control values as vectors into one x/y direction.

mo.vrslider.function: Vertical range sliders, each setting a low and high value.

mo.vslider.function: Vertical sliders for a list of values, ready for MIDI mapping.

mo.vtab.category: UI: buttons, pads, tabs & color pickers
mo.vtab.function: Vertical tabs with named items for picking a state.

mo.xbendout.function: Sends high-resolution MIDI pitch bend to a device.

mo.xbendouts.comments: Useful for per-voice bends, as in MPE.
mo.xbendouts.function: Sends a list of high-resolution pitch bends, one per voice.

mo.xypad.function: Two-dimensional pad that controls a pair of values.

01_max_and_odot.category: odot OSC bundles: making, storing & viewing
01_max_and_odot.comments: A tutorial patch, not an object for use in patches.
01_max_and_odot.function: Opens lesson 1 of the odot tutorial: bundles versus Max messages.

o.append.category: odot OSC bundles: routing, testing & editing
o.append.comments: Works on odot bundles only, not plain Max messages.
o.append.function: Adds an OSC address to the end of every address in a bundle.

o.change.category: odot OSC bundles: routing, testing & editing
o.change.comments: Reordering the contents counts as a change.
o.change.function: Passes a bundle only when it differs from the previous one.

o.collect.category: odot OSC bundles: making, storing & viewing
o.collect.comments: Accepts plain Max messages like /freq 440, so it is an entry point into odot.
o.collect.function: Gathers OSC-style messages and outputs them as one bundle on bang.

o.compose.category: odot OSC bundles: making, storing & viewing
o.compose.comments: Also the safe way to store a bundle. Needs no other odot object upstream.
o.compose.function: Holds an OSC bundle typed as text and outputs it on bang.

o.cond.category: odot OSC bundles: routing, testing & editing
o.cond.comments: One outlet per comma-separated expression. Like a switch statement for bundles.
o.cond.function: Sends a bundle out the outlet of the first expression that is true.

o.dict.category: odot OSC bundles: making, storing & viewing
o.dict.comments: Bridge from odot to dict, dict.view and v8.
o.dict.function: Converts an odot bundle into a Max dictionary.

o.difference.category: odot OSC bundles: routing, testing & editing
o.difference.function: Outputs messages whose addresses are not in both input bundles.

o.display.category: odot OSC bundles: making, storing & viewing
o.display.comments: The main way to see what a bundle holds.
o.display.function: Shows an odot bundle as readable text and passes it through.

o.edge~.category: odot OSC bundles: making, storing & viewing
o.edge~.comments: Lives in odot's deprecated folder, which is not on the search path unless you add it by hand. Unsupported.
o.edge~.function: Reports when a signal changes between zero and nonzero.

o.explode.category: odot OSC bundles: routing, testing & editing
o.explode.function: Turns /a/b style addresses into nested sub-bundles.

o.expr.codebox.category: odot OSC bundles: routing, testing & editing
o.expr.codebox.comments: odot's expression language: math, conditionals, list functions. The older o.expr object is only in the deprecated folder.
o.expr.codebox.function: Runs expressions that read and write the values in a bundle.

o.flatten.category: odot OSC bundles: routing, testing & editing
o.flatten.function: Pulls messages out of nested sub-bundles into the top bundle.

o.gui.attach.category: odot OSC bundles: making, storing & viewing
o.gui.attach.comments: Lives in odot's dev folder, which is not on the search path by default. Does not search subpatchers.
o.gui.attach.function: Reports the state of UI objects whose scripting names are OSC addresses.

o.if.category: odot OSC bundles: routing, testing & editing
o.if.function: Sends a bundle left if an expression is true, else right.

o.intersection.category: odot OSC bundles: routing, testing & editing
o.intersection.function: Keeps left-bundle messages whose addresses also appear in the right bundle.

o.listenumerate.category: odot OSC bundles: routing, testing & editing
o.listenumerate.function: Outputs the items of a list at one address one at a time.

o.pack.category: odot OSC bundles: making, storing & viewing
o.pack.comments: Addresses are arguments; the left inlet triggers output.
o.pack.function: Binds values arriving at each inlet to an OSC address and outputs a bundle.

o.prepend.category: odot OSC bundles: routing, testing & editing
o.prepend.comments: Works on odot bundles only, not plain Max messages.
o.prepend.function: Adds an OSC address to the front of every address in a bundle.

o.print.category: odot OSC bundles: making, storing & viewing
o.print.comments: Plain print cannot show bundle contents.
o.print.function: Prints a bundle to the Max Console and passes it through.

o.printbytes.category: odot OSC bundles: making, storing & viewing
o.printbytes.function: Prints the raw bytes of an OSC packet to the Max Console.

o.route.builtin_alternative: route (plain Max messages, exact match, no wildcards)
o.route.category: odot OSC bundles: routing, testing & editing
o.route.comments: Supports OSC pattern matching (*, ?, [ ], { }). For bundles from the network use udpreceive with a symbol argument so it passes whole OSC packets.
o.route.function: Routes bundle messages by OSC address, with wildcards, removing the matched part.

o.schedule.category: odot OSC bundles: making, storing & viewing
o.schedule.comments: Needs bundles carrying timetags, for example from o.timetag.
o.schedule.function: Holds bundles and outputs each at the time in its timetag.

o.select.category: odot OSC bundles: routing, testing & editing
o.select.function: Routes bundle messages by OSC address and keeps the full address.

o.timetag.category: odot OSC bundles: making, storing & viewing
o.timetag.function: Stamps the current time into a bundle at an address you choose.

o.union.category: odot OSC bundles: routing, testing & editing
o.union.function: Merges two bundles; the left bundle wins on duplicate addresses.

o.var.category: odot OSC bundles: making, storing & viewing
o.var.comments: Use this or o.compose to keep a bundle; zl.reg and similar objects store only a pointer that goes stale.
o.var.function: Stores a bundle and outputs it again on bang.

cm.buffercloud~.comments: Needs a sample buffer~ and a window buffer~. Grains are triggered by a signal. Each grain gets random start, length, pitch, pan and gain within set ranges.
cm.buffercloud~.function: Plays many overlapping grains from a buffer~, windowed by a second buffer~.

cm.gausscloud~.comments: Window shape can vary per grain. No window buffer~ needed.
cm.gausscloud~.function: Plays many overlapping grains from a buffer~ with adjustable Gaussian windows.

cm.indexcloud~.comments: Choose the window by index. Used by petra's example Live device. No window buffer~ needed.
cm.indexcloud~.function: Plays many overlapping grains from a buffer~ with built-in window shapes.

cm.livecloud~.comments: Needs a window buffer~. Recording is started with a record message. Grains are triggered by a signal. Port counts unsettled: help file shows 12 in / 5 out, refpage 11 / 4.
cm.livecloud~.function: Granulates live input from a circular recording buffer with adjustable delay.

rytm.category: Gesture & hardware: MIDI, grid & touch controllers
rytm.comments: Only for Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.70. Connect sysexin to the inlet and the left outlet to midiout.
rytm.function: Reads and edits an Elektron Analog Rytm MKII's patterns and kits over SysEx.

rr.rampr.comments: Settings are edited in a window opened by double-click. Give it a unique name argument; settings save to a JSON file in the package's misc/userdata folder. Non-commercial license.
rr.rampr.function: Plays speeding-up or slowing-down runs of MIDI notes with matching CC ramps.

rr.randomizr.comments: Double-click to open its settings window. Needs a unique name argument. Parameters can be locked to move together.
rr.randomizr.function: Generates random MIDI notes and CC messages within set limits.

rr.randomrampr.comments: Double-click to open its settings window. Needs a unique name argument. Start and end values are chosen at random within limits.
rr.randomrampr.function: Plays a sequence of random speeding-up or slowing-down MIDI note runs.

mc.sn.comp~.comments: Mapped to mc.wrapper~ around the sn version, so each channel runs its own copy. Use the mcs.sn version for one processor across channels.
mc.sn.comp~.function: Compresses each channel of a multichannel signal separately.

mc.sn.drive~.comments: Mapped to mc.wrapper~ around the sn version, so each channel runs its own copy. Use the mcs.sn version for one processor across channels.
mc.sn.drive~.function: Adds harmonic distortion to each channel of a multichannel signal.

mc.sn.ecomp~.comments: Mapped to mc.wrapper~ around the sn version, so each channel runs its own copy. Use the mcs.sn version for one processor across channels.
mc.sn.ecomp~.function: Runs an expander-gate into a compressor on each channel separately.

mc.sn.egate~.comments: Mapped to mc.wrapper~ around the sn version, so each channel runs its own copy. Use the mcs.sn version for one processor across channels.
mc.sn.egate~.function: Runs a downward expander or gate on each channel separately.

mc.sn.gate~.comments: Mapped to mc.wrapper~ around the sn version, so each channel runs its own copy. Use the mcs.sn version for one processor across channels.
mc.sn.gate~.function: Gates each channel of a multichannel signal separately.

mc.sn.lim~.comments: Mapped to mc.wrapper~ around the sn version, so each channel runs its own copy. Use the mcs.sn version for one processor across channels.
mc.sn.lim~.function: Limits each channel of a multichannel signal separately.

mc.sn.line~.comments: Mapped to mc.wrapper~ around the sn version, so each channel runs its own copy. Use the mcs.sn version for one processor across channels.
mc.sn.line~.function: Generates multichannel signal ramps and envelopes.

mcs.sn.bfilter~.comments: Parameter mode, or cascade mode fed by filtergraph~ coefficients.
mcs.sn.bfilter~.function: Filters a multichannel signal through a chain of biquad sections.

mcs.sn.comp~.comments: Takes one multichannel cable into a single processor. The hoa attribute lets the first channel drive gain for ambisonic streams.
mcs.sn.comp~.function: Compresses a multichannel signal as one unit.

mcs.sn.drive~.function: Adds harmonic distortion to a multichannel signal.

mcs.sn.ecomp~.comments: Takes one multichannel cable into a single processor. The hoa attribute lets the first channel drive gain for ambisonic streams.
mcs.sn.ecomp~.function: Runs an expander-gate into a compressor on a multichannel signal.

mcs.sn.egate~.comments: Takes one multichannel cable into a single processor. The hoa attribute lets the first channel drive gain for ambisonic streams.
mcs.sn.egate~.function: Applies a downward expander or gate to a multichannel signal.

mcs.sn.gate~.comments: Takes one multichannel cable into a single processor. The hoa attribute lets the first channel drive gain for ambisonic streams.
mcs.sn.gate~.function: Gates a multichannel signal as one unit.

mcs.sn.komp~.function: Applies smooth mastering-style compression to a multichannel signal.

mcs.sn.leveler~.comments: Low and high thresholds work like an upward expander plus a compressor.
mcs.sn.leveler~.function: Raises quiet passages and tames loud ones in a multichannel signal.

mcs.sn.lim~.comments: Has lookahead, a key input and makeup gain. Takes one multichannel cable into a single processor. The hoa attribute lets the first channel drive gain for ambisonic streams.
mcs.sn.lim~.function: Limits a multichannel signal as one unit.

s2n.overview.category: Patching utilities: scripting, presets & patcher control
s2n.overview.comments: An overview patch, not an object for use in patches.

sn.bfilter.id.comments: Helper for sn.bfilter~: type, frequency, Q, gain and bypass.
sn.bfilter.id.function: Formats settings for one filter stage of sn.bfilter~.

sn.bfilter~.comments: Parameter mode or coefficient mode compatible with filtergraph~.
sn.bfilter~.function: Filters a signal through a chain of biquad EQ sections.

sn.comp~.comments: Named instance can dump and recall its settings through a receive.

sn.drive~.function: Adds harmonic distortion through a nonlinear curve.

sn.ecomp~.function: Runs a downward expander-gate into a compressor on a mono signal.

sn.egate~.function: Applies a downward expander, gate or upward compression to a mono signal.

sn.envf~.function: Follows the amplitude envelope of a signal.

sn.gate~.function: Gates a mono signal below a threshold.

sn.line~.comments: Adds a ramp-active outlet and a mute outlet for poly~.
sn.line~.function: Generates signal ramps and envelopes from target-time pairs.

sm.ladder~.comments: Resonance 1 self-oscillates. Built in gen~; double-click to look inside. Cutoff is in MIDI pitch by default (cutoffmode).
sm.ladder~.function: Filters audio with a Moog-style 24 dB lowpass ladder filter.

sm.sallenkey2~.comments: Stereo version of sm.sallenkey~. Built in gen~; double-click to look inside. Cutoff is in MIDI pitch by default (cutoffmode).
sm.sallenkey2~.function: Filters a stereo signal with an MS-20-style multimode filter.

sm.sallenkey~.comments: filter attribute picks the type; slope picks 12 or 24 dB. Built in gen~; double-click to look inside. Cutoff is in MIDI pitch by default (cutoffmode).
sm.sallenkey~.function: Filters audio with an MS-20-style multimode filter and saturation.

mcs.spectrogram.player~.builtin_alternative: mcs.groove~ (plain MC buffer~ player, no spectrogram link)
mcs.spectrogram.player~.comments: Channel count follows the buffer~ unless @chans is set, and updates only when audio restarts. Otherwise identical to spectrogram.player~.
mcs.spectrogram.player~.function: Plays the buffer~ shown in a spectrogram~ from one multichannel outlet.

spectrogram.colorbar.comments: Link it by a patch cord from its outlet to any spectrogram~ inlet. write saves it as a PNG.
spectrogram.colorbar.function: Shows the colour scale used by a connected spectrogram~.

spectrogram.player~.builtin_alternative: groove~ (same transport idea, no spectrogram link)
spectrogram.player~.comments: Connect its rightmost outlet to spectrogram~. Then loop points follow the selection and @filter plays only selected regions, adding @filter_fft_size samples of delay. Unlinked, it is a plain player.
spectrogram.player~.function: Plays and loops the buffer~ shown in a spectrogram~, filtering to the selection.

spectrogram~.builtin_alternative: spectroscope~ (live signal only, no buffer~ view or editing)
spectrogram~.comments: Point it at a buffer~ with @buffer_name. Edits such as edit_selection_delete change the buffer~ itself; undo and redo are available. Frequency scales include Mel and ERB.
spectrogram~.function: Displays a buffer~ as a zoomable spectrogram and lets you edit it spectrally.

voice-alligator.comments: Adds note streams with priorities, hold notes and microtonal scale_def. Pairs with mc.poly~; the voice count must match.
voice-alligator.function: Assigns notes to mc.poly~ voices, with mono/poly switching, hold and custom scales.

voice-alligator-audio~.comments: Signal-driven version of voice-alligator~ for signal sequencers.
voice-alligator-audio~.function: Allocates voices from trigger, pitch and velocity signals, with envelopes.

voice-alligator-looper.comments: Plays back on its own stream; attributes set speed, transpose and jitter.
voice-alligator-looper.function: Records and loops notes played through voice-alligator, with exact pitches.

voice-alligator~.comments: Built-in ADSR and glide, so voices need no envelope of their own. Pairs with mc.poly~; the voice count must match.
voice-alligator~.function: Assigns notes to voices and outputs envelope and pitch as MC signals.

zero.announce.comments: Uses ZeroConf (Bonjour). Windows may need Apple's Bonjour installed.
zero.announce.function: Announces a network service, such as an OSC port, so others can find it.

zero.browse.comments: Pair with zero.resolve to get the address. Windows may need Apple's Bonjour installed.
zero.browse.function: Lists network services of a chosen type found on the local network.

zero.resolve.comments: Feed its output to udpsend. Works with services found by zero.browse.
zero.resolve.function: Looks up the IP address and port of a named network service.

zsa.ampstats~.comments: Most useful inside pfft~. misc/zsa.easy_ampstats~ builds the pfft~ for you.
zsa.ampstats~.function: Reports min, mean, max and sum of each signal vector or FFT frame.

zsa.bark~.comments: Works only inside pfft~. misc/zsa.easy_bark~ builds the pfft~ for you.
zsa.bark~.function: Outputs Bark-band energies of each FFT frame as a list.

zsa.centroid~.comments: Works only inside pfft~. misc/zsa.easy_centroid~ builds the pfft~ for you. fluid.spectralshape~ gives this and six more.
zsa.centroid~.function: Outputs the spectral centroid in Hz, a measure of brightness.

zsa.dct.comments: Turns zsa.mel~ bands into cepstral coefficients.
zsa.dct.function: Computes a discrete cosine transform of a list.

zsa.decrease.function: Measures how quickly magnitudes fall across a list, such as mel bands.

zsa.decrease~.comments: Works only inside pfft~. misc/zsa.easy_decrease~ builds the pfft~ for you.
zsa.decrease~.function: Measures how quickly spectral magnitudes fall off in each FFT frame.

zsa.dist.comments: Store key and values in the right inlet, query with a list on the left. Supports weights and read/write. Simple nearest match without FluCoMa.
zsa.dist.function: Finds the stored list closest to an input list.

zsa.energy~.builtin_alternative: cartopol~ (outputs amplitude and phase, needs a square root)
zsa.energy~.function: Computes the energy of each FFT bin.

zsa.flatness~.comments: Works only inside pfft~. misc/zsa.easy_flatness~ builds the pfft~ for you. Set band edges with @freq.
zsa.flatness~.function: Outputs spectral flatness per frequency band, from tonal to noisy.

zsa.flux~.comments: Works only inside pfft~. misc/zsa.easy_flux~ builds the pfft~ for you.
zsa.flux~.function: Measures how much the spectrum changes between FFT frames.

zsa.freqpeak~.comments: Works only inside pfft~. misc/zsa.easy_freqpeak~ builds the pfft~ for you. Feeds zsa.fund and zsa.roughness.
zsa.freqpeak~.function: Lists the strongest frequency and amplitude peaks of each FFT frame.

zsa.fund.comments: Feed it zsa.freqpeak~ output. Outputs a MIDI-rounded pitch and amplitude.
zsa.fund.function: Estimates the fundamental from a list of frequency and amplitude peaks.

zsa.kurtosis~.comments: Works only inside pfft~. misc/zsa.easy_kurtosis~ builds the pfft~ for you.
zsa.kurtosis~.function: Measures how sharply peaked the spectrum is.

zsa.mel~.comments: Works only inside pfft~. misc/zsa.easy_mel~ builds the pfft~ for you.
zsa.mel~.function: Outputs mel-band energies of each FFT frame as a list.

zsa.mfcc~.comments: Works only inside pfft~. misc/zsa.easy_mfcc~ builds the pfft~ for you. fluid.mfcc~ needs no pfft~.
zsa.mfcc~.function: Outputs MFCC timbre coefficients of each FFT frame.

zsa.rolloff~.comments: Works only inside pfft~. misc/zsa.easy_rolloff~ builds the pfft~ for you.
zsa.rolloff~.function: Outputs the frequency below which most of the spectral energy lies.

zsa.roughness.comments: Input is frequency-amplitude pairs, as in its help file.
zsa.roughness.function: Estimates sensory roughness from frequency and amplitude pairs.

zsa.skewness~.comments: Works only inside pfft~. misc/zsa.easy_skewness~ builds the pfft~ for you.
zsa.skewness~.function: Measures how lopsided the spectrum is around its centre.

zsa.slope.comments: Refpage inlet and outlet labels (MIDI note, frequency) are copy errors.
zsa.slope.function: Computes the slope of a list of magnitudes by linear regression.

zsa.slope~.comments: Works only inside pfft~. misc/zsa.easy_slope~ builds the pfft~ for you.
zsa.slope~.function: Computes the overall spectral tilt of each FFT frame.

zsa.spread~.comments: Works only inside pfft~. misc/zsa.easy_spread~ builds the pfft~ for you.
zsa.spread~.function: Measures how widely the spectrum spreads around its centroid.

zsa.virtfund.comments: Right outlet reports calculation time and success, not confidence. Raise @max_iterations for hard cases.
zsa.virtfund.function: Estimates the implied fundamental of a list of frequencies.
